name: Akari - The Five Eyed Fox
summary:
Play as Akari, a magical fox imbued with the power of light in this fast paced Metroidvania. Slash and Dash your way through an army of darkness and explore diverse, beautiful worlds.

“Akari - The Five Eyed Fox” tells an emotional story of hope in the face of despair through a beautifully crafted 2D action-adventure platformer developed by SplashFire Studios.

Slash your way through dark enemies. 
Jump, climb, and dash through diverse worlds while avoiding obstacles. 
Collect shards of light to unlock and upgrade abilities that allow you to reach new areas. 
Collect the lost memories of Akari to discover the truth of who you were in a life forgotten. 
Collect gate drives to open portals into entirely new worlds to explore and find more collectables in. 
When you've collected enough to breach the dark veil, battle your way through the dark realm and put an end to the invasion once and for all.

The realm of the gates has been guarded for centuries by a clan of foxes. When their world is invaded by an army of darkness, A fox named Akari risks everything so the others may escape, but after being cornered and overrun by these dark entities Akari closes his eyes and accepts that this is the end. Upon re-awakening Akari finds himself alone in a vast dream-like dimension with no memory of who he is or how he got there. It is in this place that he encounters Liora, the goddess of light and is granted a spark of her power. With this new power of light Akari sets out on a journey to remember who he is and find a way to end the dark invasion and restore peace to his home.

name: Super Indiemania
summary:
Whip your way through hordes of supernatural monsters and bosses! For fans of classic-vanias and linear 2D side-scrollers with a goal of mastering each stage and destroying its boss! Discover hidden items, secondary weapons and even vehicles!

Super Indiemania is a game inspired by several classics. It is a 2D action side-scroller and mainly a linear experience. Keep moving forward to each new stage while fighting supernatural enemies/bosses, avoiding hazards, discovering items, and utilizing vehicles!

 Many unique areas to explore, such as: graveyards, giant beehives, mushroom jungle ruins, an underwater palace, evil forests, a castle...and more of course!

 A multitude of different enemies and bosses to conquer: Zombies, Shroomtrolls, Skeletons, Evil Bears, Vampires, and Carl!

 Your main weapon is a whip with a multi-directional ability: attack horizontally, vertically and diagonally!

 Discover new sub weapons on each stage: Crystal Crosses, Mushroom Bombs, Throwing Leaves, and others!

 Most sub weapons have a secondary use, e.g. the Crystal Cross can turn into a shield to repel enemies, the Throwing Leaf can be thrown at multiple angles

 In certain areas, utilize vehicles such as minecarts, a mushroom-ship with a laser cannon, a super strong penguin and others

 Find hidden items, such as health, score, projectile ammunition and extra lives pickups in each area

Story:

An Evil Nerd has created yet another 2D game...how surprising! To create his new world the Evil Nerd has stolen and corrupted the souls of many Indie Developers! Our hero is forced to play the game over and over until he is able to free the Indie Souls and defeat the Evil Nerd and his minions!

Do you have what it takes to put an end to the Evil Nerd (and his unoriginal ideas) and destroy Castle Indiemania once and for all (or maybe not...)?

name: Symbiotic: Invasion
summary:
Symbiotic: Invasion is an RPG Visual Novel that's been meticulously crafted over the years. Throughout development, the game has undergone many changes to achieve a quality level I'm proud of. Battle monsters, explore, uncover secrets, and immerse yourself in an emotional rollercoaster of a story!

How It’s Made

As a self-taught solo developer, I handle the majority of the art, writing, and coding for ‘Symbiotic: Invasion,’ balancing this passion with a full-time job. Initially planned as a premium webcomic, the project evolved into a Visual Novel using the CloudNovel engine. Facing engine constraints and issues with the engine’s maintainer, I switched to using Monogatari. After months of learning and coding, the game was successfully ported to the new engine. Over the years, the game has gone through a complete overhaul, major visual enhancements, and coding upgrades to greatly improve its quality and player experience.

Battle Against Alien Monsters:

The war for Earth rages on, fueled by the ominous presence of Metamor, a pitch-black planet that has locked its orbit with our own. Its dark tendrils reach out, unleashing hordes of alien monsters upon our world. In special speed-based combat, you’ll stand as Earth’s last line of defense, fighting to protect the lives of men, women, children, and animals from these parasitic, symbiotic creatures.

Explore & Help Students With Their Problems:

Roam the SCAR Institute as Zaydin, a snarky teenager who couldn’t care less who he offends, through the exploration map. Encounter a cast of… “unique” characters with problems for you to solve: a girl obsessed with sweets, a puzzle-maniac boy, two enigmatic lunch ladies with many secrets, and a seemingly omniscient janitor with an uncanny awareness of the institute’s goings–ons are just a few of the people you’ll meet. Each character you meet has their own life story and experiences that can be played out through their engaging questlines and personal interactions.

name: MugenCards
summary:
Play MugenCards, an endless card game!

MugenCards is a simple card game that can be played endlessly. The player is presented with two to six cards. Pick a red card and your coins will increase. Pick a blue card and your coins will decrease. You can pick a card simply by pressing one of the assigned buttons/key on your gamepad/keyboard. (You can change the assigned buttons/keys in the Options menu.)

After picking a card, you will then proceed to the next round. Try to keep playing for as long as you can by avoiding the blue cards! If your coins reaches zero, then it's game over. As long as you still have some coins left after picking a card, you will be able to proceed to the next round.

The speed at which the blue card switches with a red card will increase as you proceed to higher rounds. The coins you can earn/lose from the cards will increase with each round, thus both the risk and reward of playing another round will increase with each round you decide to play. Try to pick a red card each round!

summary:

Five Finger Discount is all about getting that sweet adrenaline rush when stealing something.

Inspired by real life events, the story revolves around Michael, a young man who was just released out of prison on parole. He doesn't want to talk about his past, and just leave it behind, but he's just the same ? magnet that he always was. 

Starting with some small mistakes that could happen to any law abiding citizen, he is forced very soon to commit some serious heists, or he will face the wrath of some very bad people.

Use your head, not your fists.

Michael swore to never commit violence, if you are detected you may try to run, but if you get busted, it's game over.

This game was designed to be as realistic as possible, with mechanics such as safe cracking, lock picking, and the use of debugging tools sourced from the dark net, all designed by real-life professionals. 

The community is your strength.

If you need something, there surely is someone who can help you. You should talk to the NPCs you meet in the game or connect with other players on our discord server.

This game rewards skill rather than repetition.

You can break into a bank on the first day if you want. No unlocking a different skin by doing the same repetitive task 600 times.

name: Riemann's Lens
summary:
Explore a wormhole! Riemann's Lens simulates the non-euclidean geometry and strange visual effects associated with a Riemannian wormhole. This interactive virtual art display allows you to fly around and through the wormhole.

Explore a wormhole!

Riemann’s Lens simulates the non-euclidean geometry and strange visual effects associated with a Riemannian wormhole. While it is unknown whether these objects exist in nature, nothing prevents us from investigating their properties and consequences with our computers. 

Riemann’s Lens is an interactive virtual art display that allows you to fly around and through a wormhole, with simple scenery rendered in the euclidean space on either end. The size and geometry of the wormhole can be adjusted. 

Custom scenery can be defined with a scripting language.

The simulation uses a compute shader to perform non-euclidean ray-tracing, and relies on the graphics card to perform some heavy computations. It has been developed on a machine with a GeForce GTX 1650, and it manages 2-5 fps. Expect some lag. The graphics card must support OpenGL 4.3+, and compute shaders. It did not run on an Nvidia Quadro K1100M (6 year old laptop).

name: 蚀界档案
summary:
一款由骰子驱动命运的克苏鲁风格战棋游戏。探索、解密、战斗，在策略棋盘上运筹帷幄，在疯狂与理智的边缘，指挥你的调查员小队。谨慎探索，明智抉择，在真相揭露前，别让疯狂吞噬你。

骰子已然掷下，理智正在流失。欢迎来到一个由混沌与秘密构成的世界，在这里，每一次调查都是一场与未知的豪赌。

加入我们，成为传奇的一部分。如果你渴望更多讨论或获得最新消息，欢迎加入我们的社区：

（准备好，开始你的调查吧。）

游戏故事：

侦探沈立邦，与助手克里斯，神秘少女爱丽丝，一起踏入了都市最阴暗的角落。他的目标不仅是寻回至亲，更是要撕开这个世界的伪装，直面帷幕之下不可名状的恐怖。你的选择，将决定他成为英雄，还是又一个沉沦于疯狂的牺牲品。

核心体验：战棋跑团 × 动态叙事
这是一款将SLG战棋策略与桌上角色扮演（TRPG） 精髓深度融合的游戏。

策略调查： 在棋盘格般的场景中规划每一步，移动、探索、与角色互动，搜集散落的线索碎片。

动态骰判： 游戏的核心。每一次关键行动的成功与否，都由一套复杂的动态数值系统模拟掷骰决定。你的技能、状态、环境甚至运气，都将共同影响命运的走向。

多重结局： 每一个委托案件都拥有多个独特结局。是完美解决，还是酿成悲剧？抑或揭开隐藏最深的真相？重复游玩，探索所有可能性。

游戏主要特色

深度互动与线索网络： 场景中的一切皆可交互。一张便条、一道抓痕、一句低语都可能是关键。组合关联线索，推导出隐藏的真相，推动剧情前进。

传奇调查员： 招募能力各异的伙伴。无论是力大无穷的体育生，还是活力四射的侦探助手，或是能看见“不可见之物”的女大学生。组建你的终极团队，应对不同威胁。

丰富道具与危险秘术： 使用超过60种道具辅助调查。但小心，某些记载古老秘术的卷轴能扭转战局，也可能让你付出惨痛代价。

敌友莫辨的鲜活世界： 与众多拥有独立秘密的NPC互动。那位彬彬有礼的教授，活泼的兔耳女仆……他们提供的是帮助，还是将你引向深渊的诱饵？信任，是这里最奢侈的资源。

回合制策略交锋： 在遭遇不可言说的存在时，进入紧张的回合制战斗。精心规划站位、技能与道具使用，在绝望中搏得一线生机。

name: My Furry Maid
summary:
Welcome home, master! Would you like tea, coffee, or perhaps a hot maid for dinner? Oh, wait, it seems we’ve run out of tea and coffee, so...

Okay, to be fair—we don’t have a real maid here, but we do have a hot actress who wants to play one! And since she’s wearing a maid costume, who cares?

My Furry Maid is a kinetic novel about a guy who works as a teacher in a housekeeping school and his new student, Anna. She wants to study maid classes for a role in a TV show, so he’ll have to teach her etiquette, housekeeping, and cooking for an entire week. How long will it be before she falls in love with him? Let’s find out!

(As usual in the "My Furry" series, expect a touch of drama, serious topics, and slice-of-life moments.)

Features:

About 1.5 hours of content

An exciting story

HD, fully original artwork

A cute cat maid!

“你想救谁？或者说，你准备抛下谁？” 午夜的撤回键将她们困在时间的夹缝，也唤醒了本该死去的“你”。 化身寄宿于屏幕与监控后的“幽灵”，隔着手机给出指令、窥探她们的秘密。 选择、解谜、救人……然后抛下其中一个——亦或者将她们全部留在这座监牢。

1.拟真手机界面x叙事解谜|

本该死去的“你”被生前的好友唤醒，现在的你们被困在由生前记忆和混乱的数据所构成的异空间内。
“你”的选择将决定命运。

2.现实时间同步|

“你"的时间，决定了她们的黑夜与白昼。

时间将成为逃脱的关键。

3.多结局分支|

在这里有无限的可能性，但“你”救不了所有人。

除非……

23:61-三角的悖论

当时间停留于不存在的刻度——
本该死去的“你”被唤醒，作为唯一的观测者手握她们的生杀予夺。

这是无尽的“轮回”，抑是无解的“悖论”。
当两人同时向你伸出手时……
你不仅要决定谁能够活下来，还要决定谁将被遗忘。

保持连接，不要让信号中断。
你的每一次“退出”，都会让她们的时间陷入崩坏。

Save and Delete...or IMPRISON？

明明不可能救所有人的……你还是想继续吗？

……

那我，就再相信你一次。

name: KickNSlap
summary:
Come Kick And Slap Your Way To The Top!

KickNSlap: Ultimate Knockout flings hordes of contestants together online in a wild slap through round after round of escalating chaos until one victor remains! Battle bizarre people, shove through unruly competitors, and overcome the unbending laws of physics as you stumble towards greatness. Leave your dignity at the door and prepare for hilarious failure in your quest to claim the Win!

name: Dreaming Worlds
summary:
Dive into the dreaming worlds of the four dream keepers and find out why they don't answer anymore. Rescue the trapped inhabitants of the dream worlds, change the dreams back to good and discover mysterious places and puzzles. But something dark will stand in your way.

In Dreaming Worlds you play as the red panda Rin and rescue the other Dream Wardens from a mysterious nightmare that has thrown the dream worlds out of balance and turned their inhabitants to stone...or worse!

In order to do this, you must enter and explore the dream worlds of the other Guardians. There you will be faced with tricky puzzles, you have to overcome gorges and cross deserts.

But you are not completely on your own. Although the other Dream Wardens have been mysteriously trapped, you can use some of their special abilities yourself to overcome the obstacles in your journey.

从生命到死亡，我们的细胞面对无数的战斗，消灭数千入侵的病毒和细菌。踏上这段不可思议的旅程，解锁新的细胞、药物和纳米技术，强化自己，迎接生命中最伟大的冒险！

name: Alone: Shattered Tribes
summary:
An isometric survival RPG without the survival. Collect resources and craft items and weapons. Build a settlement on your island. Hunt in the darkest forests, or slay the undead in the cursed crypts. Explore the islands, unite the shattered tribes, and become a Jarl worthy of the sagas.

Having fled the destruction of his people, and shipwrecked on an island, our hero must rebuild, survive, and thrive.

Alone: Shattered Tribes is an isometric survival RPG without the survival, eschewing certain challenging features in favor of a more relaxing experience. Collect resources and use them to craft items and weapons. Build and upgrade your settlement on a rich and fertile island. And hunt in the darkest forests, and slay the undead in the cursed crypts. 

Explore the islands, defeat the goblin foe, unite the tribes, and become a Jarl worthy of the sagas 

Follow the your destiny...

Follow a quest-driven storyline following your character's journey that starts with a shipwreck, and their attempts to survive, unite the tribes, and save their people.

Survive, Thrive, and Rebuild

Harvest resources on a procedurally generated island. Catch fish, fell trees, forage for food, and mine for metals and stone. Build farms to ensure a steady supply of food and raw materials, and attract traders to give you access to exotic goods. Improve your buildings with powerful upgrades, and build furniture and decorate them how you please.

Hunt

Or look to what lies underneath the ground in your own island, a wealth of ores protected by sinister foes.

name: Girls' civilization 3
summary:
Open world survival RPG with unique lore and story.

This is a survival game, but you won’t feel lonely.
People live in the town, and there is a story and a quest.

This is the next-generation inventory.
Icons are no longer necessary. You can get and organize objects that actually exist.

Permanent death
You will need to go to dangerous locations to get resources.
You can lose your life to predatory creatures, bandits, or harsh weather conditions.
There is no option to set difficulty levels, but it is recommended that beginners choose the beast man species.

Combat
NPC can fight with the same competence as players.
It is nearly impossible to win by risking your life against a large number of enemies even in one-on-one combat.

Ancient weapons
If you have a machine gun, you can annihilate an entire army. The problem is that bullets are worth more than human lives.
It is usually better to use close combat weapons rather than bullets. 
But in an instant of crisis, it may only be machine guns and bombs that will save you.

Story mode
In this mode, you follow the main quest of 51000 Japanese letters amount.
It is not a simple quest. It develops from a unique world and this makes what follows unpredictable.
Tutorials appear naturally in the story, and it is recommended you use this mode once when first playing the game.
All of the lines are recorded in Japanese.
Fast travel is a specialized function of story mode. It cannot be used in survival mode.

name: Drift Type C
summary:
A multi-discipline real-physics driving game where the ghosts are actual ghosts. Drive 50+ real spec cars right from the factory on 100+ miles of track to free the God of Time. Master Drift, Time Attack, Off-road, Rally, and even a few head to head races against bad AI. Robust Creative Mode.

No air control.
No Nitrous.
No Brake Assist.
No Nonsense.

Drift Type C is a Real Physics Driving Game. Drive 50+ real spec cars right from the factory, with exact specifications and a detailed handling model accounting for everything from power to weight to differential setup to factory tire compound and alignment settings.

Oh, side note. You’ll be using these uncompromised sim cars to visit the Time Realm and meet the God of Time, who needs your help. Defeat 13 Warriors and 13 Ghosts to free Him.
Do Lots of Stuff
Off-roading. Multi-stage rally races. Dorifuto Batadu. Drive on trays. Flagging. Deliver tofu. DIY Space Gymkhana. Text while driving. Drive a bus for some reason. Drive in daytime or night through assorted weather conditions. Visit nine biomes and an alternate Realm with different air density affecting aerodynamics. And so many jumps!
Big world. Really big.
Drift Type C is a curated experience in an infinite, hybrid-procedurally generated world. That means the 100+ miles of road were hand-built for the best driving experience. The cities were all built in-game and events all developed for the best gameplay. Yet, you could travel thousands of miles through beautiful terrain in any direction before….. Actually I don’t know what happens when you go too far.
Drifting Games: The Problem
Behold the HYPERVESICLE, a gift from the God of Time. Drifting is generally slower compared to other driving styles, so to get the best time, you couldn’t drift… which is boring. Points-based systems are too complicated in some ways, too simple in others, and always too easy to exploit. name: Grimhunt
summary:
Paranormal investigation game.The Grimoire hides many secrets and information precious to arcane investigators.Search for magical creatures, rare animals and the hidden world in this simulation game.

Paranormal investigation game.
The Grimoire hides many secrets and information precious to arcane investigators.
Search for magical creatures, rare animals and the hidden world in this simulation game.

Have you ever wondered what lurks in the forest? In addition to birds and rabbits, what really hides.
What if I told you the legends are true. All that told through generations really exists and today with this Grimoire you will be able to find them.
Join the Guild of Arcane Investigators, experts in mystical creatures and the occult, delve into the forest for clues and information and find out what we're up to.

Dragons, fairies and werewolves, any of them could be behind the bush, choose the right equipment and find out fast what you are hunting or the prey could be you.

Magic Crystals, Lanterns and Compasses, the guild will provide everything you need, but of course it comes at a price, bring scales, fur and other evidence they cost a lot in the arcane market.
The equipment is extremely useful in your hunts.

To find out which creature is in the region you must be very attentive to the clues left by it, a tuft of fur, claw marks, footprints and several other clues will guide you to success.

Observing the clues left by the creature it is possible to discover its species.
A noise, a claw mark, a footprint, all of these are crucial when it comes to investigating, stick to the details, observe with extreme care, note the evidence, and rush to take action.

Why Early Access?

The game is already at an advanced stage of development but there are still important choices to be made, we hope to build an active community that helps make these decisions, suggestions and ideas are very welcome and will be taken seriously.

name: Soul of Kaeru
summary:
Soul of Kaeru is a Metroidvania-inspired VR game! Explore each corners of a miniature world set in an ancient samurai's zen garden where nature took back his right! But beware of the little creatures and insects, as they may not be as friendly as you would think...

Note: The game is in the prototyping stage. Please note that most of the content you see at this date doesn't reflect the final game and will be subject to many changes.

An epic Japanese tale awaits!

Follow a frog and masterless Samurai -or Ronin- along his journey through a colorful yet dark japanned-themed miniature world. Throughout an ancient samurai's abandoned garden, lush forests, or deep mysterious caves, our Ronin will encounter a whole collection of characters, each more colorful than the last! 

Soul of Kaeru is a 3D Metroidvania-inspired VR game that mixes realms: reality versus dreams, surface versus underground. All wrapped up in a cryptic yet comedic tale.

Game Features

An epic story where reality is not what it seems... Help your hero unravel what lies deep in his own mind before vanquishing evil!

Explore a vast and colorful yet dark semi-open world filled with creatures of all sorts, from the small critter to the giant fantastical beasts. Progress through a miniature interpretation of a feudal Japan filled with luscious backgrounds and interconnected caves. 

Find a wide range of embryos that will grant you powerful new skills and abilities to fight foes, reach new areas, and progress through your adventure.

Experiment with VR interactions through first-person cameras during puzzle moments and control your hero in third-person. Put aside your motion sickness as most of the game plays with fixed cameras. Just sick back, relax but fight!

summary:
The Idle Undead is an Idle Clicker game set in a Zombie Apocalypse - Upgrade a base, recruit survivors, play minigames to boost your damage!

Overview

The Idle Undead is an Idle Clicker game set in a Zombie Apocalypse!

Click to defeat enemies, get loot and cash and spend it to upgrade your base and recruit survivors to help you in your survival.

Gameplay

The Idle Undead is a clicker game where you recruit survivors and purchase various upgrades to progress, You start by clicking on the screen to earn points, that you spend to recruit fellow survivors to defeat the enemies around you! 

Enemies drop various rewards, such as XP and Resources you put towards levelling up to unlock new areas and upgrades, with more advanced features unlocking the further you progress. 

Minigames - Play fun small minigames to give a boost to your damage and defeat the zombies faster!

Recruit Survivors - You can level up your base with various upgrades to help you in-game! 

Cards - Open crates dropped after bosses to earn cards, These cards provide an effect when used and are then destroyed, You can strategize when to use these to help you in difficult situations 

Unlock Skills - Progress through the game and unlock Skills to help you fight back, Unlock cool mechanics to make the Idle gameplay more fun as you play!

Story

The game is set several years after the outbreak of a virus that transforms the population into mutated zombie-like creatures, Originating amongst the wealthy who spread the virus slowly down to the common population, it's true origin is unknown, but the mutated creatures show plant like roots within them.

Find newspapers and additional lore as you progress in game to get the full story!

name: Fast Food On The Beach!

和朋友一起翻新位于法国阿卡雄海滩的快餐店，并将其打造成知名餐厅！合作、烹饪、服务，追求成功！

name: Cricket Captain 2022

With new separate aggression ratings for all players for First Class and Limited Over match types, white ball cricket has never been as dynamic.

Cricket Captain 2022 features all domestic system changes, and a database update, including new international home and away player stats.

 One Day and 20 Over New Ball: reduced new ball and swing impact in limited over.

Spy out the RatKing’s secrets with a falcon’s super skills in this action-packed hometown hero adventure!

Transform into a high-flying hero with the ancient temple, the biochemical bath, the glowing meteorite, or the mysterious heirloom! Soar, smash and stealth your way to safety for your citizens. Will you crackdown on crime, or negotiate for peace? Collaborate with authority, or make your own rules? 
Skystrike: Wings of Justice is a 313,000 word interactive novel by E. Chris Ambrose. It's entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

The charming and insidious RatKing recruits a growing swarm of minions, intimidating law enforcement and threatening City Hall. Risk your secret identity to stop them from destroying your town and spreading the RatKing’s malicious love across the world. Dodge government agents and battle the RatKing’s ranks, from the creepy museum, to the mansion on the hill!

 Play as male, female, or non-binary; gay, straight, bi, or asexual/aromantic.

summary:

Panzer Arena: Prologue is an experimental tank PvP game. Boost, drift and flip your way through any kind of terrain in order to destroy your opponents. Use several types of abilities and weapons and compete in multiple game modes.
Movement
You control a nimble little tanks that can jump, dash and do all kinds of flips. No terrain is too difficult to conquer and no opponent can escape if you master the movement in Panzer Arena.
Combat
Currently you have the choice of 4 weapons and a few abilities. You can dash, use a dome, stealth or use an impulse dart that can propel you to even bigger heights. Tanks have the thickest armor up front so you can't just spam your shots, you need to calculate every move and wait for the right moment to strike in the rear of your opponent.
Style
Switch up your style based on the situation. Is your opponent aggressive? Use a shotgun. Is your opponent shy? Use the charge rifle! Or perhaps it's best to just freestyle and be creative. The invisible skybox is your limit!
Game Modes
Currently you can play Free for All, Team Deathmatch and Duels. The first two are self-explanatory but the Duels mode needs some explanation. Imagine you've invited your friends over to play video-games but there's only 2 controllers. What do you? Well you play winner stays on. Two players go head to head while the other watch (or taunt) and wait their turn. Winner stays on, loser gets put in the back of the queue.
Experimental
Please note that this project is highly experimental. I'm developing this on my own so don't expect a ton of updates or content drops. Your feedback is very much appreciated!

summary:
Oyster VR is a first-person and virtual reality exploration based learning game about oyster reef restoration at the bottom of the Hudson River in New York and New Jersey.

Oyster VR is a first-person and virtual reality exploration based learning game about oyster reef restoration at the bottom of the Hudson River in New York and New Jersey. The game was produced by professors, designer, developers, students and subject matter experts from Parsons School of Design NYC, The NYC Media Lab, and the NY/NJ Baykeeper.

Experience the Trash Museum and learn how pollution affects marine life, then enter the bathysphere and sink down into the Hudson River. You are then an underwater explorer who helps clean up the trash you see and build the beginning of an oyster reef.

Swim through and explore The Hudson River Bottom. Watch fish swim by and experience the cleaner water when the oyster reef grows over time. One oyster can filter 50 gallons of polluted water a day! We can help them by picking trash up and throwing it into trashcans. Then we can set oyster cages and gather oysters in cages to encourage other oysters to attach themselves and build a natural reef barrier for cities like New York and Jersey City.
KEY FEATURES

Immersive Gameplay: Trash items from dumped glass, plastic, and construction materials are on display and tell us why they are harmful to marine life. Take a ride in the bathysphere when you sink to The Hudson River bottom. You can pick up trash and set oyster cages as fish swim by. You can have a realistic experience of being under water without scuba gear.

Realistic Graphics: Clean and clear experience in the Trash museum, The Hudson River with fish for a full under water VR experience.

name: ヘキサムーン・ガーディアンズ
summary:

プレイヤーは轟堂大地となり、伝説の守護神「ガーディアン」の復活を求めて地球に降り立った６人の「ヘキサムーン・プリンセス」とともに、「クロスロード鉄鋼兵団」と対決していく。学園生活を送りながら心の交流を深めていく「AVGパート」と、迫り来る敵と戦う「SLGパート」の2つで構成されている。ガーディアンの力を発揮させるため轟堂大地とプリンセス、互いの心の強さが必要となる。

name: Locks
summary:
Locks 是一款恐怖解谜平台游戏，以木偶戏为背景。游戏拥有全新的解谜方式和恐怖元素。您是观众、玩家还是猎物？

主要特色：

背景设定: 

融合两种恐怖风格。

解谜机制新颖，包含旋转和缩放场景或单个装饰元素。

背景音乐配合游戏行动，营造阴森童话氛围。

游戏试图营造的恐惧感不是来自于木偶，而是针对你，观众。

游戏玩法:

游戏不会手把手教学，而是通过不断提升难度来考验你的解谜能力。你需要在每个房间重新分析游戏逻辑。

头目战：你需要通过解谜战胜轮椅、管道等各种 boss，比如会攻击的巨大嘴巴。

解谜是游戏的核心。你可以移动、旋转场景或单个装饰元素，比如：

将带图案的梯子移到你面前，爬上去，然后再次升起梯子，获取钥匙。

缩放整个场景，缩小后跳上高台，然后放大场景，通过狭窄的门。

恐怖元素:

游戏的叙事风格随着剧情发展而变化，从蒂姆·伯顿式的童话风格转变为伊藤润二式的恐怖风格。这就像你和两位大师合作制作了一部恐怖动画电影。

玩偶师就像所有艺术家一样，依赖观众的反应，因此他会密切关注你的反应。他非常喜欢玩弄你，会对你做鬼脸，开一些恶作剧，比如在你耳边放一只蟑螂，或者为了取乐毁掉舞台。

你需要忍受玩偶师的频繁出现。但不要忘了舞台上的装饰，它们也长着眼睛。

音乐:

游戏中的每一个动作，甚至每一步，都伴随着古典乐器的演奏。大部分都是阴森童话风格的音乐，与蒂姆·伯顿的作品类似。 在真正的恐怖场景中，音乐会变得混乱，比如用萨克斯风演奏失控的旋律。

name: Lorsvale
summary:
Lorsvale is a open world fantasy rpg, where four factions battle for dominance. As a new arrival you can recruit allies, form alliances, and defeat foes as you shape the future of the Lorsvale.

In Lorsvale, four factions compete for dominance. As a new arrival you can build alliances and make enemies of a variety of factions. Find strong allies and equipment for your warband, build your numbers and alliances, and set out to conquer dungeons and engage in open world skirmishes with other roving bands of foes. With a team of capable fighters at your side you can shape the future of the Lorsvale, through real-time action combat, questing for reputation or riches, and finding unique and disparate companions, there's many ways this story can end, and they will all be down to your choices.

name: WestFallen

Please Read the Early Access Blurb Before Buying!
The game is currently only a single player arena wave mode.
Enter the world of WestFallen
You are a nobody, destined to grow up and die a nobody. One fateful day, you are thrust into the midst of a war, watching on as your small village is invaded and the people you care about killed in front of you. Narrowly escaping, you set forth on a path of vengeance and destruction.
A kingdom at war
WestFallen, a kingdom in the heart of the continent, is a land full of promise, potential, and beautiful landscapes. The son of the king has taken his rightful place on the throne after his father stepped aside and has gone missing, leaving the kingdom in turmoil and uncertainty. Will this new king rule justly like his father, or will he put his own personal interests ahead of the kingdom? This uncertainty is what gave the neighboring kingdom of Lightgrave license to declare war, before the new king could meet with his generals and come to grips with the responsibility of defending the kingdom.

The son of a local foreman, you watch helplessly as the Lightgrave murder your friends and family, burning your village to the ground, in a surprise attack marking the start of a brutal war. 

Left without home, family, friends, or any real purpose, you look to join the war to take revenge on those who robbed you of your life.

However, not all is as it seems... With all of the death and destruction being caused, an ancient looks to gather it's strength to take advantage of the war.
Features
Compelling Open World: 
From the foothills of the mountains, to the glistening buildings of the capital, explore a beautiful open world where around every corner is a new fight, frien

name: Slava Ukraini!
summary:
A completely free game of heroic defence against enemy aggression. Take part in the defence of Ukraine against Russian aggression. A tribute to the courage and valor of the Ukrainian armed forces.

This is a game. Or rather, it is a tribute to the courage of the people and armed forces of Ukraine.

In Slava Ukraini!, the goal is to defend Ukraine from the Russian invasion. You will do this by chosing which battles to fight in order to delay the invasion while receiving support from friendly nations around the world. Over time, you will be given access to more weapons and equipment, while the enemy resolve is weakened by international sanctions and battlefield casualties. The game features a strategic mode and a few different tactical modes, where the strategic mode is played on a full map of Ukraine while the tactical modes (or "battles") are played in first person, each "battle" lasting only a few minutes.

At release time, the "battle" scenes of the game will be mainly about ambusing enemy columns and defending fixed positions. These battles are all played in static first person mode. The plan, however, is to keep developing the game, adding features and improving gameplay for as long as needed. More on what's being considered will follow.

Slava Ukraini! is completely free-to-play and contains no commercial ads. However, if you would like to support the Ukrainian armed forces, place a donation to the special fund set up by the National Bank of Ukraine.
On the future of Slava Ukraini!
The initial release of the game will contain mainly very short battles in static first person perspective, meaning that it's like an FPS but the player cannot move, always fighting from a stationary position. This is somewhat adequate for the ambush- and air-defence missions that will be in the initial release.

There are plans to add additional gaming modes, including armoured warfare gunnery and more complete FPS features. Some thought is going into adding political features and ad

name: HACKERGAME
summary:
HACKERGAME is a 2D terminal-based arcade hacking game and is currently in the early days of development.

HACKERGAME is a 2D terminal-based arcade hacking game currently in development. There are not many details to uncover for now but we still got some info:

Graphics
General UI is inspired by the Kali Linux and in the HACKERGAME universe, it's called Strap OS. It overall looks like the Kali.

Gameplay
You will mostly be using your terminal to hack into your targets. There is a web browser to access the surface web and an onion browser for the dark web. Throughout the game, you will encounter various hacker forums both on the surface web and the dark web. You will receive your tasks through these sites, and from time to time, story progress will again take place through these sites.

Story
The story is about you, the player, attacking corporations, taking down websites, stealing valuable data and much much more. With each attack, you push boundaries, chase conspiracies, make friends and enemies, and, of course, break almost every computer-related law along the way. Though there are not only malicious people in the world. While the cyberwar carries on, the network intelligence agencies over the world investigate the attacks. When experiencing the story, you will both encounter and interact with these sides, hacker groups and the intelligence agencies.

Keep in mind that these are still work-in-progress ideas and developments. Anything is subject to change, for good.

name: Planetary Planter
summary:
Planetary Planter is an open-world farming game where, instead of farming normal plants, you grow celestial bodies while exploring an alien world.

Planetary Planter is a single-player, open-world, third-person farming game where, instead of farming normal vegetables, you grow celestial bodies while exploring an alien world. You explore the alien world using exploration tools to find seeds and modifiers scattered throughout the environments. After planting and growing planets and stars you can harvest them. Once the planets and stars are harvested, the player can arrange them into solar systems, and arrange those solar systems into constellations. Players completing these constellations results in them receiving new exploration tools to help them explore as well as getting more of the story unlocked to read.

Planetary Planter has 10 constellations the player can fill out! Collect 5 unique celestial bodies and 6 modifiers. That totals 35 unique celestial bodies! Watch out for the Squimbus! This dubious little creature will steal your items! This game is perfect to sit back and relax with because there is no way to die! The art and music were made to make the game as relaxing as possible with cute creatures and relaxing music!

name: Catastrophe

Slaughter the horde of goblins that's become the city's new inhabitants.

Avoid the dangerous traps that have been set up to stop unwanted visitors.

Wander through the darkness to find the secrets this ancient city has to offer.

summary:
The Questing is an action-RPG game set in the fantasy world. You can grow by hunting enemies using various weapons and skills that you like. Also, feel free to explore the wide world, discover new towns and cities, and take quests from NPCs around the world to solve them.

The Questing Early Access released!

The Questing is a single-play action 3D RPG game set in the fantasy worldview.
Sweep away enemies with a variety of weapons, skills and magic based on Hack & Slash and Roguelite.

Explore a wide and beautiful map. Explore towns and cities and solve various NPC quests.
A good reward awaits you if you solve the quest.

Customize your character as you want. Create your own character by combining hair, whiskers, eyebrows, face tattoos and colors.

Use various weapons to hunt enemies!
Weapons are largely divided into close-range weapons and long-range weapons. Close weapons include one-handed weapons, two-handed weapons, double-handed weapons, and extra-large swords, while distant weapons have bows!
Each weapon has its own motion and special skills!

Use various magic and skills to wipe out enemies!
You can use supportive magic to buff or recover during combat, and use offensive magic to wipe out enemies!

And also
Additional updates are waiting. More towns and cities, NPCs, peer systems, ride systems such as horses, crafting systems and player-only shops will be added during the early access period.

name: Tale of Witch's Heart

When Chaos came, He brought us two blessings. One is your heart. A Witch's Heart. How will you respond to His kindness? Will you carry His will and slay Demons roaming this world, or shall you rebel and abandon your destined path? Will you carry this burden and face lurking threats?

When Chaos came,

He brought us two blessings. One is your heart. A Witch's Heart. 

How will you respond to His kindness?
Will you carry His will and slay Demons roaming this world, or shall you rebel and abandon your destined path?
Will you carry the burden of Witch's Heart and face lurking threats and solve thousand years old problem in this world?
Top Down Boss Rush
Tale of Witch's Heart is fast peaced action combat game. You will be facing lot of different Enemies and Bosses in huge semi-open hand drawn pixelart world filled with secrets, NPCs and enemies to slain!
Fight however you like
In this game you can choose between different weapons and skills to create build that suits you best. Here skill and knowledge of your weapon is everything that matters!
Uncover secrets
You will meet many NPC with their own goals. Use them to find about world and story of this land or your own destiny. You can decide to work with them or not. They will help you or try to use you for their own purposes. Its up to you whom to trust.
Freedom of actions
You can go almost everywhere you want, you can go straight to final boss if you wish so. You can complete NPCs quest or stab them in the back. You are the only one person that can change and save or destroy this world.

name: Go To Heck

Go To Heck is a fast-paced 2d sidescrolling action roguelite, descending through Cyberheck and destroying all the devils in your way. Use your railgun to fly through levels, build your rage, dodge attacks, and defeat enemies and bosses with speed and accuracy. Go To Heck features short runs and minimal meta-progression, allowing you to pick up the game at any time and test your mettle. 

Go To Heck is packed with variety: 3 playable classes, over 25 enemies, and over 50 items. Construct your build over the course of a 10 minute run!

We're in early access at the moment, but there's only more content and more systems on their way. Look forward to a game with faced paced moment-to-moment action alongside strategic depth.

name: Shell Soldier
summary:
" Shell Soldier " is a high‑octane first‑person shooter set in a bleak dystopian future. Featuring frenetic firefights against a diverse range of enemy combatants, each employing unique tactics and weaponry, and offering a wide arsenal of lethal tools at your disposal.

Shell Soldier is a high‑intensity, first‑person shooter set in a grim dystopian future. Expect fast-paced firefights against a variety of enemy combatants, each employing unique tactics and weaponry. With a broad and lethal arsenal at your disposal, every encounter challenges you to adapt quickly and survive.

Story

Shell Soldier unfolds in a dystopian future where Armatac, 

a powerful security conglomerate, has seized control of the nation, 

imposing martial law under the guise of ensuring safety and order.

Our protagonist, Subject 89, awakens in an unfamiliar hospital with no recollection 

of their identity or origins. As confusion sets in, he discovers that he is being held 

captive by Armatac. Seizing a fleeting opportunity, Subject 89 escapes with the 

aid of a local resistance group led by the determined Sven.

Together, they battle through Armatac's forces,

seeking answers to why Subject 89 was imprisoned 

and uncovering Armatac's true nefarious intentions.

The game features

1.Chaotic gunfights: Engage in frenetic firefights that would give an action‑movie fan a run for their money.

2.An engaging story: At the beginning, you’re determined to uncover why the shadowy organization ‘Armatac’ has captured you, what sinister plans they're hiding, and the origins of your unnatural powers, but the closer you get to the truth, the greater the danger becomes.

3.Immersive graphics and sounds: Every visual and auditory element of this game is engineered to give players a visceral experience—intense firefights crackling with energy, alongside a chilling dystopian ambience that seeps into every frame and sound.

summary:
史诗主题的中世纪RPG游戏。在你的部队和忠诚的同伴的帮助下击溃敌人。冲入敌阵并使用最佳策略击败敌人并保卫自己的阵地。思考战术、精彩的作战、盾墙、执行、陷阱等等。生存并升级。

name: BIPT
summary:
BIPT is a single player time attack game with multiple endings. Figure out what to collect, and go for the best time! Bipt can slide, super jump, and teleport. Combine these tools and find the fastest path to the finish.

Bipt is a single player time attack game. Collect stars and make your way to the finish line. Run the Gauntlet and try to get the fastest time. Your final score is the total time spent in all levels combined with whichever collectables were gathered.

Is this game going to revolutionize platforming? no

Are there hundreds of hours of late-game content? also no

Is it any fun? Well, I had fun making it

Features

5 platforming levels to race through

Super-jump by crouching first

Slide through the finish line for a style bonus

A short range teleport so you can go right through those hazards

Choose your own colors!

You can beat the game in like, less than two minutes, really.

Here's a pre-emptive "Thank You!" in case you decide to give it a try.

name: Tracing Decay

Tracing Decay is a dark dystopian simulation, that revisits impactful art that revolves around themes of decay, memory loss and recollection. The experience allows the player to explore the environment freely in search for several galleries within the ruins.

Tracing Decay is an online art museum with multiple galleries featuring artworks from the selected world renown artists:

Barbara Graf 's Anatomical Bodies 

Huda Lutfi's Dreams

ThanksTaking is a game where you play as an angry turkey, looking for revenge on thanksgiving night.... You have been taken home to be cooked for thanksgiving, and you have to make sure not to let that happen by killing anyone in your way! You need to explore the house and find keys to open the front door and escape before you get cooked. 

Use a variety of attacks and moves to defend yourself in combat.. You can hide under and behind obstacles to not get noticed by people, however dogs can still smell you if you are hidden. You must complete the level before vicious dogs are released onto you.

name: Road Defense: Outsiders
summary:
保护道路上的战车，让他们生存下去！道路防御：外来人是一款结合了 roguelike （一类游戏的统称）和 塔防类型的游戏。升级塔楼和你自己的技能，以便能够歼灭你周围的所有敌人!

让你的敌人见识真正的子弹地狱!

在游戏过程中，每当司机到达道路的尽头，他就需要支付一笔费用，可能这并不完全合理，但收到的钱为塔楼购买新武器或升级拥有的武器。

司机收到的钱并不能解决你所有的问题，如果仅仅依靠它，那你很快会被淘汰。出于这个原因，每杀死一个敌人都可以释放一个能量，提高你的经验值。每当这个经验值填满时，等级就会提高，可以短暂提高技能。所以在一个波段中杀的敌人越多，收集的能量就越多，你就越强大。

并非一切都能进展地十分顺利，难免你也会被这些敌人击杀。当发生这样情况时，不要绝望，因为你在比赛中杀死的敌人总数也可以转化为金钱！在这个时候，你之前杀的敌人的数量非常多，那么你可以永久地提升技能，在下一场比赛中开始更强大，更有优势。

name: She is mad
summary:
这是一款关于未知圣经世界的古怪恐怖游戏。

在使用黑魔法拯救我们的女儿后，事情发生了翻天覆地的变化。我的女儿不见了，我的妻子变成了一个恶魔。天使、恶魔和异教徒——我该相信谁？冒险进入未知的世界，我不禁想知道：为什么我放屁时她仍然会生气（好吧，更生气了，因为她现在似乎总是生气）？等等，她还记得我是谁吗？噢！

我不知道他们想干什么。为什么他们带着我需要的东西出现，却又把它们拿走？我最好不要背叛他们。我认为我不能相信他们。

我以前见过我的妻子这样做，她走了之后，我想我应该继续做下去。我甚至不确定这些盒子是给谁的，也不知道是谁把它们留在外面的。

所以，恶魔在帮助我？我以为他们是坏人。好吧，他笑得很灿烂，所以我现在不应该问这个问题。

这些德鲁伊魔法就像魔法一样有效。我不敢相信天使在帮助我。但是，他似乎在嘟囔一些奇怪的东西。我觉得我不应该离他太近。

我觉得那只兔子把我带到了不该去的地方。好吧，我的意思是我不应该在这里，就像，就在这里。

为什么一个骷髅在充满骨头的血水下侍奉天使？他是天使吗？还是恶魔？他是谁？

好吧，看起来有些天使和恶魔仍然相处不融洽，因为我的恶魔妻子正在追逐一个仙女。

欢迎来到 She is mad 的世界。在这里，你会在自然栖息地遇见天使和恶魔。有时也会遇见异教徒或神，但有时他们并没有真正给自己起名字。他们说时间太久了，他们忘记了自己是谁或来自哪里。

特点：

正常、噩梦、地狱模式

随着你的进步，妻子皮肤解锁

你可以放屁（这是必要的或危及生命的）

给别人留下爱的讯息或点赞

不断增长的章节

你有能力拯救这个家庭吗？

name: Slimesventure: Your Destination
summary:
Slimesventure is a strategy building game where you have to play against the time. Integrate yourself into a new life, take revenge on your enemies and get back what has been stolen from you. The value that was stolen from you is immense and would have changed your whole life, if you had known about

Slimesventure: Your Destination is a single-player strategy building and adventure game. You can build your own kingdom, gather the resources you need and process them yourself. If the buildings in your own kingdom don't produce enough, you can upgrade them!

But before you can build your own kingdom, you need to build a foundation. Make friends with the inhabitants of the neutral town, complete their quests to earn money for a place to sleep, and buy or sell items from various merchants.

But keep an eye on the clock, because you won't be able to live unscathed forever - after all, you're apparently a 'criminal'. You only have 100 days, by which time you must be stronger than the enemy. So plan carefully how you travel, trade and build.

It was a normal morning when a strong gust of wind blew open the window and a letter from your mother flew in. It was barely legible, half burnt, but you could make out some key points. It said that you should make your way to the king, your brother.

You entered the great hall and spoke to your brother, but he did not recognise you, did not consider you his brother, and was angry at your unfriendly way of just walking in. You are chased from your home, but catch a train to the Neutral City.

Once there, you discover that you have lost your identity card and that you have no proof of identity. You go to the local authority to apply for a new one. [...]

What happened!?

After the First World War, Eastern Europe has fallen into chaos... Bugs are eating all the crops, spreading diseases, and bandits are everywhere... There is no government to bring peace to the region which means cities must survive by themselves...

Inspect boats!

When a boat arrives in your port, you must inspect it before unloading or refusing it. You must verify the report by looking at the boat and comparing it to the report. If you correctly verify the report you will get some rewards. But if you don't pay attention enough attention to the infection, you will have problems with bugs that will eat some of your resources!

Manage your port!

You start with a very basic port, but this port will not be enough to survive in this post-WWI world. You must quickly develop your infrastructure if you want to last (and the city to survive). Construct new buildings, upgrade the ones you already have, or research new technologies! You can also hire employees to increase your building’s efficiency, but they will ask for a daily income. And don't forget to send some resources to the city, otherwise your citizens will die!

The world will not be kind!

You will need to be ready for all sorts of events that could happen in your port! One bad shipment could spell your doom! Prepare yourself for hard times, winter will be harsh!

name: 回渊迷城
summary:
《回渊迷城》是一款策略类 rogue-lite 游戏，玩家需要在有限的时间中，透过组合不同的遗物和技能培育队伍，挑战强大而狡猾的怪物。在地下城最深处中等待冒险者的会是稀绝的宝藏，还是另一个绝望的开端......？

《回渊迷城》是一款在回合制策略游戏的基础上，添加Rouge-lite要素的，极具挑战性的游戏。你作为冒险家循着宝藏而来，召集队友、制定策略、一步步深入神秘而危险的地下世界。有限的时间不断紧逼，你需要在冒险中谨慎做出选择。而通过探索得到的技能石、遗物相互搭配组合，将形成你特色鲜明的战斗风格。只有打败怪物的强者，才能抵达地下城的最深处。
分开探索或是结伴前行

探索时每一位角色都是独立行动的个体，而相邻的角色才能并肩作战。结伴同行可以减少战斗的消耗与风险，分头行动则更有利于在有限的回合内对地图进行探索。其中的利弊取舍，需要仔细斟酌。
深入复杂交错的地下城

在这个不断随机生成的地下世界，怪物和事件的位置会让你面对不同情况的抉择，将成为冒险的危机与转机！
由牺牲堆砌而成的殊死战斗

在地下城中你会发现前人的遗物和技能，他们的未竟之志会让你组合出千变万化的战斗策略。在考虑两者搭配的同时，你亦需要适时利用「爆发」进行迅速而华丽的攻击，歼灭所有挡路的敌人！
故事简介

在国与国之间的中央海域，突然出现了一座漆黑的城堡。学者考证发现城堡是古籍记载中应被永恒封印的远古王朝。各国纷纷派遣军队调查，发现寂静无人的死城底下是一座深不可测的地下城，地城中居住着大量魔物，并藏有大量水晶石及宝藏。
游戏内容

四名角色，拥有独特的特色
140 多款不同效果的遗物
60 多种主动技能
40 款不同敌人
10 多个神秘事件
20 多个游戏升级
5 个生态区域

即使在民间流传着关于地城那难以置信的深度及可怕的魔物，仍然有大量的强者被力量和财宝所吸引，前往这座充满未知的地下城......

name: Hunteroids
summary:
我们的城市正受到陨石的攻击，而你是唯一能保护我们的人！ 然而，你的武器只能摧毁一种类型的陨石... 在天空中创造泡泡，将它们全部转化，直到在爆炸前拥有正确的形状、颜色和旋转！

我们的城市正在遭受攻击！成百上千的流星从太空飞来，要摧毁我们！我们的先进武器可以让它们消失，但由于我们脆弱的腿，我们无法使用它！幸运的是，你在这里来帮助我们！

然而... 你只能猎捕 一种类型的流星，其具有特定的 形状，颜色和旋转...

别担心！在天空中 创建气泡，将所有的流星变成武器给出的 模式，然后捕捉它们！ 改变形状，颜色和旋转，拯救城市！

基本机制 在下面的图片中显示。

流星将从天空降临，摧毁城市。你的目标是 创建气泡来改变它们，使其与武器给出的模式相符。

有3种类型的气泡：

 红色气泡：改变流星的 形状（正方形，圆形，三角形）。

 蓝色气泡：改变流星的 颜色（绿色，粉色，蓝色）。

 黄色气泡：改变流星的 旋转。

记住！气泡越大，流星经历的转变就越多！

战役

你是保护我们城市免受流星袭击的被选者！每个城市有 5 个关卡（波次）。城市能否幸存？一切都取决于你！

每个城市都会带来新的机制！

 可用城市的数量 取决于你拥有的游戏版本。更多信息请参见“版本”部分。

对于某些城市，如果你获得了 3 颗星，你将获得一个 成就。

对于某些城市，如果你拯救了它们，你将解锁 新的挑战。

如果你拯救了前3个城市，你将解锁 生存模式。

在线排名：与其他玩家竞争，成为名人墙的一部分！

挑战

不同类型的 挑战：生命，气泡，时间或所有这些的组合。

每个挑战都有限定的生命，气泡数量或生存时间！

挑战与你在战役模式中逐渐通过的城市和学到的新机制有关！

如果你能够完成挑战并获得3颗星，将获得 Steam 成就！

在线排名：与其他玩家竞争，成为名人墙的一部分！

生存模式

生存下来 尽可能多的关卡，并在所有玩家中 转变 最大数量的 流星。

在线排名：与其他玩家竞争，成为名人墙的一部分！

Hunteroids 将会发布 两个版本：
演示版
演示版 具有以下特点：

 有 3 个基本城市，包括9个关卡 + 3个增强的教程，解释了基本知识

 本地评分（星级，生命，气泡和时间）

最终版本

最终版本将包含以下特点：

 在战役模式中有8个城市（+40个关卡）。每个城市都会有不同的机制

 Steam 成就

summary:
Stadtleben 是一款战略性的城市建设游戏，你将花园、道路和建筑放在方形牌上，以建立一个大城市。 在这里，你应该放置尽可能多的和/或尽可能高的摩天大楼，以获得更多的组件。

Stadtleben 是一款轻松的战略性城市建设游戏，在游戏中，你将使用方形瓷砖逐步建立一个大型城市。 在 Stadtleben 点，你可以不断地从日常工作中获得战略性的休息。 同时，这个游戏提供了通过巧妙地放置建筑元素来提高高分的可能性。

在 Stadtleben 的开始，你会得到一些随机的城市瓷砖，这取决于难度等级。 一个接一个，你将这些组件以用户定义的旋转方式放置在一个自由的方形场地上。 这就创造并发展了一个大城市，根据难度和粒子的高度，你可以获得高层元素的积分。

在指定的一定数量的移动之后，摩天大楼会发生随机的自然灾害，这个过程会以随机的移动数量重复进行。 这些自然灾害拆毁了高楼元素，而高楼元素没有受到上面高楼元素的保护。 当建筑元素的数量用完时，游戏结束。

在时间流逝的同时，你可以在太阳系的帮助下观看夜空，你可以在设置中激活或停用。 你还可以根据需要在设置中改变背景颜色、单元格阴影和太阳系的当前时间。

建立一个无尽的大都市

战略和拼图元素的混合体

轻松的城市建设游戏

定制太阳能系统

自定义背景颜色

战略性安置，提高自己的高分

每一轮游戏都是独一无二的

细胞阴影

3D-游戏板

不包括在 Stadtleben 中:

实时战术游戏

贸易

资源管理

斗争与暴力

多人游戏

Stadtleben 是由我独自开发的，我是巴伐利亚的一名学生。

我感谢任何反馈，任何改善这个游戏的信息，我将努力修复这个游戏中出现的和/或由你报告的任何bug/bug。 :)

In addition to letters, there are also power-up items to find on the board that will assist you. You'll take the role of a team manager and guide your team of 3 runners trough a series of grueling races that wind their way through mountains, plains and time trials.

In this turn-based game, every action must be carefully considered for each of your three specialized racers (climber, sprinter, and all-rounder):

 => Roll the dice to set your pace and risk encountering technical problems

 => Take advantage of the slipstream created by other racers to follow them

 => Strategically wait to slow down the racers behind you and create a gap

 => Seize an opportunity to attack and break away from the peloton

The game offers several options for guiding your racers, and each racer has their own strengths and weaknesses. As a manager, you will need to take these differences into account and choose your strategy accordingly.
MagnyTour offers a strategy and tactics-rich gaming experience for fans of cycling and simulation games.

Features:

* Choose between "classic" one-day race, Tour or time trial
* Solo mode against AI
* Online multiplayer mode with up-to 6 players

name: Crystals Of Irm
summary:
Crystals Of Irm 是一款老式RPG游戏，具有独特的战斗系统和地牢爬行元素。你与三位英雄一起探索伊尔姆，参观土地的不同区域，并爬到最黑暗的地牢深处。 

今天，只有传说仍然围绕着伊尔姆的晶体。山上的红色水晶--曾经是伟大的锻造之火，蓝色水晶--曾经是永恒学院知识的象征，绿色水晶--曾经是无尽森林的守护神；它们都已经从世界上消失太久了。或者，也许终究不是这样？ 

一次又一次，高贵的战士们踏上了寻找水晶的道路，将它们送回原处。到目前为止，许多人都失败了，而且仍然下落不明。传说中提到了三个地牢，据说伊尔姆的心脏就藏在其中。这次有可能取回水晶吗？ 

基于运动的网格战斗 - 在快节奏的战斗中击败讨厌的坏蛋，每一步都很重要。使用你的英雄们的能力和法术来到达你想去的地方。 

探索伊尔姆的世界 - 在这片土地上的各个地区旅行，参观各种地点。与这片土地上的居民交谈，帮助他们解决困难。

英雄 - 为你的三个不同的英雄配备技能和法术，变得更加强大并找到更好的装备。

地牢爬行 - 一路寻找不同的地牢和洞穴。寻找战利品，进行战斗，解开失踪水晶之谜

summary:
Bowerwhelm 是一款FPS Rogue-lite游戏。杀敌直到死亡，获得新技能，进化并组合它们，创造强大构建，更多屠杀！！！

Bowerwhelm 是一款旨在提供纯正Rogue-lite体验的游戏。这个追求使得游戏采用了极简主义的风格和简单的图形。我们融合了定义Rogue-lite类型的所有有趣元素，摒弃了其他一切。

在Bowerwhelm的核心是一个简单但有趣的Rogue-lite游戏。它与其他类似游戏有着相同的循环。然而，游戏的开发目标是优先考虑上瘾的核心循环，而不是试图引入多余的功能。

它采用简单的控制方式，让您控制一个面对各种几何敌人的弓箭手。最初，您的能力只是对基本攻击的增强。随着您的进步和获得新的技能卡，您可以打造出自己独特的玩法风格。

您可以创建基于随机机会的AFK卡组，实现一击杀敌，或农场卡组，轻松获取货币。除了发展您的技能之外，您还可以购买永久性升级。

每张地图都提供不同的挑战，更高的难度会提供更丰厚的奖励。不同类型的敌人需要不同的策略。但是，如果您不喜欢制定策略，也不用担心。您可以通过发展您喜欢的技能来完成关卡。您可以专注于创建仅针对强力攻击或被动技能的卡组。

如果您是一个想要拥有一切的玩家，在Bowerwhelm中也是可能的。您可以混合技能并创建混合构建。尽管每个技能都可以互补，但创建这些组合可能需要一些尝试和数学技巧。
在Boweria王国中与Nashved相遇

当您进入Boweria王国时，最高统治者将会为您分配一个监督员。在您的旅程中，"Nashved"会在那里为您提供帮助。他有些讽刺的个性，请用幽默的心态接受他的评论。

每一个到达这个王国的蠢货都应该有人来指导他们。是的，在Boweria，凡人被称为“蠢货”。请不要见怪；让我们称之为文化多样性… 最高统治者根据监督员的报告奖励蠢货新的能力和金币。

花时间收集胶囊。不要着急，它们不会消失

检查您的任务以解锁新技能

不要忘记发展您的技能

购买永久性升级以更强大的开始

寻找强大的技能组合

name: 迷石地牢
summary:
迷石地牢是一款在地牢中进行冒险的2D动作游戏。通过在地牢中与怪物战斗、采集资源、制造物品、寻找宝箱，最终到达地牢的最深处，解开被封印已久的秘密。

在远古的遗迹中，某天突然出现了一个通往地牢的特殊魔法阵，被地牢所吸引的人们很快聚集到了这个遗迹里。作为被吸引而来的其中一名冒险者，你能否在与地牢里强大的怪物战斗中存活下来，探索隐藏在地牢最深处的秘密？

《迷石地牢》是一款结合了采集资源，制作道具装备玩法的2D动作冒险游戏。通过采集在特定地牢中出现的地图资源，和收集特定地牢中出现的怪物掉落素材，来制作新的道具和装备，不断地挑战地牢中强大的怪物，向更深处的地牢前进！

采集资源

在不断出现怪物的地图上采集药草，挖掘矿石，砍伐树木等重要资源。在与怪物战斗前，首先要在这个神秘的地牢中努力的生存下来。

与怪物战斗

在地牢中才会出现的怪物。与各种怪物战斗并击败它们，收集只有怪物才会掉落的素材。

制作道具和装备

为了向更深处的地牢前进，就需要更强大的道具和装备。把收集到的资源和素材，制作出回复的药剂，锋利的刀剑以及坚固的铠甲。当然还可以制作更好的镐子，来更快地挖掘矿石。

挑战强大的怪物

只有在特殊层数的地牢才会出现的Boss级怪物。拥有Boss称号的怪物其强大是无需置疑的，只在特殊的层数出现，似乎是要抵挡探索的人们前往地牢的更深处。

寻找神秘的宝箱

会随机出现在地牢中某个房间的宝箱。宝箱里藏着能提升人物各种能力的神奇戒指，出现在地牢越深处的宝箱，藏着能力越强的戒指。

summary:
Lead a Roman expeditionary force into the heart of Ancient Britain! Recruit, promote, and upgrade your legionaries while constructing a series of fortified marching camps. Use Roman tactics and strategies to conquer the entire island and become Warlord!

Warlord: Britannia is the first entry in a new series of immersive strategy games created by solo developer Darkmatter Games. Step into the shoes of a Roman General given direct command of a Legion with orders from the Emperor to conquer an entire island.
Immersive-Strategy
A unique combination of first-person strategy elements places Warlord: Britannia in a genre of its own. Immersive strategy fixes the player in the first-person perspective of their character. Lead a large army, construct bases, conquer settlements, and disrupt enemy forces in the open world—entirely from this immersive strategy perspective. Turn the tide of battle by participating directly in the action, fighting alongside your own troops in real time.
Dynamic Open World
The world of Warlord: Britannia is an island more than 45 square kilometers in size, divided by latitude into three visually distinct geographic zones. Start your occupation in the densely forested Lowlands, then march north to the rolling hills and farms of the Midlands. Finally, push further north into the imposing and desolate Highlands. All three zones flow seamlessly together, never subjecting you to a loading screen.

Travel the roads cautiously and keep your eyes on the treelines, as trading convoys and roaming warbands criss-cross the open world in real time. The local population will quickly spread word of your exploits, so choose your actions carefully. Manage the population’s unrest levels and prepare for uprisings and raids on your camp. Enemies will react aggressively to repeated attacks and transgressions by your Roman invasion force.
Massive Battles

name: 死怪夜行
summary:
多様な妖怪を避けて赤い箱に封印された5つの玉を探し、祠堂を抜け出そう。

ゲームのあらすじ
一度入ってきたら絶対に抜け出せない正体不明の森
ある日、人生の意欲を失い、命を絶つためにある高校生が足を踏み入れることになる。
万が一、自分の遺体が発見されることを懸念していた生徒は、さらに深いところに入ることになる。
どれほど歩いたのか、ぼんやりする精神を維持したまま前に進むと、そこには古い祠堂があった。
◆ゲーム方式◆
広い廊下の中で自分の命を狙う存在を避けて、5つの玉を集めて財団に差し込んで次の場所に移動します。
近くに物事を調べて生存に必要なアイテムやストーリー進行に役立つ読み物があります。
◆しっかりしたストーリー◆
長い廊下の中で繰り広げられる物語
このゲームで複雑な世界観を一度に理解でき、人物の関係を容易に把握し、没入することができます。
◆退屈を減らしてくれる存在◆
長い廊下をさまよって感じられる恐怖なら、やはり自分を追いかけてくる存在ほど怖いものはないと思います。
廊下をさまようあなたを退屈させないように、さまざまな妖怪が登場します。
◆選択に応じた多様な結末◆
このゲームには「ベッドエンディング」「ノーマルエンディング」「リアルエンディング」 3つの結末が存在します。
あなたが選んだ結末で主人公が感じる感情を一緒に感じてみてください。
その他の情報
このゲームはRPGMAKERMVで制作されたホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。
暗くて果てしない廊下の中で、あなたの命を奪うために追いかけてくる数多くの妖怪たちを避けて、生存に必要な物と脱出に必要な道具を探して元の世界に戻りましょう。
■「リアルエンディング」を鑑賞すると、2種類の無料DLCが開かれます。
■このゲームはスチームクラウドに対応しています。

Play through multiple levels and shred through hundreds of enemies in this ALL NEW ACTION PACKED ROGUELIKE. Use Thousands of weapon and upgrade combinations to create your own strategy to progress through the ever-challenging stages of progression. Permanent upgrades and multiple classes allow for many different starting points and tons of replay-ability.

Craft a strategy using up to 6 Weapons, destroying everything in your path and crown yourself the KING of the apocalypse.

Add passives to your kit to add abilities to all of your weapons, create a shockwave around every critical hit, increase running speed depending on your level, and even heal for every enemy killed. All abilities, skills, upgrades, and weapons scale with one another, creating an experience that any player can succeed with any preferred strategy, if you play well of course ;)

The Wild West is a place where you can find a lot of cowboys who strive to take your life. Each of them is especially dangerous and must be destroyed. The bounty hunter has a lot of places to roam here.

Cowboys Showdown is a platforming shooter with waves of enemies, bounty hunters and high-ranking criminals who will be well paid to kill. Boxes with bonuses and the ability to buy new weapons will help you in your hard work.

name: Orc Tales: Olgob The Bold
summary:
An orc from a small tribe in the Greenskin Barrens. From a blue-collar, working-class family, hunting down billionaire Bear Lords who have taken control of the world. Help Olgob give power back to the people by overthrowing them.

Olgob The Bold is a Metroidvania Soulslike by a solo dev.

The story of an orc from a small tribe in the Greenskin Barrens. From a blue-collar, working-class family, hunting down billionaire Bear Lords who have taken control of the world by exploiting the labour of poor orcs. 

Ruling with cruel taxes up to 75% for small business owners. And letting their bear friends register companies in tax havens in the Forgotten Lands. Olgob is the Strong Orc Leader they need to come and fix all their problems. 

Play and help Olgob give power back to the people by overthrowing the government of the oppressive Bear Lords. 

With over 500 lines of unique dialogue spoken in complete gibberish.

Join Olgob on his journey through the Mutating Castle to collect 20 bear asses for a stranger in the woods... 

That is it. This is your quest. The only quest you have in this game. Just the one. Collect 20 bear asses. 

Mutating Castle

Players will traverse the Mutating Castle with interconnected areas, and changing pathways. Your world will change as you progress through the story.

Story and Lore Rich World

Discover the origin and story of the Bear Lords and their ascension as you piece together the secrets of the Mutating Castle.

Slow Deliberate Combat

Nothing is claimed easily. You will scratch and claw to victory every step of the way. You may say it is... just like Dark Souls.

Colorful Cast of NPCs

This game is all about the power of friendship. if you cannot do something alone, there is always someone who you can passively talk to and they will do nothing.

I plan on releasing free DLCs depending on how well this does.

summary:
VOSS Turbo 是一款复古风格的轨道双摇杆射击游戏； 带有控制器和键盘支持。 随着您访问和征服新世界，游戏的难度会增加。 探索 30个阶段，发现秘密和击败首领。 探索多元宇宙所提供的一切！

在这款受第五代启发的双摇杆太空射击游戏中，冲过 30 个古怪、抽象的关卡。

在这个具有分支路径的非传统宇宙中航行，以揭开它的许多秘密。

随着您在不断发展的旅程中解锁新的挑战和能量提升，动态难度将使游戏保持新鲜感。
将您收集的战利品带到当地的太空车库，制作零件来定制您的巡洋舰！ 您甚至可以带一个好友参加一些沙发合作行动！

大量的首领，大量的敌人，以及大量的游戏方式！

name: 风墓战记
summary:
致敬火纹的战棋游戏

故事背景
传说，那是一个遥远的年代，众神耕耘，大陆祥和宁静。人们生活富裕，各国繁荣昌盛。------史称众神时代 
某日，天地崩塌，众神凋亡。大陆自此战祸四起，从此人们生活在战乱颠沛之中。 
时光流逝几千年，大陆逐渐被几大国及周边无数小国瓜分统治。人们再次迎来了短暂宁静的和平 
直到古达尔海中，传说中的【圣枪】现世······ 

《风墓战记》讲述了一段遥远的历史与现今产生的国与家之间的纠葛战争故事，在层层迷雾下，黑暗势力、精灵、各大王国之间都在蠢蠢欲动。
核心玩法

《风墓战记》
是一款回归本源的经典风日式战棋游戏，每一个角色的站位、每一次行动的选择、每一把武器的使用，都将是攻关的关键。注意角色入队的条件，角色经验的分配，这将是你来决定的战场
游戏特色
1，游戏目前处于研发阶段，后续更新将不收取任何费用，购买时请酌情购买
2，游戏的美术及代码还有策划文案都将会逐步更新
3，错综复杂的战场地图，用你的战略克敌制胜
4，继承经典日式战棋游戏之衣钵，一个全新系列的启程之作。

name: BeachRun

name: EvoMon
summary:
Evomon是一款现代版的电子宠物育成类游戏。从幼儿期开始照顾你的Evomon并逐步探索牠们的进化路线，透过有趣的小游戏、充满神秘感的冒险以及和各种怪兽展开激烈的战斗来争夺冠军名衔。

WISHLIST NOW!

Take a moment to add EvoMon to your Steam Wishlist! You can also Follow to receive updates about development and release dates, and it will help us reach more players.

 Evomon 是新一代的电子宠物游戏，在这里你可以从婴儿时期开始训练Evomon直至它长大成强壮无畏的成年体。玩家能够尝试各种小游戏、钓鱼、探险、与怪物战斗、在实验室结合新的Evomons 和认识各种Evomons。在这个旅程中，你可以透过训练你的Evomon并使其成为Evomon冠军。
 如何照顾你的Evomon？

要成为一名称职的训练员，你需要给Evomon喂食各种食物，必要时清理牠的排泄物，使用你的Evocoins 在商店购买新的工具，以确保牠拥有需要的一切来继续繁忙和紧张刺激的日常。否则的话牠可能会需要被冷藏。

 你也不想永远照顾着婴儿宠物吧？
透过紧凑的小游戏在训练场锲而不舍地训练你的Evomon，赚取经验值来进化牠并了解牠们成长后的外观。

在远征中发掘稀有Evomons，在各种远征的终点赚取特殊道具，并在实验室中合成出新的稀有Evomon。

你很缺钱吗？没问题，你可以去钓鱼区钓出不同品种的鱼和各种独特的道具，这些鱼能够用来喂饲你的Evomon，或是贩卖以赚取更多Evocoins。
 你有足够的体力参与战斗吗？

在最后的战斗中使用你最强的成年体Evomon，并击败各种各样的训练员。即使你不能同时战胜所有敌人，你也可以利用你获得的经验和知识并在实验室合成新的Evomon。与你的新Evomon展开新的冒险直到你打败所有怪物并成为Evomon冠军。

在每次Evocycle的结束前于实验室合成新的Evomons。如果你在战斗中失去了Evomon，你可以复活一只旧的Evomon或是冷藏牠并用于合成两只Evomons来生成一颗新的蛋。你将获得并需要训练一只新的Evomon，希望这次一切会顺利吧！

 Evomon 这款游戏能给你甚么？

作为一名真正的Evomon训练员

照顾超过49种Evomons，每种宠物都各有3种进化

了解超过147种进化

在钓鱼区探索各种鱼类和特殊道具

三个远征区域，每一个区域都有一个独立的小游戏和特殊道具，该道具能在实验室中解放新的Evomon

在训练场有6种小游戏，可以用来训练你的Evomon和赚取Evocoins

有四只怪物在战斗区域等待你，每种怪物都有不同的小游戏

在实验室收藏冷冻后的Evomons、复活牠们，或是合成新的Evomon

像素画风

8位元音乐

160：144 分辨率以达至更大的游戏沉浸感 

塔麻可吉宠物育成类游戏

别忘记加入我们的Discord服务器来追踪游戏的最新进度、认识游戏制作人和提早获得游戏更新的截图、影片和试玩！

name: RE:BRIDGE～Return to oneself～
Hello, "another" WORLD!
Duterra
summary:
An isometric action RPG set in a medieval world of corporation-like guilds, you'll embark on a journey to pull your family out of debt, choosing to assist or betray the very guilds that hold power over you. At your disposal is an arsenal of melee and ranged weapons to fight opposing factions.

Explore
Along your journey, you'll meet every sort of character, from fisherman to quartermaster. Uncover guild motives, and make an impact because every choice shapes your reputation in the world. Explore unique areas and find special weapons to enhance your effectiveness.
Features

 Stealth
Stealthily approach enemies, making sure not to be seen or heard. Some weapons like knives have a stealth damage bonus that makes quick work of your foes. You can also create distractions by throwing anything you find.

 Ranged combat
Some enemies are best dealt with by bow and arrow, or anything sharp that you can throw, others by explosives.

 Melee combat
At your disposal is an assortment of swords, knives, and maces for close range encounters - dealing damage, and successfully blocking incoming swings will give you a powerful adrenaline bonus that increases your mobility and damage output.

 Puzzles
Keep an eye out for secret areas and locked doors, you never know what you might find.

Engine
The technology behind this game is a custom web-based engine built upon Electron.js, utilizing WebGL 2.0 and other modern web APIs.

name: Forlorn
summary:
Forage, craft, build, hunt, explore. Tackle the wilderness and anything lurking in the shadows in this single-player survival horror adventure.

Anyone can survive for a day. But can you survive the nights?

Forlorn is a single-player survival horror game. Lost on a deserted island, you will have to forage, craft, build, hunt and explore your way through the wilderness. The clock is ticking, as every night could be your last.
Forage
Find the resources you need to stave off hunger and survive just a little longer. Chop down trees to clear the landscape and collect wood for larger constructions.
Craft
Turn whatever resources you have found on the way into useful tools or deadly weapons to aid you on your adventure. Learn more crafting recipes as you become more experienced in the wilderness.
Build
Being out in the open, exposed to the elements and to anything lurking in the bushes is extremely dangerous. Grab a hammer and build a base to return to after a long day.
Hunt
Whether you prefer long-range kills with a bow or to get up close and personal with a spear, you will need a way to acquire fresh meat and hides.
Explore
You find yourself in a situation that you are utterly unprepared for. The answers you need can be found around you, but they will not be easy to come across. Explore your surroundings to figure out the path forward.

Are you ready to take on the unknown and survive?

summary:
Dynamic turn-based strategy game inspired by the hyper hardcore genre, where the player as a chief man of his tribe, will lead it to the glory, watch out for food and lurking predators!

Master of War is a planned series of dynamic turn-based strategy games inspired by a genre game called "Hyper hardcore" like Vampire Survivors.
Simple rules but there are many ways to victory.

In Rule of Power, the player gonna visits a wildland with tribal or Aztec-like people living in the jungle, as a chief man of his tribe, he not only focuses on destroying enemy tribes but also needs to care for food amount and be careful of attacks from predators or other supernatural beings.

Food in the jungle has a value greater than gold!
You need that not only to build structures and train troops but also to keep your people alive.
You can cultivate the land, collect fruit, go hunting or steal from opponents.

Watch your step, don't send people alone or a jaguar or crocodile will have a nice meal!
Remember that some animals are living in one herd, attacking one, you gonna fight the entire herd.
Also, these thieving monkeys can steal your food!

The most important person in each tribe is a sorcerer that protects his people from evil spirits, fights with other sorcerers, cast doom on enemies or blessed his fellows.

Use his magic wisely, because they all have cost.

summary:

Take classic top-down control of the destiny of a Buh as he makes his way through an adventurous retro wave world populated by many other Buhs.
Explore
Glitch throught the interconnected levels on the hexagonal grid world. Figure out how the grids are connected and get into areas no Buh has ever seen before.
Quests
Accomplish quests for different types of Buhs to unlock new skills and items.
Trade
Find the mysterious game store owner: Sell the junk you find on the different grids and try to get a good deal on the games he offers.
Fight
Fight the evil Buhs with your Nano Sword 2000 and grap their mojo to find out what happened to them.
Highscore
Try to reach the central grid to become the one and only choosen Buh for the highest of all known highscores.

...and have fun!

summary:
A new dark fantasy multiplayer action adventure role-playing game. Hone your combat skills, master the arcane arts, or turn a house into a home in the world of Fibula.

Dive into a heartfelt nod to the classic RPGs. This game is a cozy, yet adventurous journey through dungeons that feel both familiar and new, filled with puzzling quests and boss battles that challenge us just enough. It's a world where you can take a break to tend to your farm, decorate your house with unique items found throughout the world, study arcane arts to unlock unique spells, and make choices that carve out your unique story in the world of Fibula.

Invite up to 5 friends or host a dedicated server for more to play together.

Put your skills to the test with archery.
Bows can have unique effects that modify projectile properties.

Customize your character with different equipment loadouts.
Use equipment that best suites for your playstyle or optimize for style.

Study the arcane arts to unlock unique spells.

Decorate your house with riches found in dungeons.
Make a house into a home.

Dynamic hotbar with quick switching.

Set custom keybindings.

Now 100 years later, the descendants of those first mutants have decided to rebel against their governments to bring retribution for their ancestors and the discrimination they still face.
Key Gameplay Features:
2 playable factions: Global Defense Strike Force or Malformed Humanoid Coalition
Play single player against bots or team up with your friends and play against others in player hosted servers!
6 playable characters and 6 Game Modes: Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch, Control, Capture the Flag, Rush, and Kill Secured with more on the way!
3 playable maps and classes all equipped with their own unique ability

summary:
一款依赖拖拽手速和简单策略抉择的休闲游戏。

你的女朋友是一个吃货，非常喜欢各式各样的美食，尤其偏爱烧烤。
假期将至，你架不住她的软磨硬泡，决定花几天时间带她吃遍你家附近的烧烤店。
游戏玩法

 游戏的核心玩法是根据女朋友的喜好来烤制不同的食材来投喂她，以此来增加女友对你的好感度。

 你每天可以带她去一家店，在不同的店里她的喜好也会发生变化。

Aqorel is an isometric logic puzzle game set on a strange colorful planet. Combine elemental seasonings to create your path and deliver items. Combine and use these elements to interact in different ways to solve each puzzle.

Features

12 levels with puzzles that move from friendly to challenging

Unique and evolving elemental system

New interactions introduced and explored in each level

Aqorel is part of the CosmOS 9 bundle, a set of 9 puzzle games discovered on a mysterious video game console drifting in outer space.

Explore a strange world to uncover the secrets of a chaotic realm known as the Delta Manifold after it's sudden appearance caused a disaster known as the emergence which caused you to become stranded on mysterious planet.

Dive into an interconnected world and uncover locations such as ancient ruins, deep caverns, warped dimensions, and abandoned facilities.

Find upgrades to help you on your journey with abilities such as the scan visor, dash, slide, and jumps.

Collect scattered elemental relics to unlock new areas

Travel through breaches into the Delta Manifold to traverse past obstacles

This game is meant to be a simple and short(~2hour)

summary:
Your Computer Might Be At Risk is a first-person narrative puzzle game. Locked up in a room after a mysterious car accident, you must figure out how to escape while surviving dangerous trials.

A plan that almost worked out. 

An unfinished story, forgotten twenty years ago, returns to be concluded. 

A story about wrong decisions.

Your Computer Might Be At Risk is a first-person narrative puzzle game. Locked up in a room after a mysterious car accident, you must figure out how to escape while surviving dangerous trials and solving dozens of puzzles. Narrated in parallel, twenty years later your son unravels the story of your mysterious vanishing.

The game includes the special chapter "La Rata Escarlata". This last chapter explores the origins of the story and adds new interconnected puzzles in a unique new location.

As of December 2023, the game also includes the "Xmas Special" chapter. This short Christmas-themed episode contrasts the tone of the main game and features new puzzles, music and scenarios.

FEATURES

 Unique 3D visual style with stylized models, vibrant colors aesthetic inspired by Giallo genre and animated video cutscenes created from real video footage.

 Solve dozens of puzzles with unique and interesting mechanics.

 Varied gameplay, from fixed-camera point and click scenes to first-person camera with free movement.

 Diverse scenes and situations, from the real world to dreamlike stages.

name: Formula TOP
summary:
Formula TOP brings all the excitement of formula racing to a 3D top-down racing game. Work your way from backmarker to champion by planning perfect pit strategies around dynamic weather conditions and racing to victory.

Career mode

The career mode is all about a simulation-style experience. Team performances evolve over time and even new teams enter the field replacing old ones. You start in a backmarker team trying to work your way up. Solid race performances will aid development and refined teamwork over the years improves car setups, but at some point it's often better to move on. Keep up with the active driver market and impress with your race performances to secure a seat in the best possible team for the following season. When you have the car for it, push hard for the championship!

Feel the traction

Formula cars are the greatest racing cars in the world with amazing speed, downforce and grip. The game's driving model is built to emphasize this; hitting that apex just right really makes a difference. Slipstream overtakes and intense side-by-side battles create a great race experience. The AI drivers make mistakes, line up for overtakes and offer an engaging challenge for all skill levels.

Pit strategy

Optimize risk in your tire strategy on different tracks and temperatures to maximize grip throughout the race. Push to gain positions with your fresh soft tires or try to hold your ground long enough with hard tires to take advantage of the extra durability. 

Dynamic weather

Dynamic weather adds a whole other dimension to strategy. Do you start with wet tires on clear weather to get ready for the coming rain or leave those who do in the dust with soft tires? Or maybe you will do a longer stint with intermediate tires since the rain is light and won't last long. Whatever your plan, always be ready to adjust during the race. Reacting to the strategies of others and taking risks can make underdogs into winners.

Damage and engine modes

Watch out for damage

Tankitos!
Even the name reveals what is this game about, game inspired by old school game "Battle City" originally on NES in modern stylized style is full of tanks and tank battles in various arenas.
What is all about?

You can choose if you want to play solo missions or just enjoy some fun with your friends in online. Solo missions has same rules as in original "Battle City" game. Player have to protect his base against enemies. Enemies are spawned with different level and power. If player survive all enemies, player wins and can continue to next level, if player lost his all lives, player loosed and must play again. Most of walls are destroyable and those ones contains pickable items like, healths, armor and variety of weapons.
What can you expect by purchasing it?

Lot of fun with friends or with NPCs trying to destroy your base.
By playing solo player can achieve achievements, levels, xps and game coins. Game coins can be used for buying chests. Chests contains skins, new tanks, boosting cards and another game coins.
By playing multiplayer player can achieve free chests of all levels and xp points which leads to level up.

There is marketplace? :O

YES! Finally, I tried to make games more interesting, this game is my first game which contains marketplace! Marketplace contains skins, boosting cards, keys for some chests and chests. Some of items are tradable.

name: Post Solis
summary:
Post Solis is a real-time sci-fi strategy game. Your only ally is a tiny ray of the sunlight. It moves across the planet, and you can only build in its area. Anything plunged into darkness is destroyed. The game is built around the key mechanics of following the slipping ray of light.

Post Solis is a real-time strategy game. It's up to you to find out why eternal night has fallen on the remote planet where the prosperous Hope Colony was settled.

Now, 200 years after the disaster, your only ally is a tiny ray of the sunlight. It moves across the planet, and you can only build your base in its area. Anything plunged into darkness is out of operation. The game is built around the key mechanics of following the slipping ray of light.
Game features:

Send drones to find human survivors and scout out the ruins.

Build chains of production, gather raw materials and search for the survivors.

Improve your buildings to better withstand a cruel world.

Complete 3 exciting campaigns (plus a tutorial) to fully uncover the story of the Hope Colony.

Defend against flying guard drones and take your city into the air.

The prototype for this game was inspired and developed during the Ludum Dare '50 contest. We now offer players an updated and refined version of our game.

The Early Access version of the game contains a detailed tutorial and 3 full game campaigns. The game includes sound effects and several different soundtracks.
Our update plans

We plan to expand the main campaigns, possibly adding new types of buildings, blueprints and units.

A more polished user interface

Future updates may include edits to the game's difficulty balance.

シリーズ累計360万部超の大ヒット医療ミステリーのファーストエピソードを完全コミカライズ。これは二人の医師が絆を結ぶ、数奇な出会いの物語！
外科医から内科医への転科を決め、天医会総合病院勤務となった小鳥遊優。彼がそこで出会ったのは、莫大な知識と驚異的な頭脳を持つ天才女医・天久鷹央だった。やがて二人は院内で起こる不可解な謎に飲み込まれていき、一連の事件によって同僚の沖田を失った。
２人は事件の真相を暴くため、謎の教団「大宙神光教」の施設に潜入することになる。そこで起きる数々の不可解な出来事と同時に得る手がかり。事件解決にたどり着く完結巻。

summary:
温泉の出ない湯屋の跡取り娘・燕は調合した薬草の湯で客を癒やしまくる天才薬湯師。
ところが肝心の湯屋を叔父に乗っ取られ、金持ちの側女（しかも21番目）として売られることに。
だが祝言の土壇場、想いを寄せる幼馴染み・弘頼が燕を攫いに来てくれた!!
このまま駆け落ちするのねとドキドキの燕だったけれど、到着したのは後宮⁉
実は弘頼はやんごとなき皇弟だったのだ。　
弘頼の母の宮で侍女として働き始めた燕だが、
ある日、因縁がある中級妃に上級妃毒殺未遂の濡れ衣を着せられてしまう。
大ピンチにも気付かず燕の脳内では僅かなヒントを元に薬湯の知識が渦巻き、事件の謎が解け──⁉

迷信に怯える後宮妃たちの心と身体を、弘頼とともに持ち前の薬湯の知識で癒やす燕の無双が始まる！

name: Formula Bwoah: Online Multiplayer Racing
summary:
Formula Bwoah is a free-to-play, cross platform racing game with pit stops, engine modes and changing weather. Download now to experience a game that rewards skillful play and risk taking in online multiplayer.

Drive, not just manage
Decide your racing style and see if you have what it takes to come out on top.
Free to play
Online Racing is fun when you have loads of players to race against. That is why we are making the game Free to play and Cross Platform.
