小鳄鱼盖拿（Gena）收到了一个橙色的箱子，打开一看，里面竟然是一只奇怪动物。它有着松蓬蓬的茶色的毛，还有一对大大的耳朵，它看起来像猴子也像小熊，但其实两样都不是。因为它走出箱子后就一直跌跌撞撞的，所以被起名为“Cheburashka”（俄语中意为跌跌撞撞的人）从此小鳄鱼就和大耳猴成为了好朋友，它们过着新奇有趣的每一天。

name: Homebody
summary:
An interactive thriller about a group of friends haunted by the memories of their past while being hunted by a relentless killer. From The Game Grumps (Dream Daddy)

Homebody is a time loop horror puzzle game from Game Grumps, the maker of Dream Daddy: A Dad Dating Simulator. A deep, strange, and emotional narrative about mental health and relationships unfolds through each time loop, revealing more about what happened at this strange house. Non-linear puzzles, a homage to slasher films and retro gaming, and a time loop adventure combine for a unique getaway weekend gone awry.

Emily and her college buddies have gathered at a remote rental house to watch the Perseid meteor shower. They try to rekindle the bonds they once had, but lingering emotional wounds and social anxieties leave Emily feeling more alone than ever. When the power suddenly goes out, it’s almost a relief. But under the cover of darkness, a mysterious killer picks them off one by one. If Emily can’t find a way out, she’ll be trapped in this nightmare forever.

Evade the killer, solve the house’s devious puzzles, and reconnect with your friends. Escaping the house may seem impossible at first, but with each attempt to put the pieces together, the bloodstained picture becomes more and more clear.

Evade an unstoppable killer inspired by retro horror games like Clock Tower and 80s slasher films. Solve non-linear escape room puzzles inspired by adventure classics like Myst. This retro-but-modern game pulls players through hours of a deeply strange and emotional experience.

Emily and her friends gather for the annual viewing of the Perseid meteor shower. But with relationships strained and anxieties high, what should be a relaxing weekend quickly goes awry, turning even darker as a mysterious killer picks them off.

Aznak is a game created by a fan of RPG games.
Utilizing the RPG Maker system they were able to create their own tale and allow others to play through this great adventure.

Story

The world was created by Aznak an ancient being, who created guardians to watch over the planet in its absence. The guardians would be worshiped by mortals gathering spiritual energy into an artifact at the highest point on the planet every 100 years, a portal would open to Aznak. The artifacts gathered energy would be offered up to Aznak. Golgrim ( Aznak's Son) grew jealous and persuaded mortals to betray the other guardians and tradition allowing it to take on all of the spiritual energy gathered. After a great war broke out, Golgrim absorbed the energy wounding all the other guardians, and began battling against Aznak. In this great battle, Aznak sacrificed itself to defeat Golgrim and hold off the greater threat. Aznak and Golgrims essence poured into the world's atmosphere creating demi-humans and beastmen and the artifacts were broken into fragments scattered across the world. 《MiniTrans》是一款城市建设和交通运输模拟游戏。玩家将自主修建主城、卫星城，建设并发展都市圈、城市群，自由规划城市空间形态。在城镇密集地带之间搭建公路、铁路、机场、港口等各式交通类型，运送通勤者以赚取税收，促进人口增长和都市圈土地利用扩展。

Intro

As a macro regional planning games at the scale of metropolitan and urban agglomerations,  players can freely plan and create urban areas in the huge regional space, develop the main city and satellite cities, expand the population, and determine the spatial form of the region, earn taxes by transporting commuters and facilitate population mobility. We have selected 15 well-known urban agglomerations or metropolitan areas around the world and divided them into various categories for creating. 

Features 

Covering levels of dozens of city maps in five types, with a long game time.

Familiar metropolitan circles and urban agglomerations, maybe there are cities where you live.

Regional maps based on real city textures and satellite images; multiple types of transportation and minimalist art design.

The data layer displays core metrics such as traffic flow, traffic density, population, road mileage, railway mileage, etc.

A tense and relaxing level mode, a more challenging hard mode and an infinite mode that provides players with ample funds.

Five region types 

Bay cities

Seaside cities

Inland cities

Capital cities

Desert cities

Notice: now only 3 maps finished- Greater London metropolitian, Beijing (Capital-Tianjin Region), Shanghai (Soochow-Hu-Jia urban agglomeration). We haven't completed the final map classification.

Later Improvement 

Optimizing the player interavtive experience and simulate a more realistic transportation system and taxation mechanism.

Further clarify the playing objectives and reward mechanisms, enhancing playability and entertainment degree.

The city map will continue to increase and improve.

Exploring the player's free drawing mode

summary:
Rail Walker, noun, a semi autonomous rail-mounted turret attack weapon. Defend against the swarms of intelligent insects threatening your mining infrastructure. Construct rail tracks, strategically move, repair, recharge, reload and upgrade your rail walkers in the battle against these enemy waves.

Back Story

Set in the not so distant future, you have been tasked with protecting a secret government mining operation. Its deep-earth drilling has disturbed previously unknown families of intelligent insects. Threatened by your machinery being too close to their nests, swarms of these insects are fixated on destroying your infrastructure.

Historically, effective control of these swarms has only been possible with the use of Rail Walkers. These semi-autonomous turret based weapons contain sophisticated electronics enabling them to intelligently target and destroy thousands of attack insects.
Gameplay

The single objective is to protect your Base and infrastructure from the insects by using Rail Walker technology.

You will start with a single Type 1 Level 1 Rail Walker positioned on a small length of rail-track in the middle of your mining area. This track will need to be extended, allowing your Rail Walker to reach further into other areas of your operation. By using switching tracks your Rail Walker can easily be moved from location to location.

Rail Walkers are controlled manually via the Remote Operations Hub. You will issue commands to the Rail Walker to stop, start, recharge, patrol, reload and so on. You will also operate the rail switching tracks, changing the path your Rail Walker will follow.

The insects attack in waves, with each wave most likely being more difficult than the previous. Defeating these wave attacks will earn you funding to upgrade your Rail Walker or to even purchase more Rail Walkers. Each upgrade brings faster movement, increased battery life, better firepower and so on.

summary:
工厂自动化 × 动漫风RPG。用齿轮与传动轴为机器与传送带供能，搭建自动化工厂。生产物品、研发科技，从风车一路进化到核聚变，沿着人类技术史前进；最终建造火箭回到故乡，揭开你被流放的真相。

风车旋转、齿轮啮合，机器轰鸣着苏醒。调校转速与扭矩，设计只属于你的动力网络。

高转速还是高扭矩？通过齿轮比的调试，追求高效的动力传输。

从水车到蒸汽机、电力，再到核聚变。每一次技术飞跃，你能做到的事情都会随之扩展。

将采矿、冶炼、加工到组装全部自动化——打造一张材料自行流转的生产网络。

你的最终目标是建造一枚火箭。发展你的工厂，向回到故乡迈进。

被流放的公主优里（Yori）与她色彩鲜明的伙伴们。她为何被逐出？真相将在故事中揭晓。

Yori（左）：塞莱斯塔尔（Celestal）星的第二公主。甚至不知道原因就被流放到阿卡迪亚（Arcadia）星。起初她只是个被保护得很好的大小姐，几乎什么都做不了，但在艾雷诺（Ereno）的帮助下，她推动了工业化进程。

Ereno（中）：通用型支援 AI 系统，作为随从与 Yori 一同来到阿卡迪亚星。

Kurua（右）：运动能力强，真诚聪明，性格随和。友善健谈。她热爱金钱——为了生存愿意做任何事。

循序渐进的教程将从零讲解工厂自动化的基础——无需任何经验。

完整的分步教程，教你掌握工厂自动化的核心基础。

不再出现“接下来该做什么？”的困惑。伙伴们会引导你走向下一个目标。

老练玩家也可以跳过教程，直接投入真正的建造。

name: Maps: U.S.A.
summary:
An educational game to make learning the name, location, and capital of the fifty states of the United States of America fun.

Maps: U.S.A. is an educational game designed to teach the name, location, and capital of all fifty states of the United States of America. Various difficulty settings and hints can be adjusted to accommodate those just learning, as well as those who already know the lay of the land. At game's end the player will either be rewarded with a fireworks display and rousing anthem, or an invitation to play again until they can correctly identify all 50 states without a single misstep. An entertaining soundtrack keeps the mood light and the pressure low.

God bless the USA!

How about switching to a farmer's life? Contrary to what it seems, this is not an easy job! Carefully cultivate crops, take care of animals, trade, and keep in mind your budget while dealing with all. This means, the progress of the entire farm is in your hands. Let's get started!

Environment

name: Tile Cities
summary:
Tile Cities turns city-building experience into a simple relaxing puzzle game and does so with style

Tile Cities breaks city building down to its very basics making it more of a simple puzzle.

Compose nice-looking city maps of randomly generated city blocks (tiles), match colored buildings and parks to meet demand, connect tram lines with depots to get bonuses. 

Creative mode with no limitations is also available. In this mode you can regenerate random tile until you get the one you like.

name: Mariam Game
summary:
Mariam游戏是一款叙事类游戏，设置在一个幻想世界中，你的选择将影响你和Mariam的命运。通过玩卡片模式并完成所有关卡获取故事提示。

"Mariam游戏"是一款非常有趣的游戏，包含故事情节和游戏玩法。它依赖于三种游戏模式：故事模式、卡片模式和动作模式。"Mariam游戏"的灵感来自18世纪中东一个年轻女孩的生活，她与幽灵有着神秘的联系。
我们的游戏非常注重节奏、氛围和叙事，恐怖元素来源于氛围和故事情节，而不是突然的噪音和人为效果。
故事模式
是时候沉浸在Mariam的世界中，并在过程中帮助她回家了。做出你自己的选择。"生存恐怖"、"谜题"和"点击者"由"Salman AlHarbi"开发。它提供了一个搞笑的街机模式和一个激动人心的冒险模式，还有戏剧和动作元素。沉浸在成千上万个不同的世界中。选择是无穷无尽的！或者通过玩"卡片模式"并完成所有关卡来获得所有故事提示。

卡片模式
提供了一种引人入胜且有趣的方式来锻炼记忆回忆、模式识别和细节关注。通过生动的图形和直观的游戏玩法，它为各个年龄段的玩家提供了一种愉快的体验。

动作模式
玩一个动作游戏，你需要在极简世界中尽可能长时间生存。地狱空无一人，魔鬼无处不在。你必须生存，直到无法再继续。每轮收集金币以购买升级并提高生存机会。

游戏角色

女巫的宫殿：
 一位居住在墓地后宫殿中的女巫。她轻盈如风，由一名名为亚历山大的私人守卫陪伴。

海兹布娜：
 生活在墓地中，已有一千多年的历史，她有一位名为苏格拉底的私人守卫，一个注入了蝙蝠基因的年轻人。

莎赫拉扎德：
 居住在幽灵谷中，靠近国王的宫殿。所有的妖军都在她的指挥下，她的私人守卫是名为坎迪的恐怖兔子角色。

达里乌斯：
 一位国王，智慧且勇敢的领袖，与莎赫拉扎德结盟。他的宫殿位于幽灵谷旁边。

An enigmatic retro point & click adventure. You are the renowned artist Manglepaw who is struck with creative ennui and enters a strange train station in search of their muse. Solve puzzles or just explore the dream-like station.

This game is presented in the style of old 1st-person point & click adventure games, with an emphasis on moody atmosphere and surreal environments. Strange denizens pepper the vast halls of this cryptic building.

Learn the mysteries of the various rooms and complete a handful of puzzle minigames to reach the "true end". Or just have a relaxed time exploring and meeting folks, because most of the station is accessible from when you first enter the building.

Will one of these fine folk become your artistic muse!?!?

summary:
「VICTORY７」はスロット×デッキビルドをテーマにしたローグライク風ゲーム。スロットを止めて敵と戦うスロットバトルと、勝利報酬で手に入れた絵柄をスロットに組み込むデッキビルドを繰り返して先へ進もう！

―概要―

　「VICTORY７」はスロット×デッキビルドをテーマにしたローグライク風ゲーム。スロットを止めて敵と戦うスロットバトルと、勝利報酬で手に入れた絵柄をスロットに組み込むデッキビルドを繰り返して先へ進もう！

―スロットバトル―

　プレイヤーはスロットを止めて敵と戦う。横か斜めに同じ絵柄が３つ揃うとアクションが発動する。アクションはアタック・ガード・ヒール・チャージの４種類。アタックで敵にダメージを与え、ガードやヒールで身を守り、チャージでスキルゲージを溜めてスキルを放とう！強敵を倒して手に入る“７”の絵柄を揃えると、自動で絵柄が揃うFEVERモードに突入！

―スロットビルド―

　バトル勝利後に行うスロットビルドでは、３つの絵柄の中から１つを選択して好きなリールに組み込むことができる。リールに入っている絵柄が多いほどリールの回転速度が速くなり狙った絵柄が出にくくなるので注意！マップで特定のマスに止まることで、絵柄を排除してリール回転速度を下げたり、スロット内の絵柄をレベルアップすることができる。レベルの高い絵柄で揃えるのか、複数のアクションを揃えるのか、自分好みの戦い方でビルドをしよう！

―世界観―

　賭博の神「ヴィクトール」の気まぐれによってスロットで戦う力を授ける。正義感の強い主人公は授かった力を使い、世界各地で人々を脅かすモンスターを倒すことを決意するのだった。運と実力が交差する冒険が今始まる！

summary:
■ゲーム概要

海賊ライフ満喫エロRPG!

実はあなたは伝説の海賊の息子だった!
父親の部下だったという海賊ベベッキオに誘われて海賊になったあなたは、この海の覇権をかけて10組の海賊たちと戦うことになります。

ライバルの海賊たちは一癖も二癖もある連中ばかり。
場合によっては仲間になることもあるので、仲間を増やし、自分の海賊団をどんどん強化しましょう。
女海賊を配下にできたら、彼女らに奉仕させることも可能です!

海にはいくつかの港町があります。
海賊たちも頻繁に立ち寄る荒っぽい港町です。
港町では、商売をしたり、情報を収集したり、町を攻撃したりできます。
港町を攻め落とすと、従属させるか蹂躙することができます。
従属させると、その町には情婦を置くことになり、
もちろん手籠めにすることもできます!

商船や村を襲うと金銭や物資を奪うことができます。
奪った金が貯まったら、新しい船を建造したり、今ある船を改造したりできます。
船を強化して、さらなる強敵に挑みましょう!

そうしてすべての海賊を倒し、父すらもなしえなかった海賊王を目指すのです!



■レベル上げ作業無し!

がちんこパイレーツにはレベルの概念がありません。
レベルアップで強くなることもありませんが、レベル上げという作業に時間を取られることもありません。
ガンガン戦ってサクサク進めてください。



■チートモード搭載!

ゲーム序盤の選択肢で、主人公と副官の女の子ベベッキーが超強くなる無双モードを選択可能!
もちろん全てのエロシーンを見ることが可能です。
それどころか、無双モードでクリアすると、未発見のエロシーンもすべて回想シーンで解放されます!



■シンボルエンカウントで追いかけっこ!

敵との遭遇は全てシンボルエンカウント!
うっとうしいランダムエンカウントはありません。
好きな敵と戦い、嫌な敵からは逃げることができます。
商船を追いかけて、軍艦からは逃げまくる、ガチンコな海賊の航海をお楽しみください。



■海を彩る女たち!

港町ごとに情婦を囲ってこそ立派な海賊ってもんよ!
様々なタイプの女海賊と、女海兵、女商人、女王、メイド、女兵士長などが登場します。
もちろん登場する女子全員にエロシーンを用意しております!
配下や情婦からは奉仕を、蹂躙した町ではレイプを!
総数35のエロシーンをお楽しみください!

summary:
■ストーリー

突然悪魔が現れ、世界が荒廃して20年。
地殻変動で高い崖に囲まれ、狭い土地に隔離されたユグドの街の人々は
崖を越えて外の世界に出るために、悪魔と戦える新人類を作り上げた。
悪魔と性交することで悪魔の能力を身に着けることができる「魔女」と
魔女を使役する「戦士」
新たな「戦士」となったあなたは、ユグドの人々を導く救世主になる。



■システム

〇戦術性の高いアクティブターンバトルを採用。
戦闘中、悪魔を誘惑してセックスしたり、興奮した悪魔に襲われたりします。
通常戦闘の最中に無防備なセックスを行う緊張感をお楽しみください。
悪魔に中出しされると悪魔のシードを受胎。その悪魔のスキルを身に着ける
事ができるようになります。

〇数多く用意された装備品は全て、立ち絵と戦闘画面でグラフィックに反映。
好みの見た目で戦闘をお楽しみいただけます。

〇時間の経過で昼と夜が訪れます。
夜のユグドの街では様々な夜のイベントが待ち受けています。
ヒロイン以外の魔女へのシード譲渡。売春、買春、乱交などのエロシーンを、
体験したり覗いたりできます。

〇ヒロイン達は、魔女とはいえ最初は処女です。なので最初のうちは悪魔との
性行為はハードルが高く、なかなかうまくいきません。
夜の時間にヒロインたちと過ごし、抱いて開発してやることによって、彼女達
は悪魔との性行為も難なくこなせるようになってゆきます。

〇ストーリーが途中で大きく分岐、4種類のエンディングを用意。
あなたの選択で、ユグドの街の人々の未来は大きく変わります。
ルートによって戦う敵、エリアなど訪れる場所も変化しますので、フルコンプ
には周回プレイが必要です。
ただし、一度獲得した装備品とスキルは2周目以降も繰り越されますので、
2周目以降は楽な戦いをすることができます。



■エロ

Hシーンは基本で44シーン。差分を含めて270枚のイラストを使用。
今回、ほぼすべてのイベントイラストをサークルJONのちゅぴまろさんに
描いていただきました。http://www.dlsite.com/maniax/circle/profile/=/maker_id/RG07987.html

かわいらしい顔をしているくせに、むっちりと柔らかくて暖かそうな、
そそる体を描いてもらっています。ぜひご堪能ください!



■■まずは体験版を!■■

動作確認も兼ねて、ぜひ体験版をお楽しみください!

ver1.01

〇確認されているバグの修正を行いました。

〇より快適に遊んでいただけるような複数の調整を施しました。
・フィールドの敵出現率を半分にしました。
・デビルジャマーの効果時間が３倍になりました。
・戦闘中セックスで装備が外れなくなりました。
・昼間に自室のベッドで休むと夜になるようになりました。
・一部薬品の効果を大幅に強化しました。
・シードを宿しているキャラクターにアイコンが表示されるようになりました。
・悪魔辞典に、悪魔の所持シードと出現地域が記載されました。

ver1.02

〇確認されているバグの修正を行いました。

〇新規Ｈイベントを２シーン追加しました。

〇クリア後に戦闘時のＨシーンを再現できるモードを追加しました。

〇検査薬でのシードの定着が失敗しないようになりました。

〇体験版のゲームシステムを、現状の製品版と同じものに修正しました。

〇すでにお買い上げいただいている方も、お手数ですが再ダウンロードをお願いいたします。

summary:
あらすじ

行方不明の少年を探すため、廃れた港町・インスマスへやってきたメロード巡査。

summary:
Comedic Horror RPG / JRPG that will leave you breathless with a sticky keyboard --- or offended! No holds barred, no filters. Pure unadulterated sexiness monster orgy goodness!!

In this horror-themed comedic RPG, you are "Hero" (but can change your name) that tries to stop a horned-up vampire named "The Grand Stroker" and his electrifying friends. You will fight enemies, level up and get progressively stronger tiered gear, take on dungeons and hand-drawn bosses until the final show-down where you will fight the "The Grand Stroker" himself in the Grand Stroker's Castle. Will you survive --- or will he suck your life-forces dry? 

The game features : 

•Hilarious names, places and ideas that will literally say "Are you kidding me?!"

•Hand drawn bosses from Cesare, the legendary Italian illustrator from NecroCatic Games!!

•At least 7 dungeons and a dozen bosses! Side bosses, RAID Bosses, INCARNATE Bosses and more!!

•A ton of color tiered gear to collect including rare, epic and MONSTER drops!

•Traditional turn-based combat with new and clearly superior Retro Sideview Combat!

•Some BANGING Music by returning OST composer Scott Oakes (who did "The Tower of Wowers")!! 

•Masterful voice actor VaughnsEvilLair providing funny and witty lines that will sure to leave you in stiches.

•52 Strokemon cards to collect all throughout the environment!

•Ideas from the same programmer and studio that brought you such classic games as "The Tower of Wowers" and "CarsFuckingDragons".

AND MORE!!!

Why is Clance trying to kill him?

Is Ashley really that bad?

What is the DEAL with that duck hat!!!???

Intense combo system encourages mastery of play. Will you get the S ranks?

Different attacks from opponents are dealt with differently. Dodge yellow attacks, parry red, and don't punch blue!

Platforming stages break up the action! Spectacle to the max!

Humorous cutscenes will steal your heart and your hard-earned cash!

name: THE WILDERNESS
summary:
THE WILDERNESS is a first person, action packed, realistic survival game. Fight off mutant zombies while trying to expand your base. Craft and upgrade your equipment in order to survive. Begin a solo session, or partner up with up to 4 players in a cooperative survival adventure. You are not alone.

SHORT DESCRIPTION

Introducing, "THE WILDERNESS" - a new and upcoming indie open-world survival game, developed by Wilderness Games and developed in the Unity game engine. THE WILDERNESS is targeted for PC platforms, with ultra realistic graphics. It expands on the current survival genre, with stunning graphics, and an incredible set of features to optimise the fun out of every session. 

JOIN OUR DISCORD

Use this link to join our discord! a place where you can hang out and chat to others about the game, or anything related to it!

FEATURES

THE WILDERNESS has a lot of features to engage the player. These features are provided to the player to maximise the fun out of every single session!

HUNTING

Hunting is a core part of gameplay in THE WILDERNESS. You can hunt down animals to cook, harvest, or gather resources from them. Animals can be hunted with the various weapons presented throughout the game.

GATHERING

Gathering is an important part of gameplay in THE WILDERNESS. Players will collect many items, which can be used for crafting or building later. Items can be harvested with many tools, and some items requiring certain tools or upgrades to harvest.

INVENTORY

The inventory is a major key in progressing in THE WILDERNESS. Players can use their inventories to craft, store and hold items. Players can transfer inventories between each other or between storage containers.

BUILDING

Building is a core part of surviving in THE WILDERNESS. Players need a shelter to survive the night, and keep away from combat. Players can also build furniture and necessities. Players can build objects like campfires, to help with cooking and other aspects of gameplay.

name: Spyer
summary:
Denny, a government spy, is assigned to investigate a remote area where there is supposed to be a terrorist group. Upon arriving at the scene, Denny comes across several armed individuals, and finds possibly the largest base of the terrorist group.

In Spyer you will live a story of action, mystery and observation.

The game takes place in a rural area, in the middle of a forest, where you must explore the area to complete the objectives. You will have a rifle and a silenced pistol to help you in combat, and you will have to face an area full of terrorists heavily armed, all of them prepared for combat.

You will control Denny, in first person, and you will have to complete some tasks to exterminate the terrorist group that inhabits that region, in an intelligent way, trying not to be seen, for that, you will have to take some photographs, carry out interrogations and collect some other information in the area, all this with a lot of intelligence and preparation, because the area will be full of armed men. You'll be able to play in your own way, be it silently, in stealth mode or by breaking everything and shooting everyone. Go to the area, investigate, collect evidence and try to escape unharmed.

The game experience provides a mix of suspense, which when combined with strategy, makes everything perfect.

Denny, a government spy, is assigned to investigate a remote area where there is supposed to be a terrorist group. Upon arriving at the scene, Denny comes across several armed individuals, and finds possibly the largest base of the terrorist group.
In this situation, Denny decides to invade the base to try to take some photographs and interrogate one of the group leader's trusted men, in order to obtain information about the group's future plans. It will not be an easy task to invade a place full of terrorists armed to the teeth. Any mistake could be fatal!

Are you a good spy? Find out on Spyer.

name: 魔王難為Ⅳ vol.03
summary:
聖魔大戰的導火線，竟然是「他」？！
　　最不想見到的戰爭，終於爆發——

　　跪著生，還是站著死？
　　沒有正確答案的悲傷抉擇，
　　聖王和魔王站在了黑與白的極端，
　　歷史，向著已知的悲劇前行。

　　緋炎水銀、魔律式石、賢者之石……
　　戰爭中，一件件可怕的鍊金道具因緣際會誕生；
　　與日冕的鏖戰，在獻祭了千萬生命之後，
　　終於得以走向「未來」……

name: 魔王難為IV vol.04 無冕之王
summary: 歷史的圓環終於圓滿，魔王與日冕打響最終戰──沉睡百年，終於從「過去」回歸現在，日冕帶來的威脅終於升到歷史頂點！然而在與之對決之前，魔王碧安卡首先需要面對阿爾卡迪亞留下的最後考驗——魔王印記的徹底甦醒、埋藏的力量被喚起，七隻大惡魔齊聚一堂、聖與魔的決戰亦再度打響。當心化為鋼鐵，當決意成為利劍，王者之名，又怎需那邪惡的冠冕來妝點？

name: 魔王難為Ⅳ vol.02 聖魔之戰
summary:
隨書附錄：PET人物造形書籤組+《魔王難為》番外特典

　　數百年前的聖魔大戰，碧安卡正身歷其中，
　　所謂的「真相」到底是什麼？

　　穿越這種不可能的事情，在碧安卡身上發生了兩次！
　　第二次還是被最愛的人送到數百年前……
　　但她沒有太多的時間可以感傷，
　　因為一切的開端，都源自於「曉光聖女辛西婭」——

　　隨著聖魔大戰的關鍵人物逐一登場，
　　是敵是友，難以分清。
　　站在這個歷史上重要的轉捩點，
　　碧安卡的一舉一動都牽動著未來。
　　她，該如何做出抉擇？
　　以及，何時才能回去？

name: 魔王難為Ⅳ vol.01 愛與憎的彼岸
summary:
消失的魔族大賢者、理應不存在於現世的魔法元素、在迷宮深處徘徊的白色巨獸、以及勇者蘭斯洛特遺落在外的最後一份感召力；盤魔山溶洞揭露了太多秘密，是時候將它們逐一揭曉了！然而隨著旅途的終焉的到來，當迄今以來最為龐大的「答案」呈現在魔王的眼前，她是否真正做好了迎接這一切的準備？

summary:
幼稚園から私立女子校育ちの35歳、独身。アパレルブランドを経営するエミリと、テレビ局でバリバリ働くマリアは、幼少期から同じ学校に通い、今も変わらず定期的に集まる大親友。この日も行きつけのカフェで待ち合わせ、マッチングアプリでの出来事にツッコミを入れ合い、美容などの他愛もない話をしながらケーキとお茶を楽しむ。写真を撮って加工して、「今日の私たち、結構いいよね」と笑い合う、いつも通りの時間。
ところが2⼈が通うネイルサロンの年下ネイリスト・さくらが合流すると、流行の話題もスマホに映る動画も、なぜか自分たちだけ微妙にズレている。気づくと店内も若い客ばかり。
楽しい雑談の延長のはずが、「ねぇさん達って、どうなりたいんですか？」というさくらの一⾔に、エミリとマリアは思わず絶句。「わたしたちのこのモヤモヤってなんなんだろう……」、「若さに憧れちゃうのってなんでなんだっけ……？」そんな想いを抱えながら、2⼈は“自分なりの幸せ”を求めて奔走する――。

summary:

Princess of Seas is a sea sailing. Start the blue-colored adventure now.
Basic Features

 Randomly Generated World: The world is procedurally generated. So the adventure in a completely new world every time.

 Open-World: No limitation. Explore the world freely.

 Trading: Selling goods all around the world and making money

 Upgrading Ship: 197 ships in the world. Unlock them, buy them, and enhanced them. You can never be too powerful.

name: The Sirena Expedition
summary:
The Sirena Expedition is a short PSX-style horror-platformer in which you explore a mysterious underwater facility.

"I remember getting the call vividly. I was trying to finish up for the day, but a stack of paperwork was keeping me late. To be honest, I was also looking for reasons not to go home. My phone rang, I answered it, and the director of the institute was talking, albeit disjointedly, about something that had turned up in a recent survey of The Sirena Deep."

Explore a mysterious, abandoned underwater facility at the bottom of the Mariana trench. Who built it? What was it used for? Perhaps you will find answers, or perhaps the answers will find you.

You can play through The Sirena Expedition in about an hour. However, there may be some hidden content, for those willing to look for it.

A 2.5D platformer with PlayStation1-inspired visuals.

Tense underwater atmosphere and horror.

Innovative puzzle mechanics.

Fully voiced dialogue.

Original soundtrack by beee girlll & Giraffe Cat.

name: Hacker Man
summary:
Joe, an experienced programmer at a reputable technology company, is fired by a director of the company, after having a romantic relationship with the director's wife. Very angry about the situation, Joe starts studying hacking, to get revenge for his firing.

In Hacker Man you will experience a story of action, invasion and hacking.

The game takes place in a company close to a city, where you can explore the entire area and you have to fulfill some objectives to complete it. You will have a medium-range weapon and a pistol as work tools, in addition to your hacking expertise. You will have to face an area full of security.

You will control Joe, in first person and you will have to do some tasks to break into the lab, look for the correct notebook to hack, and shut down the lab's servers, all this with a lot of action, since the lab will be full of security guards, making it possible for you to complete your objective with stealth, without drawing too much attention. Enter the lab, do what must be done, and get out safely.
The game experience provides a mix of strategy with a little suspense and action.

Joe, an experienced programmer at a reputable technology company, is fired by a director of the company, after having a romantic relationship with the director's wife. Very angry about the situation, Joe starts studying hacking, to get revenge for his firing, and in return, make some money, stealing the source code of one of the company's main programs.
After a few months, Joe decides to put his plan into action, and breaks into Tech Corp. in order to steal the company's source code. However, this will not be an easy task, as the company has several security guards around, prepared to cease any invasion.

Are you prepared to invade and hack Tech Corp.? So let's go!

2 videos per level so you can solve the puzzles placing the pieces strategically according to the areas of each video.

Enjoy the awesome synthwave tracks.

51 Achievements. Are you fast enough to unlock all of them?

Finish the game to unlock Kitty's message. It contains extremely important information about the future.

name: Employee of The Month
summary:
An atmospheric retro inspired survival horror game. Enjoy the late shift at 'The Month' in an abstract and unsettling night of terror, spooks and convenience.

Salary : €9 - €11 an hour

Become a member of The Month, a rural market store that provides for local communities. Staff here provide a friendly shopping experience for customers, answer questions and offer suggestions. Responsibilities may include :

Working to accomplish goals

Operating the cash register in a fun and efficient manner

Stocking shelves

Cleaning the store and general maintenance

Helping customers find their favorite products

You'll learn a lot. You're not stuck doing one task here. Each Crew Member contributes to creating a WOW customer experience by participating in all aspects of the job.

If you have a passion for money, we'd love to meet you. We can teach you the rest.
The Month is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to hiring damn near anyone.

 NOTE : Must have a flexible schedule.
 - Manger

First person exploration with unique and unsettling environments.

Play with Mouse & Keyboard or Controller.

Retro-inspired graphics.

Interactable and readable objects at every corner.

Multiple endings and modes.

Employee of the Month contains mature themes and scenes of explicit violence, gore and bad language.

name: The Unsettled
summary:
The Unsettled is a first-person psychological horror game. You, as a paranormal investigator, is on a journey to find a missing girl. In order to find the truth, you plan to visit a boarding school in the Indian Himalayan Region.

Note: The game can get a bit challenging at times, so if you get stuck, you can follow this easy Tutorial Walkthrough.
Storyline
You are an investigative journalist willing to take risks and dig deep to uncover the stories no one else will dare touch.
On a trail to find the truth, You plan to visit a Boarding School in the Indian Himalayan Region after receiving a Message from your old co-worker friend who told you about a case of a missing girl. 
Your task is to Investigate the school campus, follow the instructions from your Friend while you explore, Collect the hints, Connect the dots and try to find the missing girl, and.. try not to die.

Environment
The game is set inside a huge school in which terrible things have happened.
You’ll wander through various places, such as scary classrooms, unsettling houses, movie halls, hostels, labs, auditoriums, dispensaries, etc.
Explore every location and find your way to the missing girl.
Gameplay
In this game, you have to search for some stuff in order to search for the missing person. You’ll be able to pick up items, interact with the environment, and search for things that may help you search for the artefact coins and solve the mystery.

Get lost in this immersive and terrifying experience thanks to high-quality visuals and 3D sounds with ever-changing weather and realistic environments.

WARNING: PHOTOSENSITIVITY/EPILEPSY SEIZURES

name: L'Avancée du désert
summary:
L'Avancée du désert est un jeu de gestion où vous devez développer votre colonie spatiale pour récolter de la nourriture et trouver de nouvelles technologies tout en combattant la désertification.

Chaque bâtiments que vous construisez accélèrent la propagation du désert, il vous faudra donc trouver le juste milieu entre la croissance de votre colonie et la préservation de l'environnement.

Tentez votre chance dans 4 niveaux aux mécaniques et objectifs différents. Chacun d'entre eux contient une nouvelle technologie pour vous aider à combattre la désertification.

----------------------------------------------------

L'Avancée du désert est un projet étudiant, développé en 300h et entièrement produit par moi-même. C'est le premier jeu que j'ai produit et j'espère avoir l'occasion d'en produire d'autres dans un futur proche.

name: Natal Perdido
summary:
Brazilian Indie JRPG with biblical perspective. Turn-based battle system. Developed solo. The only Christian RPG on Steam.

The project:

Emilia is an ordinary girl living on top of a mountain until strange things start to happen, demons and angels are facing each other to decide whose human souls will be, an event that will become known to all as the Lost Christmas.

The Gameplay:

Lost Christmas has simple gameplay. The battles are in turns and the entire soundtrack of the game is professional, the combat mechanics are traditional, Attack, Defense, Skills and Items, but the acquisition of spells differs from the common, in most games the characters acquire new spells through masteries and reading scrolls, grimoires, etc. In Natal Perdido new spells are unlocked as the player finds or acquires verses scattered throughout the game, these verses when equipped grant the character new abilities, status and attributes according to the passage described in it.

When purchasing this game keep in mind that it is a totally independent project in development, created with great care by a single person, this one who tells you. The central idea is to offer a complete JRPG entirely in OLD SCHOOL style with turn-based battles, various equipment, legendary weapons, skills, NPCs, as well as characters with a rich, deep and mysterious story, the game has secrets , easter eggs and secret passages which it is quite possible that only 1% of players will discover. 

(Early Access)

summary:
いま、二つの冷蔵庫がつながるーー。

冷蔵庫は別世界への扉だ。
2026年夏ーー食に無関心な大学生・上原夏樹の冷蔵庫が、料理代行をして暮らす会田栞のものと繋がった。"200km"先にいる知らない相手との冷蔵庫を通したやりとりは、料理を送ったり、文通をしたりという、すこし奇妙なもの。だが、そんな交流のなかで夏樹は、栞が抱えている大きなトラウマに触れることになる。2人の冷蔵庫が繋がった意味とは、一体ーー。
冷蔵庫の向こうへ、200km先へ、自分の声を届けるために。冷蔵庫の向こうにいたのが、あなたでよかった。

summary:
[결혼식 일주일 전, 도망간 약혼자의 동생인 다넬과 결혼하게 된 라우레아. 그러나 결혼생활 중 다넬의 비밀이 드러나는데…]

결혼식 일주일 전에 약혼자가 도망쳤다.
그래서 그의 동생과 결혼했다.

수도사였던 다넬 벨로체와는 도대체 서로 맞는 부분이라곤 하나도 없었다.
후계자를 만들기 위해 매일 밤 이어지는 의무적인 관계에서의 속궁합 빼곤.

환속한 수도사였던 그에게 큰 기대가 없었으나
난생 처음 섹스하다 기절한 그날 아침,
꽤 괜찮은 결혼을 했다고 생각했다.
어쨌든 결혼은 했으니까. 평생 이렇게 사는 것도 나쁘지 않을 것 같았다.
그렇게 생각했었다.

어느 늦은 밤, 남편이 내 가랑이를 빨며 자위하는 꼴을 보기 전까지는.

name: ひとりぼっちの惑星
Need for Seat
summary:
A fun kart(chair) racing game where you can drift in a chair, race through office hallways, and even use random power-ups.

Win the Race!
Grab your chair and fasten your shoelace! Race opponents and take the 1st place before they do. Drift through sharp corners, build up boost, and use random power-ups from Lucky Boxes to turn the race into pure chaos.

If It Has Wheels, You Can Drift It!
Drift = speed! Sharp turns everywhere? No problem. Use drifting to slide smoothly through tight corners and keep your momentum.

The longer you drift, the better it gets…

Lucky Box Power-Ups
Nothing is illegal if everyone’s doing it. Grab Lucky Boxes around the track to get random items that can help you win… or ruin someone else’s day.

Choose your chair & driver
Each chair and driver have their own unique perks and style. So pick your favorite and show off your racing personality while drifting past your opponents.

Various Race Tracks
Race through multiple unique race tracks full with weird obstacles, crazy jumps, and insane shortcuts as you race through.

name: ポケモン公式ぜんこく図鑑 1996-2026
summary:
※デザインは、予告なく変更になることがあります。

1996年のシリーズ誕生から2026年3月までの30年間で登場した全てのポケモンを完全収録した、まさに“決定版”といえる一冊だ。長年のファンはもちろん、これからポケモンの世界にふれる方にも最適な網羅性と保存性を兼ね備えた公式図鑑の誕生だ。

■本書の特長
・1025匹のポケモンを完全網羅：
2026年までのゲームに登場した全てのポケモンを掲載。

・見やすく、探しやすい構成：
ポケモンの進化の流れがよくわかる誌面構成。
ぜんこく図鑑ナンバー順で目当てのポケモンを探しやすいリストや50音順索引も充実。

・迫力あるポケモンのイラスト：
B5判型を活かして、ポケモンのイラストを迫力のあるサイズで掲載。

・最新データ（2026年3月末時点）に基づいた基本情報：
タイプ・分類・高さ・重さ・特性・隠れ特性・図鑑の説明文など、
ポケモンの基本情報を最新のデータにもとづき掲載。

・ポケモンの英語名：
1025匹のポケモンの英語名を掲載。
知的好奇心を満たしたり、海外のポケモンファンと交流したりと、様々な場面で活用できる。

・ポケモンの基本情報を解説したコラム：
「メガシンカ」や「ダイマックス」「リージョンフォーム」など、
ポケモンの世界の言葉を、ポケモン初心者向けに丁寧に解説。

※本誌に掲載しているポケモンの情報は、2026年3月末日時点のものです。

野生のポケモンやオヤブンなどの生息地が一目でわかる「ポケモン生息地図」をはじめ、
ヒスイ地方に散らばっている全てのともしびの位置がわかる「ミカルゲのともしび地図」、

公式イラストや印象的なセリフを楽しめる登場人物紹介ページも掲載!

モンスターボールごとの軌道の違いの解説からはじまり、ポケモンを捕まえやすくなるテクニック、さらに上級編としてポケモンの好むエサや道具を投げて捕獲する方法を解説!

ポケモン調査の起点となるコトブキムラの徹底ガイド。

過酷な自然が広がるヒスイ地方のフィールドで起こる現象をすべて紹介!
時間の流れ方や天候の移り変わり、ベースキャンプの使い方・設置方法を解説!
時空の歪みや大量発生は、出現するポケモンや手に入る道具を全公開!
戦闘を仕掛けてくるショウチクバイの解説もあり!

ポケモンや道具、人を探す任務の場合はイラストや地図を用いて、見た目にわかりやすく攻略方法を紹介!
サブ任務を引き受ける条件や報酬も完全網羅! これさえ読めば、全てのサブ任務を確実に達成できる!

エンドロール後の世界で登場する伝説のポケモンや、サブ任務で戦う伝説や幻のポケモンとのアクションバトルの攻略方法もすべて解説!

name: 獄門撫子此処ニ在リ (5) 我がいとしき怪物よ
name_cn: 狱门抚子在此 (5) 我挚爱的怪物啊
summary:
たとえその母が、にせものだとしても――。

いつものことである、はずだった。
アマナとともに「どうも呪われているらしい」という廃屋を訪れた撫子は、
子を求めるという怪異・姑獲鳥を斃す。
だが不思議なことにその骸は行方知れずで、自宅に帰った撫子が出逢ったのは。

「――おかえりなさぁ~い!」
「……えっ?」

見知らぬ「お母さん」だった。
生まれながらに親を焼かれた獄門撫子には居るはずもない母が、
いかにもお母さんといった風情でそこにいる。

撫子が斃した姑獲鳥の残滓であるらしい彼女は、
しかし全身全霊で撫子を愛そうとし、母を知らぬ撫子は戸惑うばかり。
やがて消えるはずなのに撫子に愛を与える「ウバメ」の在りようを、
アマナは『残酷な仕打ち』だと糾弾するが、
彼女もまた、ままならぬ想いにとらわれていた。

悩める彼女たちを嘲笑うように、人の域を外れた聖者達の野望が動き出す。
聖地・天橋立を舞台に、この世の秩序さえ作りかえることができるという大霊祭。
心を捨て去ろうとする者たちと対峙する中、互いへの想いゆえにすれ違う撫子とアマナ。
やがて冷たい海に墜とされる撫子に、いとしき怪物が差し出すものはーー。
うつくしくもおそろしい少女鬼譚、愛する人への想いが結ぶ、第五巻。

name: されど罪人は竜と踊る (0.9) It takes two to dance
summary:
すべてを失った二人は、それでも歩みだす

死闘の果てに師が倒れ、最愛の恋人は仇敵となり、少年は意識を消失したまま戻らない。すべてを失ったガユスとギギナは進むべき道に、生きる意味すら見失っていた。師の後継者の名前を巡り、エリダナに十二高弟という暴風が集う。不穏な情勢に乗じ、簒奪者たちも動きはじめていた。ギギナは因縁のアドゥンガの森から近い町に向かい、恩人と仇に出会うことになる。再び歩きはじめたガユスは、翠の宝玉を見つけるのだった。

【「されど罪人は竜と踊る」シリーズ】
量子干渉から物理効果を呼びだす〈咒式〉という技術が可能となり、人類は世界の大半を制した。東西文化が出会うエリダナの街で、咒式を戦闘に使う攻性咒式士たちが集う。不条理に迷いつづけるガユスと、相棒にして凶暴な美貌の剣士であるギギナが汚濁の街を歩む。咒式があろうと、人々は愛憎に突き動かされ、国家と企業の陰謀が吹き荒れ、人類と人類同士、さらに〈異貌のものども〉との対立は続く。暗黒ライトノベルの起点にして、ノワールファンタジー。物語は、胸を貫く展開と結末を紡いでいく。

name: 白き帝国 (7) 天空の決戦
summary:
犬村小六集大成、2か月連続刊行で完結へ!

「全ての色彩を重ね合わせると、白になる。ぼくが目指すのは、全ての種族が共に暮らす『白き国』だ」。リムノスの戦い以降、進撃をつづける白猫軍によって葡萄海の勢力図は大きく書き換わろうとしていた。衰退に歯止めがかからない黒薔薇騎士団は新たな騎士団長として「信」の継承者ルカマキオン公を叙任し、さらに三隻の飛行戦艦を就航させて反撃の機会をうかがう。一方、アテナ島で反乱を起こし行方をくらませたジャンジャックとアルテミシアは囚われのルシファーを救い出すため、羊飼いに変装してアルテミス島に潜入していた。再び「火の鳥」が使用可能となる六月一日を目処に、ジャンジャック率いる第三翼の将兵たちはアルテミス島に再結集し、黒薔薇騎士団の実権を奪う計画だが……。ついに迎えるクライマックスの前編! 2か月連続刊行で完結する、犬村小六の集大成・超大型ファンタジー戦記の結末を目撃せよ!

name: 変人のサラダボウル (10)
summary:
そして岐阜は神話となる――。

二年の時を経て、岐阜県ニューヨークにて対峙することになったサラとリヴィア。

その間にも、岐阜では様々な出来事が起きていた。
ブレンダと付き合うことになったものの惣助を取り巻く恋愛模様は落ち着くこともなく、友奈はアルバのせいでますます厄介な状況に追い込まれ、そして無敵の麒麟児は秘めたる想いに苦悩する。

異世界人たちや岐阜県人たち、それぞれの物語の行き着く先には、果たしてなにが待ち受けるのか。

人々が、世界が変わり続けるだけの、当たり前の日常群像喜劇、堂々完結。

そして岐阜は神話となる――。

name: 冷酷無慈悲な夫と身体が入れ替わったら、思ったよりも溺愛されていました
summary:
私たち、入れ替わってる!?

目が覚めると、夫と身体が入れ替わっていたーー。
入れ替わりをきっかけに、ヴィルから愛されていることを知ったミア。冷酷だと思っていた彼は、ちょっと天然で不器用な、一途な夫だったのだ。繰り返し起こる入れ替わりを隠しながら、少しずつ関係性を深めていく2人。だがそんなある日、何者かによってミアは誘拐されてしまう。果たしてヴィルは愛する妻を救えるのか……?
入れ替わっても、変わらない想いがある。
元・戦争の悪魔と可憐な令嬢。正反対の2人が紡ぐ、ピュアでスイートな入れ替わりラブストーリー。

name: 冷酷無慈悲な夫と身体が入れ替わったら、思ったよりも溺愛されていました (2)
summary:
入れ替わりのなか、妹がやってきてーー?

「近々そちらへ伺いますね」――ミアの妹・リリアから届いた一通の手紙。いまも変わらず入れ替わりが起きてしまうというのにどうしよう!おだやかな日々に訪れる変化や、 魔現象が起きている地域への遠征など、不安なことが起きるけれど、夫・ヴィルからの愛があるからきっと大丈夫。そして、遠征をとおして入れ替わり現象の原因を特定することはできるのか……?
キスで入れ替わってしまうのはなかなか厄介だけど、溺愛される毎日は愛おしくてあたたかい。あの子の恋の行方にも大注目(!?)な、入れ替わりラブコメ第二弾!

오로지 SNS로만 운영되는 한옥 카페‘호롱각'. 
그 정체는 탈주 초월자를 포획하는...아니, 보호하는 보호소다.

원래 제주도에서 농사 지으며 초월자들을 보살피던 마고가 
서울에서 힙한 카페(를 빙자한 보호소)를 운영하고 있는 이유는 
건물주이자 사장인 염라 때문이다. 
염라의 초월자 동지들을 돕자는 말에 착해빠진 마고 할머니가 홀라당 넘어간 것이다.

오랫동안 함께 해온 식솔 우진, 자청비와 함께 
우당탕탕 초월자 포획...아니, 보호에 앞서는 마고. 

어째서인지 사람 모습의 초월자보다 짐승 모습의 초월자가 더 많아 
마치 유기동물 보호소처럼 보이지만 어쨌거나 초월자 보호소의 목적은 지키고 있는 호롱각. 
초월자들을 찾고 보호하는 것은 힘들지만 보람차다. 

그러나 실질적 주인인 염라의 목적은 다르다.
과거에 인간에게 학대당한 탓에 인간을 너무 증오하는 그는 
자신과 비슷한 사상을 가진 초월자들을 찾아 인간 세상을 혼란에 빠트리고 싶어 한다.

하지만 그런 염라도 인간 소녀에게 마음이 흔들려버리고 마는데... 

호롱각이라는 카페를 중심으로, 찰나를 사는 생물들과
억겁을 떠도는 자들이 얽히고 설키는 이야기!

summary: You and your brother are trapped and need to escape at any cost. Overcome obstacles, solve puzzles and avoid being captured while devising a plan to escape the place. Freedom is within reach, but it will take intelligence and teamwork to achieve it.

name: Biomisland
summary:
BIOmISLAND is a relaxing minimalist nature builder game. Visit randomly generated islands and restore nature at your own pace using diverse plants at your disposal.

Biomisland is a relaxing minimalist nature builder game where your will restores nature using diverse plants at your disposal. You can play this game at your pace and unlock new biomes and plants to create the environment of your dream.

The game has been solo-developed as a side project by an enthusiastic programmer during about 2 years. It doesn't have the intention of being an AAA game. It just wants you to relax and have a good time shaping beautiful islands.

In Biomisland, your goal is to replenish the island nature by placing trees available in your inventory. 

Every time you place a new tree, you will receive points according to the numbers of blocks converted to the new biome. When placing trees next to each other, you can increase the land value of the terrain, the higher the value the more range your tree will have. 

Once you reach the current goal, you get to choose between two new biomes and you will receive new trees according to your choice. Use those new trees to get new points and continue your task. 

When most of the island is covered, you can access to the next island while keeping your current score and continue your adventure!

The game feature fully seed-based randomly generated islands. 

The cube-shaped islands come into three sizes (small, medium and large), and layout can vary a lot depending on the seed offering infinite possibilities. 

Islands are always created empty and it's your task to fill it as you wish using your imagination.

The game currently feature a total of 30 plants being part of 3 biomes:

 Forest biome

 Desert biome

 Tundra biome

Regularly during the game, you will be given the choice between multiple biomes to pick from. Use this decision wisely to receive the plants you need to create beautiful islands.

In this game there is no pressure, no time lim

These are stressful times to live in. Gas prices are light bills, light bills are rent prices, and rent prices are mortgage prices. Sometimes, you just need a way to escape. Sometimes, you just want to take a baseball bat and smash all of the china in the room. Sadly, doing these things in real life could land you in prison. But, this project rewards you for smashing the following:

Plates

Cups

Shot Glasses

Wine Glasses

Beer Bottles

Televisions

Computer Monitors

Glass Tables

Game Systems

Vases

& More

This game is a simple experience that randomly generates a room full of items for you to destroy.

name: K3LVN
summary:
K3LVN is a sci-fi action platformer where you play as an experiment trying to escape a space station lab where they’re being imprisoned. Through changing their state of matter, they can stick, jump, and roll their way to freedom.

K3LVN is a sci-fi action platformer where the player is a creature who’s been experimented on and is trying to escape the space station lab where they’re being kept. K3LVN is able to change their state of matter to alter their behavior. The three states usable are the Gel state which is the default bipedal state, the Liquid state which makes K3LVN smaller and grants the ability to climb on certain walls, and the Solid State, which turns K3LVN into a ball to roll around and gain momentum. They must use these abilities in combination with each other to traverse the environment as quickly as possible. 

K3LVN was developed by RNG Forge, a group of students at Florida Interactive Entertainment Academy (FIEA), over the course of eight months.

Key Features:

Play as K3LVN and master his ability to change his state of matter

Roll around the environment and gain momentum as a icy, solid ball

Run and wall jump as a slimy, bipedal experiment

Morph to your surrounds, climb walls, and squeeze through tiny gaps as a liquid blob

Test your wits in a series of puzzles that require quick thinking and even quicker reflexes

Enjoy a somber story about trust and understanding

Take in a beautiful art style with wonderfully rendered characters and breath-taking scenery 

Controllers, Keyboard and Mouse
This game is designed to be played by either a controller or mouse and keyboard. The controls for both may be viewed in-game using the options menu. Here is a list of hte controls

Spacebar/A - Jump, double jump, and wall-jump

WASD/Left Stick - Move forwards, left, backwards, and right

Mouse/Right Stick - Pan camera

Left Click/Left Trigger - Melt to Liquid State

Right Click/Right Trigger - Freeze to Solid State

name: The Appraiser
summary:
The Appraiser is a short, first person narrative game. As an art appraiser you will sell the art collection of a dying man. Each painting is by 4 famed artist. They have a story to tell you, but only if you choose to listen.

The Appraiser is a short story about an old man and his art gallery of four artist. You are an art appraiser requested to sell off the collection as the gallery shuts down. However, the old man is fond his curation and wishes you to judge these paintings a little differently...

Each painting contains a poem. A small peek at each artist's thoughts and feelings. As the appraiser, it is up to you to judge each piece of art. These glimpses may help you make your decisions.

Explore
This art gallery is not like many. It is rundown and is more akin to a house. As you explore the gallery, you may learn why that is.

Behind The Artist
Thanks to the old man, you have gained the power of intuition. You are now able to hear and see each artists thoughts and feelings. However, your power is limited and you won't have enough for each painting. Be careful choosing which piece you wish to learn more about.

Saying Goodbye
Your job is to sell these paintings. You don't need to sell all of them, but a certain amount is expected. Which paintings you wish to part with is up to you.

FAQ

How long is The Appraiser?
The Appraiser is a short game and will need to be replayed more than once. It will likely take most players a bit over an hour to 100% the game.

Is The Appraiser a horror game?
The Appraiser is not a horror game.

What kind of game is The Appraiser?
The Appraiser is an experimental narrative game similar to a walking simulator. If you enjoy unconventional storytelling and experimental game design, The Appraiser may be for you!

summary:

SHOOT YOUR FRIENDS
In the filthy backwaters of the Milky Way, gunslingers duel for fortune and fame. 

Every one of them is daring, dangerous, and...
DASTARDLY
Dastardly is a fast-paced and chaotic local multiplayer arena combat game for 1 to 4 players. Travel across the Milky Way to face down other bandits. Jump, dash, and shoot your way to victory, making use of an array of powerups like shields, cloaks, and jetpacks. Inspired by classic and modern couch multiplayer games, Dastardly has a focus on tight controls and fast matches. Load it up and shoot your friends from the comfort of your own home.
FEATURES

Local multiplayer for 2-4 players

Control over length and powerups for a variety of game modes

1-player time trial mode

8 levels on 2 different planets (more coming soon)

summary:
Arsilon - the adventure of astronaut Alice on another planet. After a crash landing, she needs to find and collect the lost spaceship components. On spacious maps, mortal dangers will lie in wait for her. To get to special places, you have to find a non-obvious path.

Explore a new world, collect components and artifacts, learn the history of the planet.

Using terrain orientation (open world) without an interactive map, you need to find and collect items. To get to some items, you will have to solve a logical problem in building a path (where to climb or jump). You need to be careful while traveling. You can crash, drown, die from unknown radiation. name: Basureroes: Invasion
summary:
《垃圾英雄团：异星入侵》是一款充满复古风格的 2D 横向滚动条动作游戏。一群拥有特殊能力的英雄将挺身而出，对抗邪恶的异星侵略者，并拯救世界！「冲刺、跳跃、战斗」，在二十个危机四伏的关卡中杀入敌阵，迎战强大的头目，展开一场史诗般的冒险！

疯狂的科学家－狄奥根尼博士再度现身！但这一次，真正的威胁却是来自于遥远的星际：一场企图征服地球的侵略行动即将展开！ 垃圾英雄团必须整装待发，奋勇迎战，再次把「垃圾」清理干净！

《垃圾英雄团：异星入侵》 将带你进入一场充满挑战与动作快感的冒险故事。「冲刺、跳跃、战斗」，在二十个危机四伏的关卡中杀出一条血路，迎战史诗级的强敌！你，准备好大显身手了吗？

特点

复古视觉风格，致敬经典动作横向滚动条游戏。

精准操作手感，结合怀旧美术与现代流畅玩法。

六大游戏模式，随剧情进度解锁：故事、竞速、对战、头目连战、生存以及训练模式。

四种游戏难度，成为真正的「英雄」！（可没你想的那么轻松！）

超过三十首原创曲目，融合古典与现代音乐元素。

充满魅力的角色与轻松诙谐的剧情，打造全年龄合适的超级英雄故事。

每位英雄各自都有独特的能力：冲刺、跳跃、滑行，这些都还只是冰山一角而已。

多达二十个环境丰富的关卡，遍布各种敌人与机关。

每个关卡内皆有一名强力头目，等你来挑战！

拯救关卡内的五名人质和一只迷路的小狗。这是身为英雄该做的事！

特殊关卡惊喜登场：驾驶宇宙飞船、狂飙摩托车、或是操控采矿车在洞窟内穿梭。

单机合作模式，最多可支持四名伙伴同乐！

name: Poker Loafer
summary:
一款可以让你在工作闲暇时放松的21点纸牌游戏。只有鼠标悬停时才会显示游戏界面，并且永远不会全屏或发出声音。在被发现之前打出最高分吧。

Poker Loafer是一款简单轻松的21点纸牌游戏，它旨在让游戏有机地融入办公室工作氛围，为紧张的现代大都市生活增加一丝调味。Poker Loafer只占据电脑画面的一角，并且只会在鼠标悬停时才会显示游戏界面。不像许多游戏，它没有全屏模式或背景音乐。这些设计旨在减少工作与游戏的冲突带来的不便。
21点游戏是一种经典的纸牌游戏，玩家需要让手牌的点数尽可能接近但不超过21点。在Poker Loafer中，玩家需要在21轮游戏中赢得尽可能多的分数。本游戏还提供+10和-10两种额外的牌堆选择。
游戏特色：
·可隐身和拖动的无边框游戏界面
·弹窗模式
·更快实现“退出游戏”
·畅玩经典纸牌游戏
·良心的定价
隐藏自己的全新方式
Poker Loafer无时无刻不在试图隐藏自己。一旦鼠标离开窗口，Poker Loafer就会转变为完全隐身的状态。
相比于使用右上角的“退出键”，利用鼠标移动退出游戏界面更迅速、更隐蔽，甚至不需要鼠标点击。

一旦鼠标返回窗口，玩家可以从离开的游戏进度继续游玩，不再需要担心“强退游戏”导致的进度丢失。
此外，Poker Loafer还使用了更低调的工具栏和桌面图标。

弹窗模式
激活弹窗模式后，鼠标离开窗口的操作将不会让Poker Loafer隐身；它的界面会被一张弹窗广告的图片替代。玩家可以在广告上随意移动鼠标，不用担心露出游戏界面；只有点击图片后才可以回到游戏界面。弹窗覆盖区域也包括Poker Loafer的标题栏。

可以在设置>ADS主题中替换将出现的弹窗广告图片。
取得高分
在Poker Loafer中，玩家需要在21轮游戏中赢得尽可能多的分数。除了一般模式，Poker Loafer还准备了多个有趣的模式以供游玩。

summary:
250年前的工业革命、120年前的电器革命、60年前的计算革命、30年前的信息革命，如今，智能革命正在发生，在这样一个时代背景下，数据的收集、分析，以及在艺术设计领域和产业中的释放，开始成为艺术与科技专业的研究重点。 作为艺术与科技专业的毕业设计，不仅展示设计成果，还需要从专业的角度充分地诠释对于这个时代的理解与主张。 该项目的主题是 “Creating the future” 正是对于智能革命正在发生的时代性做出的回应。

我们身处一个变革的时代，从工业革命到智能革命，科技的每一次飞跃都深刻影响了人类社会的发展轨迹。作为艺术与科技专业的毕业生，我们不仅要展示设计成果，更要传递对这个时代的深刻理解和独特主张。本次毕业展的主题“面向未来，Creating the Future”正是对智能革命时代的回应。

展览分为三大板块：艺术与智能科技、艺术与系统科技、艺术与展示科技。我们将通过这三个板块，深入探索智能原理、材料元素、数字信息领域的交互体验和智能系统，以人工智能、大数据为引领，进行基于“设计人文”的智能与系统艺术实验。我们的研究目标聚焦于智能、系统的科技创新与艺术创意，涵盖智能服务、系统设计、数字信息实践等多个领域，为未来的艺科融合探索更多可能性。

在智能革命浪潮中，我们关注到高速公路服务区作为城市间交通的重要节点，其智能化升级具有巨大的潜力。当前，多数服务区在资源利用、信息整合和服务提升等方面存在不足。为此，我们设计了一款面向物联网时代的高速公路服务区智能管理系统。

该系统以智能决策、优化管理、提升服务为核心，通过整合海量数据，实现万物互联，支撑智能系统做出合理决策。我们深入研究了管理需求，设计了物联网数字孪生系统，以推进服务区的智能化管理。同时，我们也关注游客需求，优化出行流程，创造更加舒适、便捷的消费环境。

本次设计的重点之一是智慧决策模块，它能够帮助消费者在旅途中做出更加全面、合理的行程规划，有效平衡复杂系统内各参与者的需求。另一重点则是数字孪生控制台，我们针对服务区运营需求进行了深入调查，设计了适合应用场景的控制台，以解决复杂系统管理难题。

通过本设计，我们旨在为高速公路服务区的数字化发展、AI智能决策提供坚实基础，同时降低管理成本、提升效率、改善运营状况，并为游客提供更加优质、便捷的服务体验。我们相信，这一设计将为高速公路服务区的经济发展带来更多可能性，也为我们艺术与科技专业的毕业生提供了一个展示才华、贡献社会的平台。

name: SCP: EVENT CLASSIFIED
summary:
SCP: EVENT CLASSIFIED 是一款多人恐怖射击游戏，玩家可以扮演士兵、囚犯、科学家，甚至是怪物，并在这个多达120名玩家的神秘设施中与其他玩家殊死一搏或合作生存。

SCP: EVENT CLASSIFIED 是一款独特的恐怖射击游戏，玩家可以扮演士兵、囚犯、科学家，甚至是怪物，并在这个神秘的设施中与其他玩家殊死一搏或合作生存。

每个角色都有自己的任务，这些任务将不可避免地与其他角色的任务产生交集。是合作共赢还是一决生死，完全取决于玩家自己。

无论你与其他人的互动如何，你都将始终被充满敌意的异常现象和危险的环境所困扰。

游戏特色

 可重复游戏性
不仅地图每一轮都会重新洗牌，而且物品、异常、甚至角色的任务都会有所不同

 社交伪装系统
你可以找到各种衣服，甚至从其他玩家（可能是已经死掉的）那里偷他们的衣服。是的，比如囚犯可以伪装成科学家来欺骗士兵。但可别忘了，怪物不会在乎它们杀死的是谁。

 动态角色关系

每个角色都有自己的服装和与其他角色的关系。如士兵会杀死囚犯并营救科学家，怪物会攻击所有人，而这些规则每一轮都会改变。

 恰到好处的硬核

用弹匣装填弹药而不是直接换弹，用量表记录疼痛值而不是简单的生命值，用头盔和防弹背心来规避伤害而不是护甲值，除此之外还有其他有趣而真实的细节。要活下去可没那么容易。总之，选择正确的道具和战术才能让你有一线生机。

 电力系统
想要锁上几扇门？或者放置窃听器？或者不用钥匙卡就能打开大门？不用多说了！只需找到所需的工具并摧毁一些机器人吸尘器即可。

 怪物不是唯一的威胁
没有人想死，叛徒可能隐藏在任何一个角落。和你一样，其他玩家为了生存也会不择手段。与你的盟友保持紧密联系——也可能是潜在的叛徒

name: 剑冢
summary:
单机+塔防+肉鸽+防守+打书+养成于一体的上头抓宝宝游戏.挑战30天做完_独立游戏大赛作品

当我认真开始做的时候。团队的解散了。
游戏目前制作内容仅有:
1、抓宠物-宠物宝宝随心抓
50+种族宠物，有无忧无虑的小精灵、蛮族部落的半兽人、入侵世界的膏达、统领军队的骑士长……这些宠物中有一定几率变异、红名、闪耀，它们是战斗时的主力军。
2、宠物养成-策略搭配
各类宠物都有各自的专长，并根据先天资质分为7种评级。每一类宠物都有达到最高资质评级的可能。根据成长加点，技能学习、普攻需求属性会有各种各样的搭配组合。这是玩家们经常讨论的话题，有着意想不到的养成乐趣。
3、技能任意组合-浩瀚的可能
游戏内有400+技能，各种技能之间搭配组合，碰撞出别致的火花，产生不同的流派。根据不同的敌人有不同的技能搭配选择性针对，发挥你的想象力吧。
4、抽技能-非欧一瞬间
有人欢喜有人愁，辛苦刷钱数小时，一朝抽奖定非欧，有人为抽不出关键技能忧愁，有人忧愁顶级技能如何用光，没有保底就是这么真实！
5、死亡肉鸽-每一次死亡都会让你更加强大
死亡是一次新生，一旦接受了自己的软弱，那你就是无敌的！
6、副本
副本不仅有丰厚的奖励，也是输出和抵抗的测试场，想知道自己的极限吗？无穷无尽的怪物在等你出现，强大的boss会把你撕成碎片。
7、合宠+孵蛋
培养更优质宠物

Fight for your life against decades of bad parenting & education that has physically manifested into a skateboard-swinging, feces-flinging horde of undead rage!

name: Death Dungeon
summary:
《死亡地牢》是一款策略型的弹幕射击游戏，你需要合理的选择并运用双武器及双技能，去和地牢中随机生成的敌人进行战斗，以最小的生命损失击杀掉房间所有敌人。

游戏介绍：
《死亡地牢》是一款策略型的弹幕射击游戏，你需要合理的选择并运用双武器及双技能，和地牢中随机生成的敌人进行战斗。通过释放技能来减少敌人造成的伤害，同时最大化自身的输出，这样才能使得生命值损失最小。
武器：
游戏中有多种不同特点的武器，主要分为单体攻击与穿透攻击，适当使用穿透攻击武器击中多个精英敌人会更好。
技能：
精英敌人的攻击几乎是必中的，因此你需要选择并合适的技能来减少精英敌人造成的伤害。技能主要有位移、控制、击退、隐身、躲避、摧毁弹幕、打断攻击等机制。
敌人：
敌人分为普通敌人和精英敌人，高层的精英敌人的攻击会带有击退、减速、沉默、眩晕或致盲等效果，部分房间的精英敌人会获得高速、隐身、瞬移、反击、回血等被动效果。
战前选择：
进入房间之前，打开背包，选择克制房间中精英敌人的技能。
战中操作：
运用你的高超操作精准命中敌人，拉扯游走并规避敌人的攻击。
战后提升：
战斗结束后你的血量会回满，可在商人处购买属性提升或者被动效果。
难度提升：
通关当前难度后即可解锁下一个难度。难度越高或层数越高，敌人攻击频率也越高，偶尔需要使用一次技能规避两次敌人的攻击。

name: Project Nautilus
summary:
A first person exploration game set in the not so distant future. Remote operate a drone to explore this newly discovered cave system. Use tools to break away obstacles and propel your way down to find what lies below these long forgotten caves.

Features of this Game

Immersive Drone HUD

Expansive World

Narrative Rich Immersion

Hello Drone Operator #4861!
Hello, and welcome to the Isthmus Corporation Family. My name is PASSION and I will be your managerial AI, and I will help oversee your work. We would like to remind you everything that you are seeing is confidential and would like to remind you of the NDA you signed at this time. Now let us begin what is Project Nautilus.
What to expect
Project Nautilus is a first-person underwater exploration game where you, a menial drone operator, navigate through the depths as directed by your employer, the shady mega-corporation, Isthmus Corp. As Isthmus Corporation lays claim to a previously undiscovered cave system deep below the surface, you are assigned to survey the hidden caverns and uncover their secrets. You are entrusted to expand the company’s wireless network with the placing of signal beacons as you explore. Your “trusty” managerial AI, PASSION, guides you to use your drone harpoon and drill to break open pieces of the environment and propel yourself further down into the depths below. As you explore the rich, biodiverse cave network you begin to discover remnants of a lost civilization and cultural artifacts including sculptures, etchings, and even old architecture. However, you must remember your one goal from Isthmus Corp., reach the bottom of this cave system and see what lies below.

summary:
《挖掘机大战挖掘机》是一款围绕矿石争夺的组队竞技游戏，玩家非常容易上手，绝对公平，并且只需要六分钟即可完成对战。玩家之间组成小队，挖掘和垄断地图资源，使用强大的火力，狠狠的教训你们的对手。不同的挖掘机搭配不同的武器；通过运用丰富的战术配合，与小队打出令人惊叹的成绩。

产品概述
作为Gang Studio处女作，《挖掘机大战挖掘机》这款产品与他的名字一样，简单粗暴；没错，仅需玩家操纵挖掘机在一个地图中与其他玩家围绕矿石争夺进行大乱斗。此次EA版本没有冗余复杂的养成线，没有花里胡哨的多余系统，打开游戏，即开即打，六分钟一把。
或许此次EA版本的内容还不够完善，美术还不够优秀，但是在战斗体验上，我们觉得这个版本已经实现了玩家之间的对局体验；这也是我们想通过steam发布这个EA版本，近距离的听到玩家的反馈与建议，来协助我们更加完善的持续迭代这款产品。

争夺矿石
◆采集石矿、金矿、钻石矿等地图有限资源，获取更多的能源。
◆中心点将会随着时间推移，刷新各种高级矿石。
◆当高级矿石刷新时，请与团队一同前往争夺，这是非常稀有的资源。

挖掘机
◆目前版本已完成20台挖掘机的设计与开发。
◆每台挖掘机拥有自己的专属武器，武器释放需要采集矿石获得的能源。
◆AOE、追踪、激光、冲击、隐形地雷、炮台、导弹等等将搭载在不同的挖掘机上。

房间对局
◆目前通过开房间的方式进行对局。
◆开房间可自行邀请好友一起开黑或者SOLO。
◆房间最高限制人数为6V6，房主也可自定义双方队伍人数后开启游戏。

游戏时长
◆每局对战不超过六分钟。
◆提前击溃对方全部挖掘机也可直接结束。
◆每次进入地图时，需要加载下地图资源，耗时较短。

本次EA版本大概就是以上内容，我们没有做任何买断及付费的内容，如同初衷所述，我们希望玩家可以在我们游戏中找到简单直接的快乐，也希望能得到你们真实的建议和反馈！

如有BUG反馈或疑问，可直接在社区中心中反馈，我们都能看得见！

官方QQ群：783811034 （欢迎加入）

VICE Undercover是一部1980年代的毒枭惊悚片，只有从内部才能瓦解丧心病狂的卡特尔。你必须成为卧底，揭露卡特尔，化解这场毒品战争。

在另一个1980年代的迈阿密，早期万维网的建立，使犯罪帝国破天荒头一次得以在全球范围内实时运作，而且是全天候24小时开放。互联网连接起了整个世界，然而黑暗的网络使犯罪活动蔓延开来，几乎无从探察。这便是所谓的毒品交易黄金时代。

卡特尔在其合法的办公大楼工作里安设匿名计算机操作员来管理业务：转移资金、收集情报、贿赂政府官员、雇佣打手、建立点击数和促成新交易等等。

身为一名警察，你将担任其中一名操作员进行卧底。你的时间不多，但却必须了解卡特尔的运作方法，干扰他们的计划，从内部瓦解他们的恐怖统治。

欢迎来到1980年代霓虹灯下的迈阿密

VICE Undercover沉浸在独特的1980年代的迈阿密氛围中，从过场动画、新闻报道到一入耳便引人入胜的配乐，应有尽有。 

感受互动式毒枭惊悚片中的危机四伏

卡特尔可谓是无孔不入，而且他们利用互联网，变得比以往任何时候都更强大、更致命。身为一名卧底特工，你始终身处危险之中，每天，你都要徘徊在警察与罪犯之间，稍有差池便万劫不复。在这个充满毒品和金钱的世界里，你不能相信任何人。

探索80年代标志性的计算机系统

Amigo操作系统是你进入复杂而隐秘的卡特尔世界的窗口。这里有1980年代操作系统所需的一切（还有 Calypso音乐播放器陪着你）等等。耳朵里听着软盘发出的咔咔声，时光倒回从前！

name: 洪荒五行界
summary:
此游戏为MMORPG,最多八人组队,可以加入公会,可以交易。玩家之间可以互相pk，安全区基本很少，模拟洪荒时期争夺，暂时没有单独掉落。境界体系2种：1为普通经验升级。2为度过雷劫，分为地仙、天仙、玄仙、太乙散仙、金仙、大罗金仙、准圣、圣人、天道，人物每10级度过雷劫晋升为下一级，每一级差距非常大，基本为10倍差距也就是玄仙可以的攻防血为地仙的100倍，雷劫总共9个等级，度过后加成不一样。总共有5系技能金木水火土：金主攻击，木主全体buff和群加血，水主加血控制，火群里buff和攻击，土主防御和控制，玩家初始可以至少选一系，每多一系最终伤害会减少50%。法力也很重要：法力消耗=最终伤害值。

故事

古往今来，修仙者终极目的是什么呢？逍遥？长生？求道？至高者鸿钧合天道他的欲望是什么呢？
终于鸿钧合天道终有私心，大道不许，于是鸿钧开启无量量劫重演混沌。
不知过了多久，混沌开始孕育神魔。一点灵光浮现，随着一声叹息，洪荒圣人也出现在了混沌之中...

简介

本人是修仙小说爱好者，曾经想象着纵横天地任逍遥的快感，但是终归没有实现，于是我就想着创建一个属于我的世界，一个可以纵横天地的世界。于是这款游戏“洪荒五行界”应运而生，游戏的本质是让更多的玩家加入，成为一个第二世界。
 背景：鸿钧重启混沌，玩家进入混沌空间中通过收集大道碎片获得道力加成，度过天劫到达天道境界前10人将争夺‘混沌青莲’认主的机会，‘混沌青莲’认主之后玩家可以选择：1.开辟洪荒世界。2.打碎混沌青莲，挑战大道。开辟洪荒世界那个玩家将和洪荒世界的名字一致：例如玩家叫‘盘古’，那么新洪荒世界为‘盘古界’，如果挑战大道成功将成为大道之主。
 特色：怪物属性非常高，玩家要通过组队来打怪。有大量的世界BOSS要通过公会一起才能打败，掉落属性非常高的混沌宝物。渡劫时期由于分为一九到九九的九种天劫，后面几种天劫伤害非常高必须通过其他玩家帮助才能度过。人物立绘自由选择：玩家可以自由设置查看装备时的立绘，所有立绘都是由高品质的画师来制作完成。五种法则亲和 ：类似门派系统，玩家初始可以自由选择金木水火土五种法则亲和，每多一系玩家伤害会降低50%,因为每多一系玩家技能会多一倍，玩家自由定制防御、攻击、控制、恢复属于自己的玩法，五系全选的话后期会增加时空法则，但是前期人物只有其他人1/5伤害要慎重选择。拥有神魔两种体质：神族法天象地，魔族天魔解体。升级系统分为经验等级和渡劫等级：现实中经历和修炼会积累法力就相当于道行这部分就是经验等级，渡劫之后才是我们真正的等级，分为地仙、天仙、玄仙、太乙散仙、金仙、大罗金仙、准圣、圣人、天道。渡劫完成后每一级差距非常大，每一级差别10倍，例如玄仙为地仙属性的100倍。无缝大地图，场景切换无读取。
 游戏开发：组队、交易、道侣、公会、世界频道、怪物掉落、渡劫、副本、装备系统、炼丹、商城、道力附体 以上都已完成。立绘选择、游戏对话、游戏CG、自由视角飞行、自由视角的玩家技能、自由视角的元神离体待开发。
 周期：前期会发布一个测试版，以供测试。然后发布一个不删档测试版，会发布大部分已完成的功能。

加入我们

加入官方QQ群：
1018344753

在此感谢

排名不分先后
立绘画师：碧海潮生-ESSE、十四轩-雾里、金风细雨-青天
背景画师：画不来-小郎君、画不来-洛雨玄、三台令-乍见之

关于游戏
这个一个纵横混沌时期，争夺认主混沌青莲，开辟'洪荒'的游戏。游戏中讲述了上个时期为何开启了无量量劫，是怎样的一段关于爱情和友情的故事。后面会演变为洪荒时期，登场洪荒时期的各路大神。
 游戏中通过击杀道孽获取大道碎片以合己身，然后度过天劫来晋级。
 是一款MMORPG游戏，玩家要通过组队来完成各种任务和击杀道孽，拥有精美的立绘和漂亮的引导者。

name: Delilah
summary:
Eastern Europe is the newest Circle of Hell, but outside its walls things aren't much better. Relentless action, pixelated gore, 256 colors. That is Delilah. And yeah, it is inspired by other shooters starting with a 'D'.

Delilah is an old-school FPS set in a world divided between Humanity and Hell. Its main goal is to capture the magical formula of the great classics.

Seven episodes (planned), each with a distinct theme and story

Authentic 2.5D graphics in 256 colors, multi-directional monster sprites

MIDI tunes emulating sounds straight from the 90's

Custom game engine that supports 3d and dynamic level geometry

A century ago a great hero has saved our species by closing the gates of Hell, but the billions of demons already on Earth didn't just magically disappear. Instead, while Humanity was slowly reconquering the planet, several Arch Devils have adapted to the rules of our dimension. They formed their own twisted governments (known as Circles), to use their populations as human shields. 

Our two protagonists were born into this century-long cold war: one is an enforcer of the Transylvanian Daemocratic Circle, the other is an Anointed defender of Humanity.

Borington is a one-person game development team from Transylvania. My previous games include 'BlackChain' and 'Rum & Gun', both available on Steam.

name: Youmandriver
summary:
Take on the Youmandriver challenge: a demanding simulation and management game. Face dense traffic on narrow roads with ultra-realistic vehicle physics. Choose your missions, manage your career and budget. Experience intense and authentic driving !

Youmandriver: An Unprecedented Simulation and Management Challenge

Welcome to the world of Youmandriver, a simulation and management game where every decision matters. Here, you are not just a driver, but the master of your destiny on narrow and unpredictable roads.

Ultra-Realistic Physics:
At the heart of Youmandriver lies meticulously crafted vehicle physics. Feel every turn and maneuver as if you were truly behind the wheel, with realistic responses to traffic conditions and terrain variations.

Strategic Mission Choices:
Each mission you choose - be it Speed, Comfort, Ecology, or Safety - shapes your journey. These choices are not just cosmetic; they define your gameplay style and challenges.

Ultimate Reality Mode:
For those seeking an even greater challenge, Ultimate Reality Mode offers an experience where every mistake can have lasting consequences. A crash might mean the permanent loss of a client, adding a layer of tension and urgency to every trip.

Career and Budget Management:
Beyond driving, Youmandriver puts you in control of your career. Manage financial aspects such as vehicle upgrades, maintenance, insurance, and fuel. Each decision impacts your path to success.

An Adventure in a Near-Future World:
Explore a near-future world where most cars are driven by autonomous AIs. This unique backdrop adds an extra dimension to your driving experience, skillfully blending reality and foresight.

Conclusion:
Youmandriver is not just a game; it's an invitation to master the most demanding roads, make wise decisions, and experience an intense and authentic driving adventure. Join us on these winding roads and show what you are capable of !

name: Caddywack
summary:
Caddywack is an arcade driving game that blends taxi missions with trick combos, drifting, boosting, and aerial stunts inside a stylized open-world city built for score chasing.

Overview:

Caddywack is an arcade open-world driving game where you pick up passengers, race through city districts, and chain skate-style jumps, drifts, and aerial tricks into combo multipliers across a compact sandbox built for fast, skill-based score chasing.

Design:

Caddywack blends arcade driving, taxi missions, and trick-based combo scoring inside a dense open world designed for flow. Players accept passenger jobs, choose their own routes, drift through tight streets, launch off ramps, perform aerial and wall-based tricks, and maintain momentum to extend combo multipliers while racing against the clock. The core appeal centers on responsive controls, boost-driven speed, route optimization, and replayable high-score mastery, combining the freedom of open-world driving with the expressive trick chaining of skate-inspired arcade games.

name: Maku
summary:
Battle and survive through an endless swarm of monsters! Maku is a bullet hell survival game where you power-up your character with weapons and upgrades to defeat increasingly stronger enemies that await you!

Survive the swarm!

Maku is a bullet hell survival experience where anyone can pick up and play. Delve into various worlds to fight your way through thousands of monsters and grow in power!

Inverted Bullet Hell
Intuitive movement-focused controls allow you to focus on dodging and weaving through your enemies while you fire your weapons at the swarm. Coordinate your positioning to align with your firing patterns and timing to maximize your damage.

Power-Up!
Obtain new weapons and upgrades to create powerful builds and experiment with diverse synergies in order to defeat the world boss before time runs out. Collect coins along the way to unlock permanent upgrades and improve your future runs. Defeat bosses and complete challenges to unlock characters for your roster and progress to new worlds with increasing difficulty.
Increasingly Difficult Challenges!
Complete levels and challenges to unlock the skill-testing challenge modes, Hardcore and Demon mode. Alter your experience with the Endless and Turbo modes. See how long you can survive and farm permanent upgrades in Endless mode. Shorten run times and test your reflexes with Turbo mode.

name: Nine Lives or Less
summary:
Nine Lives or Less is a rogue-like action game about a cat going on an adventure with a special jetpack.

Have you ever asked yourself: what if a cat has a jetpack and goes on an adventure? Well, probably not, but here we are anyway ?. Make your way down a dark and dangerous land full of menacing creatures that can and definitely will hurt you. Destroy these creatures, earn tokens, die, and...do it all over again because this game is a roguelike ?. But hey, don't fret. Your earned tokens can be used to permanently unlock customization for our lovely cat so that the next time you die, you will at least die in style ?.

Multi-purposed Jetpack: A movement utility? A weapon? How about both? Use the jetpack wisely to battle against these creatures or run away from them, your choice: fight or flight.

Unique Customization: You can unlock customization skins inspired by some of pop culture's most famous (or infamous) cats. Who are they? You'll have to find out.

Boss Fights and Secrets: As you venture deeper and deeper into the unknown land, more, let's say, curious creatures will stand in your way. Use the experience you've gained to defeat them ✊.

name: Hop For The Best
summary:
A clay styled frog platformer. Hop, climb, dash and sprint your way through 10 clay worlds in "classic platformer mode" or put your skills to the test in "challenge mode" with hard precision platformer gameplay. With no attacks and worlds filled with obstacles, all you can do is... Hop For The Best!

A small clay frog in a big clay world. Hop for the Best is a clay style platformer intended for players looking for a challenge (Don't worry there's a kid's mode for the little ones too)

Hop, climb, dash and sprint your way through 10 clay worlds. With no attacks and worlds filled with obstacles, all you can do is... Hop For The Best!

Game modes:

Standard mode - 10 levels and only one life to make it through them all, can you make it to the end?
Kid's mode - 10 levels with decreased difficulty, checkpoints, and easily obtainable extra lives for the kids. (or for the adults that aren't in a mood for a challenge)
Challenge mode - 50 short precision platformer style levels to try over and over until you get the satisfaction of making it through unscathed.

name: 三国英雄坛
summary:
这是一款开放式文字策略模拟游戏，没有特定的路线，可以达成成就，也可以冲击结局。 游戏的方向都由玩家自己来定，招募想招募的人物，收集喜欢的道具。

本游戏是单机游戏，购买可以解锁所有游戏本体的内容，包含经典模式所有的结局和成就都能达成。

游戏是文字类游戏，通过文字表达角色、任务、战斗、收集等等。

所有游戏中的历史人物，都可以收为队友，可以之战斗，所有能想到的人物，都可以去挑战！

游戏背景是三国，在这里，打败吕布、左慈完成战神，并不是最终目的。

可以完成霸业，也可以完成其他的结局，是的，这是个多结局游戏。

喜欢收集成就的，有几十个成就等待您来达成！

喜欢人物鉴赏的，几百个人物全部招募。

所有人的武器都能掉落，当然，要方天画戟、赤兔，还是要有一番准备的！

我们这个游戏非常适合觉得无聊，想打发时间的朋友。

name: Jigsaw Puzzle - Swingers Party
summary:
Challenging jigsaw puzzles, featuring adult images of 2 couples at a swingers party on a yacht.

Features:

12 different puzzles to solve, which present a mini novel in images

Timer, to see how long it takes to solve a puzzle

Gallery where you can view all the puzzle images you have solved.

Relaxing background music to match the theme and mood.

Be among our most engaged players to achieve a top spot in our Leaderboards and unlock various achievements.

name: Boiling Point: Road to Hell
summary:
Saul Myers 重返战场，并准备好与世界对抗，救回他的女儿。你有能力完成他的任务吗？

“我们会在不同的温度下沸腾” - Ralph Waldo Emerson

最初发布于 2005 年的 Boiling Point: Road to Hell 回归了。重温这款开放世界角色扮演第一人称射击类型游戏的早期先驱作品。在发现自己的女儿在伪南美国家雷利亚被绑架后，法国外国军团的老兵 Saul Myers 必须前往雷利亚执行营救任务。Saul 必须穿越雷利亚山谷，那是一个充满热带丛林、农场、村庄和庄园的地区。Saul 现在必须设法穿越这片土地。同时在危险的局面中与腐败政客和犯罪组织周旋，并寻找女儿的下落。

管理你的声誉。游戏中没有直接的敌人，但一切都取决于你的玩法。尽管雷利亚有着危险的自然生态环境，是毒蛇和大型肉食动物的家园，但 Saul 还要努力维系与六个派系的关系。这些关系一开始是中立的，完成任务可以提高或降低你在雷利亚政府、游击队、黑手党、土著部落、强盗集团甚至中央情报局中的声誉。但要小心，建立盟友可能会导致其他派系的不安并树敌。

在这个广阔的世界里书写你自己的命运

超过 240 平方英里（450 平方公里）- 受到每一个决策和行动的影响

驾驶卡车和坦克；驾驶直升机、飞机和船只

可选择大量可升级武器

与警察、游击队、南美黑手党、中央情报局等结盟或对立

Demon dogs from the Underworld will attempt to attack you, but you can shoot them with bubbles to clear the way! How long do you think you can you last?

Game Controls:

Enter: Shoot

VHS Setting: Click the VHS icon

Leave: Esc or X

Have fun! <3

summary:
《消除迷宫》作为一款回合制类Rogue奇幻游戏，融入了三消元素，赋予了玩家许许多多克服难题的办法！这么多原生魔能等你调用，除了拳打脚踢，还有很多手段可以对付来自其他位面的怪物！

《消除迷宫：异境入侵》大胆融合了回合制类Rogue角色扮演游戏的元素与三消游戏的网格设计，几位主角将要勇闯城堡，面对随处可见的原生魔能和异位面生物。每个回合仔细观察敌人的行动，是上前发动物理攻击？还是站在远处，通过融合、消除魔能，施放元素魔法？时间紧迫，墙上奇怪的传送门源源不断出现敌人，每一次行动都要谨慎考虑。

不过城堡现在情况危急，所有房间均已封锁。你不仅要击败敌人，还要解除神奇的入侵警报系统。要想清除房间的危险，就要揭示地上的符文，轰击蕴含魔能的晶石，踩下地板升起的按钮。只是事情好像很有蹊跷，因为城堡的防御系统非常精密，应该不只是为了防止喵咪法师入内寻找《喵灵之书》……

再提醒一句！很多房间都被元素力量占领了。千万小心，不然就有可能从岩浆界域直接滑进寒冰火山位面，还有一定避开蒸汽位面的超热气体。进入沼泥方格之前，一定记得先要把它们清理干净。不过，这些东西能影响你……也就能影响你的敌人！有机会的话，也可以把它们引入陷阱。
游戏特色

战斗基于回合进行，场景由网格构成，关卡布局与物品随机生成。故事发生在城堡之中，这里似乎到处都是来自火、气、土、水等元素位面的怪物。

游戏采用元素魔能三消系统，你能控制城堡随处可见的原生魔能。六种特殊的消除能力任你选择，改变游戏的玩法。利用时间道具停住时间，定住敌人，或者利用百搭魔能，成为连消大师。召唤可以发射能量的猫猫，或者炸掉魔能，引发连环爆炸！

六个角色，六种特殊的技能、长处和玩法。地城兔子身手灵敏，喵咪法师召唤猫猫，圣武犬持盾冲击！各个角色还有各种专精，每个回合可以行动多次！

一百多种咒术和物品供你选择，可以不同的方式克服游戏的难题。许多咒术和物品能够提升你的属性或元素伤害，还有一些物品可以提取咒术！如果背包没有空了，也可以丢掉物品，只记住物品所含的咒术！

 面对元素界域的20多个头目，每个都有各自的攻击模式和弱点！躲避寒凉大蛇的冰雪轰击！打断砂浆狮蝎的砂浆袭击！避开利岩浆坦的岩浆冲撞！

掌控周围的元素，为你所用。消耗魔能，召唤旋风，然后消除火魔能，产生连锁闪电！或者将房间变成多土的环境，然后将水魔能变成泥沼陷阱！

踏上冒险旅程，体验意想不到的故事，起初明明只是普普通通的营救行动，后续却急转直下，情节发展令人匪夷所思！

Round Table is a fun virtual reality action game for everyone! You are a knight of King Arthur's Round Table practicing swordplay in preparation for a big tournament. The wizard Merlin was kind enough to conjure up a training course for you, right in King Arthur's throne room! Grab a sword and get to it. How many rounds of Merlin's parcour can you do?
Gameplay
Select competitive mode, grab a sword (or two!) and start hitting the training dummies Merlin has summoned for you. One hit and they fall over. Hit all the training dummies in the throne room to advance to the next round. But be careful not to run out of time! Each round Merlin is going to conjure up more and more training dummies. At the same time, you have less time to hit them all. Luckily you get a little bit of extra time from removing a training dummy. How many rounds can you last?

Round Table also features two other game modes: arcade/casual and sandbox. There is no score counting or high score tracking in arcade/casual or sandbox game mode.
Arcade/Casual Mode
If you want to just enjoy the game world without a ticking clock, pick the casual mode. There is no time limit, and you can play for as many rounds as you like.
Sandbox Mode
In the sandbox game mode you can set your own challenge! You get most of the dials and gauges that we use to balance the competitive game mode. Make the game as easy or as difficult as you like! And if you find the right setting for your flow, share it with us on Discord!

name: Cardterrupters
summary:
Break into a turn-based deckbuilder where turns aren't guaranteed. Race forward on the offensive to act before the enemy, Breaking their skills and Interrupting their turn.

Command the flow of battle in a time based deckbuilder, where cards come with a Cast Time instead of an energy cost. The combined Cast Time of your cards dictates how long it'll take to cast and unleash their effects. But don't worry, you have as much time as you want to plan your turn.

Perfectly timing attacks to hit enemies as they're casting Breaks the skill they were about to use, removing it from their turn. Break all of an enemy's upcoming skills to Interrupt them, skipping their turn entirely! Keep the momentum going by consistently Interrupting enemies, softening them up for a swift victory!

Explore a colourful world which is being turned into a board game by the nefarious Board Master. Bucking the trend of all 3 acts being the same every time, the areas in Cardterrupters can appear in any order, keeping repeat plays fresh!

Features:

A deckbuilder with speed. Consider your cards' casting time, as well as how close the enemies are to attacking, whilst deciding your next step.

A turn-based game where enemy turns can be shortened and cancelled entirely through clever aggressive play.

Each Cardterrupter has their own focus in battle, bringing unique cards and charms to build powerful deck synergies.

Navigate 3D levels instead of choosing nodes from a 2D flowchart, but watch out for traps.

Each area has unique foes to battle and can be encountered in any order during a run, perfect for repeat playthroughs.

A upbeat and energetic soundtrack to shuffle your hands whilst you shuffle your hands

Welcome To Your New Life

In the near future, Earth Online (E-ON) is the world’s most popular social media metaverse. Users are able to log in with their verified E-ON headsets and Be Who They Really Are. Spend your entire day in E-ON- attending business meetings and working “on-site” in Business Zones, or hanging out with friends across Casual Zones built by other E-ON users. Once you log off, your A.R., Artificial Replicae, will continue to chat, play games, and expand your E-ON presence.

For unverified guest users such as yourself, E-ON will match you with a random user to chat with. Develop a friendship, explore the platform, and find out why E-ON will be your new home away from home.

----------

E-ON is a narrative-focused “social media exploration” game, inspired by Serial Experiments Lain and the optimistic vision of the internet during the early 2000’s. Re-experience the thrill of navigating an unfamiliar platform for the first time as you learn the tricks and features of Earth Online. However, as an “unverified user”, players can only interact with a limited slice of the platform. By working together with Ellie, the A.R. you are matched with, players will stretch the limits of their account and learn about Ellie and the world she has made her home.

 Connect with Ellie through hundreds of lines of dialogue.

减少、再利用和回收
你有没有想过每天有多少垃圾被回收？你知道这个过程是怎样的吗？让我们从头开始进行梳理。首先，垃圾必须……分类！

成为一名专业的垃圾分类员，在这款快节奏的游戏中改变世界。 负责回收的第一个也是最重要的阶段 - 分类。 将塑料与玻璃分开，将纸张与金属分开，将可回收材料与不可重复使用的废物分开。

保持冷静，并找到贵重物品！
回收不是一次性的交易。您要做的是仔细观察分拣带，以免错过任何可回收材料。塑料、玻璃、纸张、金属 —— 都混在一起了。 有不同的形式，不同的形状，不同的颜色。瓶子、报纸、塑料包装、罐头、纸袋……这一切都只是冰山一角。您还可以找到有人扔掉的各种贵重物品，从金钱和珠宝，到独特的收藏品。所以把浪费的物品放在正确的地方，启动改变机器。

不过，不要轻易被愚弄。“仅仅”将它们分类到适当的垃圾箱是不够的。
你还要对其排序！迎接挑战……

整理垃圾，踩着节奏！
与本地多人游戏的合作！通过将垃圾扔进适当的垃圾箱并点击合并数据！在分拣铃声越来越快的同时感受节奏！ 优化您的流程！找到一种最有效的方法，并为每场比赛赢得积分。 在与朋友一起玩乐的同时成为所有分拣员中的佼佼者。

summary:
Medieval Knight is a text-based management game with roleplay and adventure aspects.

Please Note

The features listed below are currently still in development and will be expanded and completed during the course of Early Access. The development of this game weighs heavily on the community, ideas and suggestions will be incorporated into the game where possible.

General Description

In this game, you are your own master. You will build your own city and let it blossom. But be careful, because there are dangers lurking in this world. You need an army to protect and defend yourself, your city and your allies.

For your city to flourish, you need to trade to get more resources to equip and upgrade your army, or to expand your city. It is up to you to find your own strategy.

Diplomacy (Work in Progress)

Interact with other cities and rulers, trade or go to war with them. Forge an alliance, give gifts to other rulers or threaten them. Your wealth and power play a big role here, you can intimidate them or make yourself popular. The path you take is entirely up to you.

Dynasties (Work in Progress)

Build your own family tree by marrying and having children to ensure your own inheritance. Continue to play as your own heir, expanding your power, wealth and honour over time.

Armies and War (Work in Progress)

Create a large army and wage war against other rulers. Wipe out entire cities and become a tyrant, or build a powerful defensive army with multiple rulers to protect you from danger.

City Building and Administration (Work in Progress) 

Expand your city, make it prosper and increase your revenue and population. Develop resources, promote and trade them, build schools to increase education in your city, inns to increase satisfaction, churches to satisfy the religious community or a mighty fortification to protect your city.

Saving is done automatically.

Japanese and English languages are supported, and can be switched on the title screen.

Press F1 to go full screen.

Extraneum is an old-school, sci-fi single-player first person shooter with an emphasis on exploration and secret hunting. Fight your way through biohacked monstrosities and stop their progress before they take control of the entire world.

THE STORY

Thanks to your high resilience and your even higher scores on the Universal Weapon Handling Assessment, you were lucky enough to get hired as a security guard for top secret Project EXTRANEÜM (pronounced ex-strain-yum). You had no idea what this project was all about, but you certainly didn't sign up for a total overrun of the facilities by alien looking monstrosities.

Looks like you're doing overtime today. Grab your trusty knife and your standard issue SMG and send these abominations back to hell where they belong.

THE GAME

EXTRANEÜM is a brutal old-school first person shooter with an emphasis on exploration and secret hunting. Shoot monsters and find upgrades as you progress through the laboratories of Project EXTRANEÜM in search for the truth... and a way to put an end to it all.

THE FEATURES

24 levels, with 3 unique boss battles waiting at key points of the campaign

12 unique weapons and 12 enemy types

Hidden upgrades for your health, armor, and ammo

Tons of secrets and hidden areas for your exploratory pleasure

DISCLAIMERS

No generative AI has been used in the production of this game.

name: Sailist
summary:
扩张舰队，在无尽海域中开启心跳加速的冒险！从伴随宁静浪涛声的治愈航行，到充满策略的掠夺，在开拓大洋的同時，利用战利品打造一条通往地平线外未知世界的伟大航路。完成属于您的海上传奇！

自由海域，无限可能

从欣赏地平线的宁静航行，到歼灭敌方舰队的残酷突袭，Sailist 的海洋是一个真正无限的领域，没有任何无形墙壁阻挡你的航路。 跨越地平线奔向未知，锻造属于你自己的命运。通过第一人称和第三人称的无缝切换，体验海上生活的每一个细节，成为这片无尽大洋的真正主宰。

公海商人：你的黄金贸易路线

每个港口城镇都拥有独特的环境和特产。超越简单的物流运输——通过完成城镇请求来建立信任并提高你的贡献度。更高的声望将解锁普通商人甚至无从一瞥的独家高质量贸易商品。洞察市场，寻找利润丰厚的港口，建立属于你自己的黄金贸易路线。

战术大师：舰队指挥艺术

当海盗旗出现在地平线上时，便是证明你战术直觉时刻。在 Sailist 中，战斗不仅仅是发射大炮；更在于保持最佳阵型和引导舰队机动。

指挥你的战斗舰艇侧击敌人，发起毁灭性的侧舷齐射，同时命令脆弱的运输船立即进行规避机动。你的职责是在波涛汹涌中实时指定每艘船的行动并调整阵型。果断的胜利源于完美执行的阵型和你不凡的舰队管理。

你的船舱：波涛之上的避风港

你的船不仅仅是一艘船——它是反映你个人品味的避风港。用各种各样的物品装饰你的船舱，从必不可少的指南针到从全球搜集的精美杰作。使用自由放置系统，将你的船内空间打造得更具威望。

从荒凉海岸到黄金港口

将你发现的荒芜土地宣布为自己的主权领土。运输建筑材料以建造港口和设施，创建属于你自己的城镇。随着定居点的发展，你将获得至关重要的资源和战略优势。你的愿景和设计将成为高效统治广阔海洋的关键。

凝聚在国家的旗帜下（在线）

参加在线国家竞赛，与关键 NPC 城镇建立最牢固的纽带。通过完成城镇请求和猎杀海盗，你将在共享世界中提升国家的地位，帮助你的国家成为城镇的首要盟友。

盟友国家选定：每周贡献点数最高的国家将被选定为城镇的官方盟友。

同盟福利：享受强大的经济优势（如商店专属折扣），并作为备受信任的盟友国家成员，向世界展现你的影响力。

name: Breath of Ghosts 2
summary:
Breath of Ghosts 是一款第一人称恐怖游戏，采用逼真的 3D 图形制作，让您沉浸在恐怖气氛中，并以各种方式吓到您。 主要目标是生存和被拯救。

Breath of Ghosts 是一款第一人称恐怖游戏，采用逼真的 3D 图形制作，让您沉浸在恐怖气氛中，并以各种方式吓到您。游戏玩法包括收集笔记、线索和可怕的照片、解谜和逃离各种实体或鬼魂，以及任何恐怖游戏固有的其他机制。主要目标是生存和被拯救。
简要背景：
根据科学家的说法，我们的整个世界都充满了一种或另一种类型的能量，即使是在一个完全空旷的空间中，也会有大量的能量到目前为止人类还无法满足其需求。哪里有能量，哪里就有生命。在这种情况下，这种能量已经学会吸收诸如能量实体之类的物种，或者只是鬼魂。他们生活在任何地方，在我们的城市和乡村。这些神秘的生物对我们来说几乎是看不见的，几乎总是可以无痛地穿过我们，但更可怕的是，它们有时会影响我们，甚至杀死我们！

所以，这个远非快乐故事的主人公很“幸运”地遇到了这些不寻常的生物，不仅遇见了，而且在他自己的皮肤上感受到了所有无形的、透明的纯净能量团！

name: Death Bind
summary:
Slay zombies in this topdown solo/coop shooter. Both characters are always back to back, try to synchronize with your partner.

Survive as many rounds as possible, use your arsenal of unique weapons and favourite characters to slay all those filthy zombies!

The characters are always back to back, sync their movements and don't let any zombie reach you! In case they do, find a cure before your friend turns into a disgusting monster.

Play by yourself in a challenging 1 player game or cooperate with a friend and enjoy as a local 2 player game, the controls are really simple! It can be played coop via Remote Play Together, just invite your friend and give him/her Keyboard permission.

Use WASD and the Arrow Keys to move each character, it will automatically shoot when zombies are in flashlight range. Catch a time bomb and press Spacebar to throw it!

name: Pullywog
summary:
Sometimes life seems tough... Explore a punishing world full of difficult falls as well as some uplifting moments. Fogg, a doubtful young frog, takes on a journey to climb to the top of the world and hopefully makes some friends along the way.

Description

Leap to the Top in a challenging platformer that follows the journey of a small frog on a big adventure. The goal is simple: climb to the top of the world! But the journey is far from easy. Do you have what it takes to make the leap to the top?
Features

 Challenging platforming: Leap, jump, and dodge your way through challenging levels filled with obstacles and enemies.

 Secret areas: Explore hidden corners of the tower to discover valuable treasures and unlock new abilities. 

 Hidden collectibles: Search high and low to find hidden items that unlock special rewards and achievements.

name: Astrophobia
summary:
Astrophobia is a low poly 4 player co-op alien hunting game. Use the equipment to find out what type of alien you and your team are dealing with and capture it from the premises.

Astrophobia is a low poly multiplayer co-op alien investigation game for 1-4 players. Gather enough evidence to correctly identify what type of alien you're dealing with. After successfully figuring it out you'll be able to determine what to use that will aid in helping you capture it. Don't forget to find the gem that attracted the alien to Earth, you'll want to collect it.
Gameplay
The overall objective is to get rid of the alien lurking inside the business or home that you're investigating. Figure out what area the alien is dwelling in on the property and collect evidence from it to figure out what type of alien it is. After figuring out what you're dealing with, you'll need to rid it from the property and collect the gem that attracted it to its location so that it doesn't attract anymore in the future.
Multiplayer
Astrophobia supports 1-4 players. Play solo, team up with a group of friends, or play in a public lobby and make new friends.
The Aliens
We have 12 different aliens ready for you to investigate. Each will give off 3 pieces of evidence in order for you to figure out what it is.
Maps
3 residential maps are readily available for investigation.
We also have a school in the works and hoping to make an airport shortly after the school is ready to go.
During certain holidays such as Halloween, Christmas, and Easter, we will have a special map for each holiday specifically themed for the occasion. Be sure to join in on the fun during these months because the map will disappear after the holiday and will not be released again until each following year.
Evidence
EMF 5, Energy Cube, Radiation, Radio Interference, Negative Oxygen Levels, Freezing, Low Gravity, Ectoplasm.
