Collectibles

Help your gang to protect or destroy the city. Your decisions will influence how the characters behave in the future missions! The world is divided in 4 sections. Each section has a group of gangs that control it.
Collectables

Exploring the open-world to discover new places and collect hidden quest items! Around the map you will find items to be collected, such as boxes of robot parts, and military case with secret documents!

A tear-filled story game about the bittersweet last day of three abandoned kobolds.

name: Metal World: Street Scraps
summary:
你喜欢汽车吗？高速行驶？ Metal World 是一款无尽奔跑类型的赛车游戏，玩家在复古未来的世界中驾驶飞行车辆！测试您的反应能力并高速展示您的技能！

Metal World 是一款以复古未来世界为背景的游戏，玩家用废旧零件组装车辆，可以装备数十种不同的组合，让车辆拥有独特的外观！高速探索世界躲避障碍，收集资源并完成你的目标。

游戏玩法

Metal World是一款无尽的奔跑游戏，玩家依靠自己的反应来避开障碍物和陷阱，游戏玩法简单但需要很多注意力，因为车辆越来越快，游戏有4个难度，非常适合更多想要放松的休闲玩家，同时也适合喜欢挑战并想要充分测试自己的反应能力和技能的玩家。

name: 棋物语
summary:
棋物语（Stick Go story）是一款单机独立游戏，初衷是将棋类策略游戏与格斗类RPG游戏结合起来，给您带来别致的意趣。像大多数格斗类游戏一样，玩家将操控自己的人物角色通过拳击、腿击等方式与对手对战。不过，游戏的内核更像是棋类游戏，因为角色可以看作由棋子组成，玩家的操纵方式也与“下棋”类似。玩家通过全部关卡即为胜利，此外还可以搜集解锁相关成就、观看战斗视频回放等。未来还将添加更多剧情元素~谢谢看到这里，祝您游玩愉快:D

白衣的少女忽地睁开眼睛，惊慌地想扭头看向四周，脑后发梢立刻撕裂般地疼痛起来。少女又拼命低下头去，心猛地缩紧了。
曾是双手的位置变成了两个白色圆球，泛着朦胧的冷光。手臂似乎一下子变得苍白枯瘦，两肘处同样嵌着白色的圆球。被紧紧束缚的“双腿”“双脚”也是这般形状。
绑架？囚禁？人体改造？脑海中一片空白的少女，耳畔传来了仿佛带着魔力的渺远声音——
 “欢迎来到‘棋子的世界’”

name: Forward Defense
summary:
Forward Defense is a top-down 3D singleplayer tower defense game. Join the United Coalition Force and defeat insurgent forces armed with Technicals and Armored Personnel Carriers in a war-torn region of the Middle East.

Join us on Discord!

关于游戏
Join the United Coalition Force and defeat insurgent forces attempting to overrun and destroy your defenses. Build and repair a wide array of Turret Structures ranging from high velocity Smoothbore Cannons to Howitzers firing 155mm air burst shells. Use Hesco Walls to provide perimeter protection. Forward Defense combines turn-based gameplay with the look and feel of classic military style RTS games.

Balanced Unit & Turret Design
Choose from six different Turret designs and learn which ones work best in different situations. Rotary Cannons will work well against lightly armored targets, while Missile Launchers will be your best bet against long range hostiles. An easy to read Information Window will show you the stats you're looking for.

Unique & Detailed Maps
Visit uniquely detailed locations across a vast Middle Eastern country. Hold the line at a sabotaged oil refinery, defeat enemy forces in a war-torn destroyed city and defend fertile farmland near a mountainous village. Each level has a completely different layout so you have to take the environment into account when considering Turret placement. 

The Backstory
"On June 6 2028, the United Coalition Force invaded the sovereign state of Kardastan. After a brutal three year war, the UCF succeeded in hunting down and assassinating the Kardastani dictator Haddar Sharif. The war sparked civil unrest and led to the rise of the Revolutionary Freedom Army, an insurgent faction who wishes to avenge Haddar Sharif."

Community-Driven Development
We're very open to community feedback and are expanding the game with new features, mechanics and units while keeping a close eye on performance. If you have any ideas or run into any issues, feel free to let us know!

name: Arclight Beat
summary:
Arclight Beat is a minimalistic rhythm based 3D platformer in which you control various level elements by modifying the music.

Jump and control the world at the rhythm of the beat in order to beat challenging music-inspired levels in this charming mix of platforming and puzzles! Create a custom soundtrack by placing beats in different spots and watch as the world adapts to the music. Rearrange the beat mixer, run and jump in order to reach the end! 

20 levels with 4 different music themes 

Rhythm-based 3d platforming 

Engaging puzzles 

4 bonus scrolling levels 

This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

name: Heroes of Time
summary:
Join young adventurers from the future on a quest through time, battling ancient evils and futuristic threats to save the world.

Chrono warriors unite, in a battle across eras to save humanity's fate from the clutches of time-bending villains and dark powers.

A classic RPG, mixing sci-fi + fantasy. Venture as Henzo and his friends to go after a scentist who wants to distort the timeline. Travel to the past and face some medieval creatures in your way as three young teens from the future! 

This game takes place 1000 years after the events of Tales of Ágaris, in the year of 2130.

Long forgotten are days of strife and conflict. Robots have been manufactured to assist with the police to keep the peace and security of the lands. Yet, not all is quite tranquil.

A scientist, named, Aizack, uses his own robots to fuel a machine that he build to go back in time. To make the world one of his own design, he aims to steal a certain magical necklace that has lost it's potency in the modern age. However, 1000 years ago, it had the capability of summoning extremely powerful demons.

The era that Aizack needs to visit coincides with the emergence of Gorgos, which was a dark moment in history. Henzo, Willie, and Lenna discover the scientist's plans and decide that he needs to be stopped. Both to preserve the present that they know, and to protect the future that they don't know.

 Would the three teens be able to nullify Aizack? Are you ready to travel in the time and save the future?

Key Features:

Fast-Paced, Turn-Based Combat: Enjoy the simplicity and speed of classic turn-based battles. Strategic decisions keep the action engaging without slowing down the pace.

Unique Limit Breaks: Each character has their own special Limit abilities, which charge up when they take damage in battle. Unleash these powerful moves with unique animations that highlight each hero's strengths.

Multi-Purpose Smartphone: Henzo’s smartphone serves as more than just a communication dev

Explore the land of Panacea and its secrets in this vibrant and colorful pixelart Action RPG and help SU in his adventure to recover the balance of the contaminated ecosystems.

SU the Son of Gaia is a pixel art Action RPG game that takes place in the Land of Panacea, a majestic, natural and pristine place where ecological balance is maintained thanks to machines created by Gaia. One day, this balance was broken by mysterious creatures called Umbras that altered the natural order and the ecosystem began to fall ill.

Explore Panacea and its secrets in a vibrant and colorful pixelart isometric perspective, in the search to recover the balance of the world.

Face powerful enemies while trying to save the mythic beings called Botans.

Create vigorous antidotes and heal the sick villagers of Panacea.

Define your game experience: unlock new movements, skills and weapons through your journey.

Discover and collect pet bugs, powerful companions with unique abilities.

Interact and befriend villagers and get to know more about Panacea's history and the universe lore.

Welcome to the magical world of Elspell! Here you will run into a variety of monsters and challenges you must overcome by casting a wide array of elementally-aligned spells. The core of Elspell's gameplay comes from its unique spellcasting system, which grants you the ability to string together specific arm and hand movements to cast spells. Each spell has a unique set of movements that must be done in order to be cast, and learning to perform these motions quickly and smoothly will pay off as you get faster and more efficient at slinging deadly spell combos!
Current Features

16 spells that each require a specific set of hand motions to cast. Spell motions vary in length and complexity, including ones that require multiple movements or movements with both hands at the same time.

Two enemy types, each with elemental variants, as well as stronger versions of each variant with visual changes.

Experience and Level-up system that allows players to customize their stats. These are permanent across play sessions and grant players great benefits for playing the game more.

The status effect system allows various effects to be applied to players and enemies over time. Fire-based spells can burn enemies for a duration, and temporary damage bonuses can be applied to the player, to name a couple.

Earn money to buy and equip different gloves and charms with unique stats and abilities.

Buy and equip spell gems to alter the effects of your favorite spells.

Interact with the world by grabbing and throwing elemental devices, picking up and storing items, and consuming active items.

Kick some asses in this cooperative retrowave game!!! Use powerful abilities and combos to destroy the evil minions of the Driftonics mega corporation and free humanity from the cyborg threat.

Chrome Hero

Fight for humankind

The corporation ‘Driftonics’ has taken advantage of this by providing cures to deadly diseases to its inhabitants through nanotechnology or modifying their bodies with robotic parts to achieve technological utopia. What no one knew is that this was all just an evil plan to possess the minds of their citizens and turn them into cyborgs ready to kill. Fight against a variety of enemies, from the weak and volatile Scout, through the agile and deadly gang members of the High Heels, to the mighty Iron Hearts.
Stop the Massacre

Help Michael take down the top executives of “Driftonics” Corporation. Starting with the beautiful but fearsome Cyberna, a powerful winged cyborg who will be willing to destroy everything in her path in order to complete her campaign of world domination.
The Purest Retrowave Style

Enjoy fantastic 3D graphics with handpainted textures. Move through the awesome Beat Bay, featuring four different levels with their own theme. Enjoy an exciting story of hilarious action in the purest style of the 80s and above all, be ready to kick metal asses.

name: MetälBörn
summary:
Techno has taken over your neighborhood. Honor your metal god Kilmister, arm yourself up to the baffles, raise the volume and show these punks which is the music that makes the shells shake. The metalheads are not dead, but the technos will be…

When was the last time you felt like a heavy metal fan? MetalBorn gives you the feeling of the golden age of the genre and also the emergence of a new musical group which is on the rise and it is called: Electronic Music.

You will immerse yourself in this first person shooter in a world where our hero, the last follower of heavy metal, is chosen by his god to reconquer the key points of power in his neighborhood, these being three points of conquest. Set to fulfill his hellish mission, our heavy metal warrior heads to the streets of Blüdstock equipped with his Kilmister-blessed weaponry.

Arriving at street level, he realizes that his house is the last bastion of the "Metallic Fortress", the name by which Blüdstock is known, the flagship place and cradle of Heavy Metal. Finding himself surrounded by minions of the evil goddess Lillith, Robert fights his way through the angry mob to the sources of power.

Having the path to trace under his choice, Robert will decide which party to conquer which he used to attend as a child, as this became a source of power after the incident with Father Judas, which allowed parties and concerts to celebrate Lilith's Faith.

Once there, and after bathing in the electronic blood of his enemies, our dark paladin performs the sacred act of "The Disc Change". This deadly sin causes the source of power to change masters and therefore its former owner loses power. According to the scriptures of the Sacred Pantheon, when one of the sons of music decides to claim his territory, he must perform the ritual at least 3 times to rule it.

Therefore, the main objective of our infernal hero is to reconquer the parties of the city while the followers of Lillith try to stop him.

name: Marine School Simulator
summary:
School life experience on island in the tropical sea... with Flying Shark! Go to school, play with friends in town, and exterminate dangerous creatures. Experience the life of a student on a mysterious southern island.

This is a small island in the South Sea. There are only girls
Cook special dishes, farm in the fields, attract tourists, improve your island reputation, level up and boost with the points you earn.
Spend your free days defeating dangerous creatures and relaxing with your cute girlfriends.

Customize your character's appearance with many costumes and hairstyles
Over 20 classmates, various collectibles

Controls.
Mouse + keyboard and gamepad support; XBOX controllers are encouraged.

name: POPGOES Arcade
summary:
Battle the corrupt animals of the forest, collect valuable items and abilities, and save the world, TWICE, in this retro-styled RPG adventure! As an official spinoff of the Five Nights at Freddy's horror game series, you can expect familiar characters, loads of secrets, and maybe some scares...

POPGOES is an official Five Nights at Freddy's spinoff series, produced by Scott Cawthon and developed by fans as part of the "Fazbear Fanverse Initiative".

In POPGOES Arcade you'll play through two RPG campaigns: "POPGOES: The Dead Forest" (originally released for free in 2020) and "POPGOES and The Machinist" (a built-in sequel for the Steam release!). These fun, colourful, and mysterious adventures will introduce you to new characters like Popgoes the Weasel and Manora the Mouse, but with no attention taken from classic FNAF characters like Chica the Chicken and Foxy the Pirate. 

Featuring...

A large, expanding map to unlock, explore, and fight bad guys in!

Tons of interesting characters, easter eggs, secrets and lore!

A retro art style, inspired by the minigames in the FNAF series!

What's in POPGOES and The Machinist?

An entire sequel campaign available after fully completing The Dead Forest!

Completely new areas, enemies and abilities like Overkill and Scrap Coins!

Deep, dark secrets connected to the wider POPGOES universe...

And on top of POPGOES and The Machinist, the Steam version also has...

A customisable room that displays your progress with weapons and trophies!

The Bestiary and The Index, encyclopedias of encountered enemies with tips!

50 Steam achievements, 25 for each chapter!

What's Fighting Chance?

Fighting Chance is an overhaul to POPGOES Arcade released in 2025.

Introducing "Battle Gifts", super fun, random modifiers to spice up battles!

Lots of abilities, mechanics, and visuals have also been redesigned!

#MadeWithFusion #fnaf #popgoes #fazbearfanverse

name: Cabinet of Curiosities VR
summary:
This is a fully immersive and interactive VR Experience set in a Victorian style Cabinet of Curiosities room, full of hundreds of highly detailed 3D scanned objects from the natural world, that can be picked up, examined, and explored like a museum without restrictions.

This is a fully immersive VR Cabinet of Curiosities, or Wunderkammer, in the style and atmosphere of an old Victorian study. It contains hundreds of rare, exotic 3D objects in photoreal stunning detail, from skulls to insects, that can be picked up, examined, and interacted with. Every shelf and drawer holds new wonders.

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀✣ ┈┈┈┈┈ Open these doors to open your mind. ┈┈┈┈┈ ✣

The objects in the room have been 3D scanned using photogrammetry from real world specimens from museums and found objects. Players will get to learn about, and be inspired by any of the hundreds of notable objects in the room, gaining knowledge about its origins and scientific background through a uniquely developed UI. The objects can be placed on a central table for further study, or examined under a magnifying glass.

✣ ┈┈┈┈ Every shelf and drawer is packed with inspiration to satisfy any curious soul. ┈┈┈┈ ✣

This immersive experience is for artists and explorers of the natural world, who may now see these wonderous curiosities collected from around the globe, in the comfort of their own home anytime they wish. This will be the absolute coolest VR museum or study room ever created, with new objects and interactions added all the time!

name: Royal Legends: Raised in Exile Collector's Edition
summary:
Save the king and his kingdom! Don't let a cunning and unprincipled villain ascend the throne! You are the only one who can influence the course of history. Are you ready to accept the challenge?

Lust for power blinds and makes people do horrible things. Act cautiously - a traitor is closer than you think. Parents and children often differ in opinion. But what would you do on learning that your child is going to betray you? King Richard faces a dilemma: he either waits for the horrendous moment to come or tackles the problem. With a heavy heart, he banishes his son. Years pass by, and the king catches an unknown disease. Did the child return to fulfill his destiny, or was it anyone from the inner circle? You're a magic supervision adviser - solve tricky puzzles and unravel the royal court's secrets. The kingdom's destiny is in your hands - handle it with care. Gather your wits for an unforgettable detective story in this pulse-pounded new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure!

This Collector's Edition includes: 

Use both your ingenuity and knowledge of magic to discover the mystery hidden behind the royal castle walls.

Learn the history of the royal family and show people their true colors.

Explore 33 amazing locations!

Hit the poisonous trail leading right to the king's past to save his present in the Bonus Chapter!

name: Jacktus Green: The Fluffy, the Spiky and the Spicy
summary:
Chase Guindilla to retrieve your beloved Cattus! Jump, dash, and hook around in this 2.5D platformer. Discover different levels, fight enemies, ride minecarts and meet the bizarre neighbors of Sofrito Town.

Welcome to Sofrito Town, a fantasy city set in the Wild West, ruled by plants! Help Jacktus Green, a bounty hunter, who has been tricked into betting his pet Cattus in a poker game against the dangerous outlaw Guindilla. She is planning to use Cattus to find golden avocados, and Jacktus wants to recover his beloved friend! 

?Travel through 5 different levels: Discover new locations, skills and enemies, while the world reacts to your presence. Complete each zone as fast as you can to beat the previous mark!

?Explore: Investigate and find hidden places, and discover the secrets of Sofrito Town!

?Boss Fight: Challenge Guindilla in three unique encounters. 

?Destroy: Break walls and crates, throw dynamite and unleash chaos!

COMING SOON!
?Shop: Collect all the gold pieces you can find and exchange them for many goodies!

name: Mortmentum
summary:
Fight endless waves of different enemies using your grappling hook in clever ways while trying hopelessly to stay alive just a little longer so you can get a higher score.

Beat My Highscore, I Dare You.

But like, this shit ramps up quick. Five types of enemies, deadly lasers, your own incompetence and only a grappling hook and physics to deal with it. Good luck :P

Get creative and improve your control, dodge between enemies with more precision than it takes to do surgery on a grape, grab hold of an enemy and use their own laser to kill everyone else or go with the classic and slam your foes into the ground or each other. That's a least like, 3 possibilities (maybe more, I'm bad at math).

Simple description:
You play as a ball with a grappling hook in a small arena. You get points by destroying other shapes, where the shape corresponds to what they do (the triangles shoot lasers). The more points you have, the more difficult the game becomes and when you die, you try again from the beginning. You destroy shapes by grappling them and flinging them at walls or other hard objects.

name: Cryospace: Prologue
summary:
"你既不是士兵也不是战士，只是一名陷入奇怪事件中的普通维修工。但你必须战斗，被迫逃亡。最重要的是，你必须帮助飞船上处于冷冻状态的船员在茫茫太空中活下去。只有你能拯救他们的性命，或防止他们被永久冷冻。你违背自己的意愿成为了英雄。你需要指挥他人，也需要痛下杀手。
只有小心谨慎、反应迅速的人才能幸存

一艘巨大的星舰在外太空航行，远离所有行星、飞船和天体。处于冷冻状态的未来移民、工人、士兵……还有其他生物在甲板上等着你。
主要亮点：

探索飞船残骸，寻找物资并帮助其他幸存者

解开谜题，躲避陷阱

用各种方式打败怪异的外星生物

将倒霉的船员解冻，他们或许能帮你解开谜团

游戏特色：

探索和资源
雄伟壮丽的宇宙飞船变成了危险的残骸，它现在看起来更像一座坟墓，而不是载满未来移民的太空船。你必须仔细调查“统治”号的不同部分，寻找线索和资源。当然，最重要的是氧气——如果失去氧气，你将在几分钟内死亡。电池也十分有用，你需要用它们点亮手电筒。当电池快耗尽时，手电筒会开始闪烁，然后你将陷入无尽的黑暗……

引人入胜的剧情
显然，你目前最重要的任务是活下去。但要活下去，你必须解开一个谜团——这艘本该将移民送往遥远世界的宇宙飞船究竟发生了什么？船员们都怎么样了？ 

这些在飞船残骸里游荡的奇怪生物是什么？你到底身在何方，在太空的什么方位？

不同的生存策略
飞船残骸上到处都是怪异丑陋的生物。它们有些行动迟缓，有些头脑愚钝，有些反应迅速，有些敏锐狡黠，还有一些全副武装（仅举几个例子）。你可以通过射击、地雷或临时陷阱消灭其中一部分。但大多数时候，你必须运用智慧，隐匿身形，并祈祷运气来避开这些生物或是逃脱它们的追踪。你需要随时注意自己拥有的氧气量——缺氧会导致死亡……

但最好的办法是逃跑！

其他的可怜人
幸运的是，这艘在太空漂浮的失事飞船上还有其他的可怜人。而你——普通的维修工——可以利用他们。你可以唤醒一些人，他们会根据自己的能力，尽其所能帮助你。其他人将继续沉睡，等待境况好转的那一天。记住，你的同伴也需要氧气，而三个人消耗的氧气量可比一个人多得多……因此，你必须做出评估，衡量他们能为你提供的帮助是否比消耗的氧气更有价值？

记住：在飞船上，你的敌人能听到你的尖叫……"

summary:
You are subordinate to the deranged dictator and must plan his doomed invasion in this text-based RPG / Visual Novel. Navigate the shark-filled waters of the Great Leader's presidential cabinet, try to save your family, and survive the purges in a world of power-hungry leaders and nuclear warfare.

This is A War of a Madman's Making: A combination of Visual Novel and text-based RPG centered around war planning and political survival, inspired by games like Suzerain and Decisive Campaigns: Barbarossa. 

War of a Madman's Making is set in a fictional world where nuclear escalation has blackened the skies. You are a citizen who has been mysteriously called up to serve as Field Marshal of the Great Leader's army. Through a combination of resource management, political maneuvering, and strategic military planning, you must survive the impending war - and the purges and assassinations that will come along with it.

You have the freedom to be ruthless in your methods, but doing so too freely could have consequences - particularly if you face a tribunal for crimes against humanity. However, mismanage your resources pursuing nobler causes, and you'll find a similar fate at the hands of your beloved Great Leader.

Rein in the disaster, protect your family, and survive the purges.

Features

 ~70k word story with 5 major endings.

 Resource management. Maintain a military budget, popularity with the Leader's cabinet, and favor with the Great Leader himself.

 Choose your allies and enemies. Scheme amongst the Leader's staff or even against the Leader himself.

 Manipulate your reports when you must give bad news to the Great Leader, but be careful not to push your luck.

 Retro-style soundtrack by Borealis (Shirli Ainsworth) full of tense overtures and bombastic battle themes.

 An encyclopaedia filled with lore and character details - including nuggets that an astute player will find useful.

Join the Discord and contribute to game development!

name: Chaste Tris
summary:
Chaste Tris is based on Tetris but there is no gravity. Blocks can be freely moved up, down, left, and right with the arrow keys. They can be rotated with X or Y keys and can also be held for later use with C. The space bar or H key can also be used to hard drop the blocks!

Hard Drop

In response to requests in the Steam reviews, which I do actually read, I have added the hard drop into the game now. Try it out with space bar or H key.

关于游戏

Chaste Tris is my first complete video game I have made. It is based on Tetris but there is no gravity. Blocks can be freely moved up, down, left, and right with the arrow keys. They can be rotated with X or Y keys and can also be held for later use with C. The space bar or H key can also be used to hard drop the blocks!

But my game also allows for a new feature that none of the other games have. It is possible to save the state of the game by pressing the I key and reload it with the L key to go back and correct mistakes. This makes it the perfect tool to test out playing styles which would be perfectly valid on other puzzle block style games but would be very difficult. 

Consider this game as a relaxing practice tool to test the limits of what you can think of when you have all the time in the world to get it right! This game is not meant to compete with the officially licensed Tetris games. However, I think it adds the feeling of the 1980s and 1990s. It is meant to run on even the oldest and slowest of computers. It is fully Open-Source and was developed on Linux. However, this Steam port is the Windows port which I have confirmed also works on Debian Linux using Proton Emulation.

For more information on how you can use the source code and modify it to your own needs, you can visit the GitHub page

name: Orbital Approach
summary:
Orbital Approach is a Physics based, arcade space game where the highest score rules supreme. Navigate around planets, avoid obstacles, travel through wormholes, and more!

Orbital Approach combines the classic slingshot puzzle formula with a space-themed twist. Progress through the 85 levels found within to achieve the greatest high scores, overcome new obstacles, and discover new ways to outthink the rules of gravity as you make your approach to the goal.

The game takes inspiration from titles such as Angry Birds, Golf It!, and a number of other casual, physics-based puzzle games. It contains a variety of precisely constructed levels to test the player's ability to both use the tools at their disposal and to think outside the box. Not every level has an obvious solution, and some will require the player to think of new ways to take their ship into orbit.

Orbital Approach features a host of obstacles, ranging from simple planets of various sizes to pull the player around, to more complex objects like black holes that use normalized gravity fields, even triggers that can toggle objects on and off, ensuring that some stages may not be exactly what they appear to be. It's up to the player to experiment and find new ways to fly through space, all while racking up a high score to top the leaderboard. The path you choose is up to you, which direction will you take?

name: 집착의 망자 - 집으로부터의 탈출
summary:
만약 당신의 집 안에 당신의 생명을 노리는 괴한이 들어온다면?

탈출 시리즈

집.
그것은 누구에게나 제일 편안하고 안전하며 자신만의 시간을 누릴 수 있는 소중한 공간이다.

하지만, 위급한 일이 생겼을 때 외부로 도움을 요청하거나, 위험한 일이 발생했을 때 외부로 도망치기에는 어렵다는 특징도 있다.

만약 당신의 집 안에 당신의 생명을 노리는 괴한이 들어오게 된다면?

당신의 목적은 단 하나.

세상에서 제일 위험한 공간이 되어 버린 집에서 괴한의 위협을 견뎌내고…살아남는 것이다.
집착의 망자 - 집으로부터의 탈출이란?

[집착의 망자]는 인디즈 작가로 활동했던 TT씨가 2011년에 만든 ‘웹 브라우저용 게임 북’입니다.

80년대에 ‘게임 북’이라는 것이 일시적으로 유행했었습니다. 게임 북이란 일반 소설처럼 1Page부터 읽지만, 도중에 ‘선택지’가 나타나고 그에 따라 페이지를 넘겨가면서 다양한 전개와 결말을 볼 수 있는 책입니다.

집착의 망자는 웹 브라우저에 맞게 제작된 게임 북입니다. 비록 비주얼도, 사운드도 없지만 긴박한 내용 전개가 인상 깊었던 작품이었습니다.

이 게임은 그 웹 브라우저 게임 북 집착의 망자를 PC로 옮긴 것입니다. 원작을 살리고자 비주얼은 추가하지 않았고 BGM도 단순합니다. 그렇지만, 그 몰입감은 여전할 것이라 믿습니다.
특징

- 21가지나 되는 다양한 엔딩이 존재합니다. (비슷한 엔딩이 다수 존재하기는 함)

- 실제 범죄 상황에 대한 경각심을 얻을 수 있습니다.

- 오로지 문장으로만 설명하여 플레이어의 상상력을 자극합니다.

- 갑자기 튀어나오는 연출이 없으므로 간 떨어질 걱정을 하지 않아도 됩니다.

summary:
该游戏是一款独立制作的回合制RPG，喜欢回合制RPG的朋友一定不要错过！游戏中你可以体验逐步变强然后击败一个又一个强大BOSS的快感。每个角色可以选择不同的培养路线，你可以根据你自己的思路选择角色天赋，进行装备搭配，以及练习技能！ 总之，如果你喜欢回合制RPG这个游戏你一定要尝试一下，我相信你玩了之后绝不会后悔！

先声明本游戏战斗有一定难度，并不适合喜欢玩挂机刷刷刷的朋友。

由于并没有太多的测试人员，主要是我自己在测试，即便我玩了很多遍，但难免会有遗漏和不合理的地方。

如果有出现BUG或者大家觉得有某些地方难度不合理，希望大家能积极反馈，评论区留言或者进群@都行！感谢各位赏脸游玩！

游戏着有不同于其他回合制游戏的战斗机制，每个角色有着独特且能产生质变的天赋加点，你可以把角色按你想的方向上培养。
但是注意你的天赋需要与你主要使用的技能搭配，才能发挥最大效果。
本游戏需要注意的点：

1.很多技能释放需要tp点，我们可以通过加攻速或者加tp回复来提高tp获取效率。

2.技能每次使用会获得熟练度，熟练度可以提升技能等级和伤害，技能熟练度达到要求会解锁更高级技能，所以我们要尽可能多的使用技能，把一个技能练到极致会比每个技能练一会要强得多！

3.游戏的里控制技能对任何敌人都有效，但部分怪物被控制后会狂暴，狂暴状态下将免疫控制且伤害可能会略微提高。

4.按Q可以快捷保存。

5.设置里面有设置战斗加速，修改窗口样式等功能。

6.更换装备时镶嵌物品会自动转移到新装备上，不需要自己取下来重新镶嵌。
关于战斗：
与其他回合制战斗不同，游戏中有攻速属性。
攻速直接影响角色普通攻击造成伤害的次数，而普通攻击每次造成伤害恢复5点TP，物理系技能是没有冷却时间的只受TP点数的限制，所以攻速也间接的影响了技能的释放频率。
对于敏捷路线的角色，想要提升输出，提升敏捷和攻速是最佳方式。（前提是你的攻击不能太低）
对于力量和智力路线的角色，攻速带来的提升并不明显，所以TP恢复至关重要。很多时候直接增加伤害不如增加TP恢复来的实在！
关于美术：
刚开始是有想请画师和美工的打算，可是了解了下价格我放弃了……

整个游戏包括角色立绘、行走图、怪物图片、场景图块、技能特效、UI设计然后一堆图标感觉没个十来万下不来，这让我实在承受不住。
后来想找人已合作的方式给分成，但似乎也不现实，毕竟想找人来免费玩你的游戏都挺困难的……

所以，只能咬咬牙自己瞎折腾了。游戏的UI素材大部分是RPG make和dlc自带的，也使用了部分其他资源，费劲力气也只能整成现在这样了！
关于剧情：
作为一个rpg游戏剧情至关重要，但是很遗憾……
我个人觉得游戏的剧情框架还是不错的，但是受限于自己的文笔和图片素材不足，很多剧情其实都是根据现有图片素材临时编的。
其实游戏中有很多东西没有讲，比如：
1.关于水斗的来历，其实佐克和水斗的父母其实曾经也是猎魔者，后来水斗父母意外死亡，于是佐克退隐照顾主角。

2.夜瞳的父亲其实是十几年前的被星玄打败的将军，整个军队全部战死无一生还。由于莫名其妙的被人团灭，他从受人尊敬的将军变成笑柄，夜瞳和母亲也饱受其他人的嘲笑，夜瞳的母亲也因此郁郁而终，所以长大后夜瞳来到帕拉斯是想弄清楚当年的事，为父亲正名。

3.乌诺斯为啥要打帕拉斯？其实是有人拱火，这个人和故事的幕后黑手麦迪文一样其实都来自的另一个大陆。他们就是想两边拱火，让两国打起来，他们就可以乘机进行实验，制造战斗用的魔物，说白了就是想把这片大陆当成战争实验室。

4.其实后续还有剧情，大致内容是：两国还是打起来了，之后再与夜瞳再见面，却不得不兵戎相见。然后会有新角色出现，阻止了战斗，新角色是另一个大陆的人，他正在调查他们那个大陆的一个邪恶组织，而这场战争就是这个邪恶组织在幕后操纵，目的是乘乱制造出可控制的魔物……

其实整个剧情有点参考了一部日本动漫《大剑》，这是一部被禁的神作（个人觉得是神作！），至今我的电脑里还有这部动漫的资源，想看的可以加群@我，哈哈哈……
后续：
虽然这个游戏还有后续剧情，但是暂时不打算出续作，因为我觉得自己目前还没有力能把剩下的故事讲好……

也许等哪一天时机成熟了，我会回来继续填这个坑，也许……

之后还是会接着做新的游戏，目前有一些思路，大致是一个策略经营+战棋的游戏。
新游戏的话打算用unity去做，也会花钱去请美工画师，有新进度我也会在群里通知大家，希望大家到时能关注一下。

完全免费

name: Putinist Slayer
summary:
普京主义杀手是一款快节奏的动作游戏，讲述了在深空中摧毁普京主义者的故事。在一个无限的类Roguelike射击游戏中释放自己。消灭成群的敌人，躲避攻击，升级武器，消灭首领，打破新的最高纪录！ 来自乌克兰的迷因。

在星空中，还有什么比见到
占领者破碎的脸更好的事情呢？

缓解你的压力，参与到飓风行动中—深入太空，深入太空，摧毁那些由俄罗斯法西斯主义名人的脸谱构成的丑陋怪物。

普京主义杀手是一款来自乌克兰的前卫游戏项目，通过互动艺术的视角揭示了冒进主义及其思想家的犯罪本质。在俄罗斯导弹的火力下，游戏由战争期间成立的匿名艺术团体 Bunker 22创作。游戏销售的净收入捐赠给乌克兰武装部队。

所有自由和民主的敌人—俄罗斯联邦罪恶政府的宣传者、政治家、军事领导人都将下地狱。 
重现你最勇敢的梦想—用激光、等离子、巴拉克塔尔无人机、燃烧弹来点燃它们，呼唤乌克兰拖拉机手的宇宙军队来协助。
 游戏玩法

普京主义杀手是一款快节奏的类Rogue的射击游戏，具有令人上瘾的游戏性。 
消灭成群的敌人，躲避攻击，升级武器，消灭首领，打破新的最高纪录！

以幽默漫画方式诠释经典的射击游戏机制，从一个全新的角度呈现出大家熟知的游戏玩法。

多样化的强化道具，可组合成超强大的组合，以及通过程序生成实现的无尽游戏进程，为独特的游戏情境提供了无限的可能性，让你可以在每次游戏中以全新的方式体验游戏的乐趣，留连忘返。

胖老板会试图阻止你的愤怒。与敌人的多阶段战斗，改变攻击和战术，将迫使你全力以赴保护银河系的自由。
游戏情节

游戏的情节线穿越了历史，从1169年莫斯科的创始人安德烈·博戈柳布斯基王子摧毁基辅，苏联对乌克兰人民犯下的罪行，再到神秘未来版本的情节。

普京主义者进行了一场黑暗的仪式，在克里姆林宫的城墙上打开了另一个维度的的裂缝。在一场嗑药—神秘的疯狂状态下，他们潜入一个遥远的外星空间，以便让神秘的恶魔生物卷入他们对全人类的战争。然而，乌克兰情报部门获得了他们的路线…
 视听效果

沉浸在“普京主义杀手”的世界中，并运用先进的图形效果。

这款游戏独特地融合了不同的视觉风格，通过近几十年的标志性迷因和文化参考捕捉了一个时代的精神。

游戏将为您带来VIDMA和Пирятин等乐队的摇滚和电子朋克音乐，以及乌克兰国歌的现代改编版。
项目使命
 支持乌克兰军队
我们将游戏销售的净收入捐赠给志愿者基金，为乌克兰武装部队提供援助。捐赠报告可以在我们的官方网站上查询。

 游戏开发艺术
电子游戏是交互艺术领域中技术手段最强大的产物，它能够容纳人类创造力的绝对所有类别，并将观众变成参与者。

这一领域的突破吸引了那些给出令人难以置信的项目的企业，同时将艺术推到了幕后，将一切都置于没有灵魂的商业化轨道上。

Bunker 22 团队打算采取行动对抗这一可悲的趋势。有灵魂的独立游戏开发，作为艺术的独立游戏开发——这就是吸引和团结我们的地方。

对俄罗斯侵略者的信息抵抗的新前沿
俄罗斯的侵略导致世界迅速军事化，人类自由减少，全球化朝着相反的方向逆转。恐怖和军事冲突蔓延到其他国家。

自第二次世界大战以来，一个国家对另一个国家进行最大规模的侵略性军事入侵，目的是彻底毁灭和种族灭绝，这使全球安全受到质疑。这为来自世界各地的嗜血独裁者的军事冒险打开了大门，他们饶有兴趣地关注着普京在乌克兰的血腥恐怖将如何结束。我们正试图在信息和文化空间中抵消这种邪恶。

我们抒发正义的愤怒，我们支持乌克兰的民族精神。通过将那些体现普京主义思想的人物拟人化，我们降低了他们的权力和影响力。

严肃和荒谬的综合，讽刺融入超现实主义，挑衅，冥想性的游戏性，以及将战斗美学投射到冒进主义者身上，这些都是我们借助的艺术手法，以试图抵制俄罗斯宣传的毒害和其中根深蒂固的反人类、反乌克兰的欺骗性概念，这些手法直接作用于玩家的潜意识。

我们梦想一个自由和开放的世界，在这个世界里不再有俄罗斯的恐怖，人们可以专注于艺术、文化、科学，追求个人幸福、和谐和生活各个领域的发展。
即刻开始！

为自己购买这款游戏，再买一份作为礼物送给一位被俄罗斯宣传毒害的朋友。毕竟，普京主义杀手包含了一场反俄国法西斯主义的催眠疗法的互动体验。

摧毁邪恶，恢复正义，从普京的血腥独裁中拯救宇宙！

name: We are definitely the baddies
summary:
A minimalist city builder where only profits matter. Build factories and extract everything before you are forced to leave the planet.

We Are Definitely The Baddies is part of the CosmOS 9 bundle, a set of 9 puzzle games discovered on a mysterious, alien video game console drifting through outer space.

We Are Definitely The Baddies is a tiny game with just a bunch of buildings to choose from and one single resource. Each run lasts 15 minutes, but keep in mind this isn't a game you will be playing for hours.

The emperor is kicking you out of the planet. But that should worry an evil space overlord such as yourself. Build a huge factory, extract resources, fend off the locals, and escape with all you can grab before the deadline. Create a network of pipes and factories that are likely to be terrible for the environment but great for your pockets.

Simple city builder that won't overwhelm you.

Great for a few short sessions.

Yes, you only care about profit and you are evil.

Might be inspired by a well-known sci-fi world.

name: Racoonie: Legend of the Spirits
summary:
Become the Racoonie! A small, yet courageous adventurer traveling through Everland to collect the blessings of the four great animal spirits.

Small Hero, Great Troubles!
The land of Everland is threatened by an ancient evil! It’s up to you to embrace your sword and shield and embark on a long, dangerous journey full of puzzles, enemies, and fearsome bosses!

Take on a classical adventure to restore peace and tranquillity in this cute and colorful world.

You Are The Only Tool You Need
Helping the great animal spirits allows our hero to gain new transformations, each of which is associated with new powerful abilities. These allow you to access new areas, solve new puzzles and defeat more enemies!

Explore Everland!
It’s not all about fighting enemies and solving puzzles. Take your time to explore a magical world populated by a variety of cute characters, with their stories, their quirks, and, maybe, their tasks for you!

The game features:
-Sword and Shield combat ⚔️
-4 Magical Animal Transformations ✨
-5 Mysterious Dungeons to explore ?
-Tons of Collectible Items ?
-Many helpless people with peculiar side-quests ?
-A colorful world to explore ?️
-1 Cute Raccoon to play as ?

name: Containment Crew
summary:
As part of the Containment Crew, it’s your job to keep the facility running—clean spills, replace fuses, and keep the power on. But when containment breaches occur, every shift becomes a fight to finish your duties and make it through the night alive.

Do Your Job

You’re part of the Containment Crew—the night shift maintenance team keeping the facility running when everyone else has gone home. Replace fuses, fix leaks, patch walls, and make sure the lights stay on… even when something wants them off.

Contain the Anomalies

Every shift brings new problems. Some can be solved with duct tape. Others require running very fast in the opposite direction. Keep the anomalies contained, keep your cool, and whatever you do—don’t open the wrong door.

Upgrade Your Gear

Use your shift pay to upgrade your office, unlock better tools, and improve your defenses. Stronger doors, longer-lasting lights, smarter scanners—anything to give you an edge before the next breach hits.

Survive with Friends

Bring your coworkers along for the ride. Coordinate repairs, divide the workload, and try not to panic when the alarms start blaring. Teamwork keeps the power on—and keeps you alive.

Welcome to the Night Shift

You’re not here to be a hero. You’re here to keep the systems online, get the job done, and clock out in one piece. But down here, maintenance isn’t just about fixing what’s broken… it’s about surviving what breaks free.

name: DecayZ Origin
summary:
DecayZ Origin 是一款第三人称生存射击游戏，背景设定在一个被致命病毒肆虐的世界。探索废墟，对抗可怕的变异生物，解开剧情谜题，并与你的猫咪伙伴一起生存下去。免费更新将带来更多内容。

“你是那个拿枪的人……但老板？他骑在你肩膀上。”

探索 14 张独特地图

从阴森的森林到废弃的村庄，《DecayZ Origin》拥有 14 张手工绘制的地图，每张地图都拥有独特的氛围、挑战和隐藏的秘密，等待您去发现。

超过 6 小时的游戏时间

沉浸在扣人心弦的生存体验中，超过 6 小时的内容融合了探索、激烈的战斗、解谜以及与忠诚的猫咪伙伴建立的独特羁绊。

解锁“新游戏+”模式，使用升级后的装备重温故事，获得新的挑战和更丰厚的奖励。

游戏功能

故事谜题

解开融入主线剧情的环境谜题。这些挑战考验你的逻辑思维和观察力，解锁新的区域和秘密。

升级武器

强化你的装备，提升伤害力、增加弹夹容量并解锁特殊能力。

制作弹药和医疗补给

收集资源，制作各种生存必需的弹药和医疗补给品。

地图系统

使用详尽的地图追踪目标、标记位置并探索关键区域。地图会随着你发现新区域而更新，使导航更加直观且更具策略性。 

任务指引

遵循清晰的任务指引系统，帮助你始终专注于主要目标。航点和日志条目会随时提醒你进度和目标。

序章

在泰国偏远的群山中，一个最高机密的政府实验室成为一种致命病毒的爆发点，该病毒蔓延速度如野火般迅猛。随着病毒肆虐周边村庄，政府实施戒严，但为时已晚。仅仅一周内，病毒就夺去了数千条生命，彻底扼杀了对治疗或疫苗的希望。

当感染者逐渐死去并再次以变异体的形式复活，政府对他们的失踪事件进行隐瞒，项目被遗弃，被遗忘，任由病毒肆虐。

然而，20年后，病毒已扩散到偏远山脉之外，世界陷入一场无望的大流行。政府在绝望中寻求外援，并派出第一支远征队遏制疫情，但他们无影无踪。第二支远征队被派往寻找病毒源头。然而，当队伍深入山中时，他们发现病毒已经进化、适应，变得比任何人想象的都要可怕。他们在那里所发现的一切，将考验他们的生存意志，并可能意味着我们所知人类文明的终结。

summary:
《逐鹿》是一款由TKG研发的三国题材的回合制策略游戏。在硝烟四起、诸侯争霸的三国乱世中，玩家可以在剧本中任意选择势力，饰演主公。通过内政、外交等玩法助你运筹帷幄。带领麾下群雄，攻城略地，在辽阔的战场上开疆扩土。或兴复汉室，或成一代枭雄，皆掌握在你的手中。

关于游戏
*本游戏需要在联网状态下运行。不支持没有网络或者需要离线游戏的情况。
《逐鹿》基于同名历史沙盘游戏引擎开发。

《逐鹿》是一款基于同名历史沙盘游戏引擎开发而成的三国题材回合制策略游戏。在硝烟四起、诸侯争霸的三国乱世中，玩家可以在剧本中任意选择势力，饰演主公。通过内政、外交等玩法助你运筹帷幄。带领麾下群雄，攻城略地，在辽阔的战场上开疆扩土。或兴复汉室，或成一代枭雄，皆掌握在你的手中。
游戏特色

问鼎九州，逐鹿三国

《逐鹿》的历史剧本以《三国演义》为蓝本推演而来，游戏贯穿历史典故，力求还原三国时期的史实风貌。玩家可以任意挑选剧本，并饰演其中一势力的主公，谋定三国，一统九州。

山河为子，天下为局

《逐鹿》以经典六角战棋玩法为核心战斗模式，玩家可以指挥部队以“六角战棋”的形式纵横驰骋于大战场之上，或与敌人短兵相接，或以计谋决胜千里之外，在矢石之间，开疆扩土。

坚甲利兵，攻无不克

在游戏中兵种可分为步兵、骑兵、机械三大类，细分则有弓兵、弩兵、盾兵、轻骑兵等十余种。还有数十种专属兵种可以携带，出征时根据战况调配兵种阵容，能够达到先发制人，克敌机先的效果。

鸾翔凤集，龙幡虎纛

根据历史文献记载以及结合三国演义内容，目前游戏中已设计武将有600余名。每个武将具有独特的特性，可以凸显武将的差异化。不仅如此，我们还为历史名将绘制了精致的专属立绘，彰显其个性。

■リリース記念！割引価格にて販売中！
オープンワールドスタイルのゲームのため、予期せぬバグが発生する恐れがあります。
リリース直後は特に発生する確率が高いため、お詫びも込めて2週間割引価格にて販売します。

周囲の視線に気を配りながら露出プレイを楽しみましょう。

summary: 这是一个关于痴迷的故事。蒙娜丽莎始终以疑惑的笑容微笑着，而我们的可怜主人公则被各种形式的“她”所追逐——无论是在博物馆里，还是在塞纳河畔的书店中，又或是大街上、咖啡馆里。这足以让他抓狂不已！

summary: 这是一部轻松有趣的动画作品，通过字母表来展开故事。每个字母都配有相应的单词以及由 Joachim 绘制的视觉形象，让观众能够更直观地了解每个字母的含义。

name: Le phonographe
summary: An old phonograph assembles itself, plays songs on wax drums before self destructing. In many ways The Phonograph is a companion piece to Renaissance, there is nevertheless something quietly affecting about Borowczyk’s final ‘object’ animation.

name: 乳魔のロシアンルーレット
summary:
5つのグラス、5杯のミルク
その中に1つだけ、乳魔のミルクが紛れています
目の前の乳魔の誘惑をかわしつつ挑む
ミルクのロシアンルーレットです


・乳魔(にゅうま)

大きな乳房を持つ、夢魔の一種
誘惑によって人を堕落させ、その精を搾り取る

名前の通り魅惑的な乳房を持ち
そこから染み出すミルクは強力な魅了の力を持つ

甘やかな香りは容易に人を引きつけ
ふわふわと優しそうなふるまいとは裏腹に
無慈悲なまでの快楽で人を狂わせる

どういう因果か、あなたはそんな乳魔を相手に
ミルクを用いた一夜の勝負に挑むことになる
全てのミルクを飲み干し無事に帰ることができるのか
それとも誘惑に負け、彼女の虜となってしまうのか──。

name: Jouet joyeux
summary: This short film by Walerian Borowczyk was made in 1979 but is so little known that when it was rediscovered in 2014 it had not been included in any of his filmographies. Of all Borowczyk’s films, this is the one that most clearly shows his love of early cinema and pre-cinema, in this case Charles-Émile Reynaud’s praxinoscope.

name: Fate/Samurai Remnant material
summary:
materialに収録される短編小説『慶安盈月食録（けいあんえいげつしょくろく）』は、本編ストーリー監修を務めたFateシナリオチームの桜井光＆東出祐一郎による書き下ろし。
“盈月の儀”に参じる七人七騎の主従たちの、ゲーム本編では描かれることのなかった「食」への思いが描かれる。
何を食らい、何を満たすのか―――彼らの生き様に触れる珠玉の小品をここに。

summary:
死神少女，是流传在石雨高校的传说，贯穿着每一集不同的校园事件。见过她的人,都会听到她说：「我是渡，是奈何桥的守护者都…虽然你们叫我死神少女，但只有当你渡不过的时候，我才会成为死神。」

死神少女渡(房思瑜饰演)，非生非死，无善无恶。她总是笑着说：「我最喜欢“过不去”的灵魂了,来变成一颗石头，帮我支撑奈何桥吧。」

面对困境、生死抉择，如果你选择「渡过」，死神少女就会消失，如果你还是「渡不过」，死神少女会帮助你完成愿望，但你，将会变成「奈何桥」下的一颗石头，永远忍受地狱之河的冲刷，支撑别人安然渡过。

此外,具有灵异体质的少年沈奇(炎亚纶饰演)，是唯一可以看见死神少女的人；透过目睹一则则的校园故事，沈奇明白「渡」并非刽子手，而是渡者，而渐渐爱上死神少女。
但医生却说：沈奇脑中长了一颗脑瘤，故而产生幻觉。
随着脑瘤越长越大，沈奇的性命危在旦夕；但若割除脑瘤，他将再也见不到死神少女。

究竟，,他会成为一般凡人而活下去?或是，为爱而死，永远与死神少女在一起?

summary:
苛酷な運命と、不器用であまいふたりのシンデレラストーリー

薬膳師の祖父を亡くし、叔母と従妹に家も資産も奪われた若水つぐみ。
彼女は生きるために、祖父から受け継いだ薬膳の技術を活かし、帝国を護る陰陽寮の調理員試験に挑む。
結果は合格。けれど、〝鬼憑き退魔師〟と恐れられる夏霧灯弥の専属料理人になることを提案され、
同時に灯弥から求婚を受ける。
突然のことにつぐみは驚くが、ある事情から結婚は仮のものであると教えられ、そのまま夏霧家に住むことになった。
そこでつぐみは、灯弥の秘密を知っていく――

孤独で不器用なふたりが本当の愛と覚悟を知る、陰陽シンデレラストーリー

summary:
父の汚名を晴らすまで恋はお預け！？　メンタル強めな没落令嬢、反撃開始です！

エリスティアは聖淑女の称号を得るために、修道院では大人しく猫を被って過ごしていた。
しかし突然、父親が無実の罪で捕らえられ、伯爵令嬢の身分を剥奪されてしまう。

修道院でメイドとして虐げられながら生きることに……なったけれど、
好奇心旺盛で行動力があり、メンタルも強いエリスティアは、
苛められてもしおらしい態度をとりながら「これぞ虐げられ令嬢！」と陰でにんまりしたり、
数々の悪意を幼稚だと笑いながらこっそり逆襲したり……。
ただの「薄幸の元令嬢」ではないみたい!?

修道院から逃げ出したエリスティアは、貴族の騎士団長・デュークフレドに拾われ、彼のメイドになることに。
とある秘密を抱えたまま、父親の無実を証明するために彼と一緒に動き出す――。
無口な騎士団長との恋の行方は!?

ちょっと変わったシンデレラストーリー、開幕！

name: Continu-discontinu
summary: 彼得亚雷·卡姆莱尔 (Piotr Kamler) 遇见了卢克·法拉利 (Luc Ferrari) 和伊安尼斯·泽纳基斯 (Iannis Xenakis)。对立的游戏：空间、颜色、形式、动作

name: Étude 65
summary: Etude 65 is a study based on a precedent Kamler’s short using the second part Continu-discontinu with a new music composed by the great Beatriz Ferreyra.

name: 咖啡店主理人模拟器
summary: 在这个忙碌过头的世界里，当一次真正的“主理人”吧！在《咖啡店主理人模拟器》中，从空荡荡的店面开始，亲手装饰店面、布置咖啡机、整理货架、补货、打扫、收银、赚钱不断拓张店面！把你的小小咖啡店，从门可罗雀做到排满长队！

name: La Planète Verte
summary: 这是一个虚构的星球，一个不断运动的抽象宇宙。在这个宇宙中，有一些微小的生物——半是跳蚤，半是变形虫，被称为“阿克特法吉斯”（actuphages）——它们在这里和平地生活着，不断进化着。

name: 超级妙音鸟
summary: 《超级妙音鸟 Super Kalavinka》是一款以迦陵频伽神鸟为背景的3D硬核平台跳跃游戏，由个人开发者开发。游戏中你将扮演一位卡通“超级妙音”，为了探寻最美妙的声音，踏上一条充满危险的神树冒险之路，游戏画风清晰，通关极具挑战！

name: Cœur de secours
summary: 那个醉心于爱情的丑角小丑，对一个被时间冻结的年轻女子展开了疯狂的恋情。

name: Spellcasters Chronicles
summary:
施法。飞行。交战。合作。在紧张刺激的3V3动作策略游戏中，召唤生物大军，施展毁天灭地的法术，并呼唤泰坦前来助阵，大杀四方。成为SPELLCASTERS社区中最具影响力的成员，与成千上万玩家一同塑造世界的命运。

诸神皆陨。在一切的尽头，仅剩的命定之人将那名为“源质”的远古能量取用，以此延续命运的轨迹。术士、萨满、巫师……无论昔日以何自称，他们如今都被称为“Spellcasters”，并已站在重塑世界的浪潮之巅。

而你正是Spellcaster之一——你身怀的伟力足以改写整个世界的命运。夺取源质，掌控魔法，为无上的伟力和世界的未来而战！

Spellcasters Chronicles是一款免费游玩，且基于团队合作的第三人称动作策略游戏。化身法师指挥官，召唤生物大军，施展强力法术，让混沌席卷战场。在这款多人合作游戏中，策略、技巧和创造力将激烈交锋，只有德才兼备的指挥官才能从中脱颖而出，夺得桂冠。你将扮演怎样的Spellcaster形象？是令世人闻风丧胆，还是让你的美名传颂四方？

在史诗级的3V3战斗中施展魔法
你是身怀伟力的法师，你将与盟友强强联合，展现技高一筹的强大实力。在神秘萦绕的竞技场中展开激烈对决，施展毁天灭地的法术，击溃你的敌人，为你的盟友提供增益。你的力量甚至可能改变周遭的环境。与你的盟友共同制定战术，把握局势走向，将胜利纳入囊中。

飞行。施法。交战。合作。
御空飞行，机动作战。你的技巧和法术将助你取得先机。在空中指挥你的部队，铺设走向胜利的道路。你的高超技巧将助你在交战时胜出，而你的深谋远虑将决定胜负最终花落谁家。快速思考，迅速行动，战场唯快不破。

召唤生物大军，助你驰骋沙场
召唤多种多样的生物，组建庞大军团。骷髅士兵、食人魔、巨龙……每种生物都有合适的出场时机。建造高塔与各类设施，定点确立优势，随后呼唤泰坦巨人，任其力量将战场搅得天翻地覆，让敌人俯首称臣。

学习全新法术，精进召唤能力，打造完美技能组合
装备你喜爱和称手的法术，你的游玩风格由你决定。无论你想作为辅助支援队友、作为坦克冲锋陷阵、还是在其之间打出成吨伤害，你都可以在超过50项法术（法术表此后还会不断更新！）中做出抉择，并在七种学派中选择最适合你的召唤方式。扩充你的后备力量，不断积累知识，学习全新法术，精进召唤能力，打造你专属的完美技能组合。

通过社区投票，与其他玩家共同塑造世界的命运
加入Spellcasters Chronicles的社区，玩家所做出的决定将永远改变世界的样貌。每个赛季你都将面临重大抉择，最终的结果将影响游玩方式与游戏故事的走向。在命运织路上雕琢你的名字，成为不朽的传奇。

name: content moderator.
summary:
为了筹集母亲的手术费，你接下了一份可疑的兼职——“内容审核员” 。你的工作是删除那些绝不能出现在网上的“禁忌图片”。在这个诅咒蔓延的异常办公室中努力生存下去吧。

《content moderator. 》是一款管理模拟恐怖游戏。你需要在SNS帖子中筛选并删除那些禁忌的图片，并努力活下去。

剧情
母亲的寿命只剩7天。

为了凑齐100万日元的手术费，你接下了这份诡异的工作。

任务内容
图片会不断涌现。将没有问题的图片设为“允许”，将被诅咒的图片设为“删除”。

心理健康
这份工作会带来极大的精神压力。适度的休息是必要的。你可以通过玩游戏、吃药来保持理智。如果攒了钱，买些减压用品或新游戏也是个不错的选择。

上司
摸鱼时千万别被上司发现。一旦被抓，你的评价就会下降，屡教不改甚至会被直接开除。想喘口气的时候，记得多留意身后。

报酬
努力工作赚取报酬，在7天内攒够100万日元。是把钱存起来，还是买道具，全由你决定。但千万别忘了你原本的目的。

游戏特点
以“内容审核员”为核心的异色游戏系统

复古UI与写实画面的诡异结合

仅需鼠标即可完成的基本操作

多结局

name: Imperialism
Starpath
summary:
独自一人或与好友一起建造你的星舰，探索无缝宇宙。规划航线，点燃推进器，在复古科技飞船中放松小憩、玩游戏，漂流穿越危机四伏的太空真空。驶入遥远星球轨道，揭开宇宙中我们是否真正孤独的答案。

你是否曾梦想驾驶一艘只属于自己的飞船，带着足够支撑一生深空旅程的一切，驶向宇宙深处？你是否好奇，作为一名失重宇航员，成为第一个踏上从未被探索过的星球……甚至整个星系的人，会是什么感觉？你会找到宇宙中是否还有其他生命的答案，还是最终面对无尽虚空中的寂静？

现在，你将亲身踏上梦寐以求的星际之旅。建造属于你的飞船，瞄准群星，点燃推进器，开启一场与众不同的太空冒险。

Starpath 是一种全新的太空游戏体验。它专注于真实置身宇宙、探索宇宙的沉浸感。我们致力于带来尽可能真实的宇航员体验，同时兼顾乐趣与创造力。这里没有近距离缠斗
，没有太空激光，没有虚假的重力，也没有刻意设计的太空贸易——只有你和你的飞船，直面冰冷的宇宙真空。

揭开宇宙的秘密
你在一座空间站中醒来，对眼前的处境一无所知，也不知道自己已经在那里停留了多久。你唯一知道的是，你无法回到地球。你会遵循屏幕上的指示，还是踏上属于自己的旅程？探索废弃飞船，揭开它们隐藏的秘密。成为第一个踏入全新星系的人类。你能否回答那个亘古的问题：在这片宇宙中，我们真的孤身一人吗？


设计并建造你的星舰
打造梦想中的星际飞船——每个按钮都可操作，每套系统都可定制，每块屏幕都有它的用途。

简单却强大的模块化建造系统，自由组合多种部件。

打造一个舒适、宜居且功能完善的深空之家。

将你的飞船设计成旋转式冯·布劳恩环，利用离心力创造人工重力。

设计专属于你的指挥驾驶舱。

确保船体密闭以维持大气环境；在遭遇陨石击穿时建立隔压舱室，并配置气闸舱进行舱外活动。


探索深空
规划穿越银河的航线，进入行星轨道。扫描获取数据，发射探测器采集样本与资源，并利用引力弹弓前往下一个目的地。

体验真正失重状态下的六自由度运动与惯性。别让自己误入错误方向却无力返回，否则你将一直漂流，直到宇宙尽头的寒冷死亡。

使用仪器扫描废弃飞船和小行星，回收资源、发现新科技，并揭开它们背后的故事。


管理飞船，生存下去
通过太阳能板、电池、大气控制系统和电子设备管理整艘飞船，让你的空间站和你自己在真空中存活。

种植并照料你的星际温室，维持氧气与食物储备。

执行舱外活动，建造设施或修复陨石带造成的损伤。


特色功能
完整支持离线单人游玩与在线合作多人模式。

探索废弃飞船与遗迹，收集资源并揭开它们的故事。

自由使用多种模块，打造属于你的舒适且功能齐全的星舰。

复古美术风格，灵感主要源自 70 至 80 年代经典科幻。

维持飞船运转、氧气供应与营养储备，在冰冷真空中生存。

建造专属气闸舱，执行舱外维修，修补陨石损坏的船体。

打造旋转式冯·布劳恩环提供人工重力，这里没有虚构重力发生器。

以真实比例与距离，无缝穿越太阳系、银河系乃至更远深空。

规划浩瀚宇宙中的航线，环绕行星轨道飞行，并借助引力弹弓驶向新的恒星系统。

扫描星球数据，派遣探测器采集样本与资源，推动科技发展。

科学严谨的真实物理。推进获得动量，减速只能反向点火，因此务必节省燃料。

宇宙中没有“上下”——角色与飞船都支持完整六自由度移动。

进入冷冻休眠跳过时间，更快抵达目的地，但务必设定好航线并提防陨石。

通过终端电脑、按钮与操纵杆控制飞船和生命维持系统。每个按钮都可使用且功能明确。

建造太阳能板、核反应堆和电池，为飞船系统供电，同时保留手动操纵杆应对断电。

除了关键飞船功能，你的终端还能完成许多任务，甚至还能玩游戏。

照料温室，确保氧气和食物供应充足。

回收废弃飞船资源，并发掘它们背后的故事。

name: うたう絵本4・5・6 Hi!Hi!
Pirate fishing
summary:
In the exciting game "Pirate fishing" you play as a fisherman and your task is to catch as many fish as possible to earn a lot of money. Pump up your fishing rod and try to set a record for catching fish every time!

In the exciting game "Pirate fishing" you play as a fisherman and your task is to catch as many fish as possible to earn a lot of money.

Not satisfied with the pace of production? Spend money on pumping your fishing rod:

- Controllability - the higher, the easier it is to control the direction of movement of the fishing hook.

- The length of the reel affects the depth from which you can catch fish.

- Speed - affects how fast you can get the prey out of the water.

- Fishing time - increase the duration of fishing.

- Dexterity - increase your level, the higher, the easier it will be to catch a fish.

- Bait - Raise the bait level in order to attract more fish species.

Pump up your fishing rod and try to set a record for catching fish every time!

name: After He Was Gone
summary:
"After He Was Gone" is a Tactical RPG. NO level-up system. Character's skills and items will change the battle situation significantly. Collect the treasures and lead therianthropes from getting out from the world of board game. Don’t worry. If YOU don’t lose hope, we can rewind the time any time.

Story
After the Creator has created therianthropes, several 100 years passed away.
Wolfy boy Fito was trapped in the world of board game, and found a creepy cat Kou which has a magic power.

Meet colorful characters with Fito & Kou and work together from getting out of this creepy world.

And YOU are the one who can help them.
Don’t worry.
We can rewind the time any time.
System

This game is a tactical role-playing game that doesn’t have level-up system.
The battle situations will significantly change by the skills and items which you robbed or picked up at the previous stage.

Like a “Shield”, there are items that supports your party by just having in their pockets.
And the other hand, there are items like a “Medicine” that doesn’t heal you until you use it.
Not all but, you can place some items on the ground and get their supports as well.

The blacky cat Kou also will be your item and supports your party.
She has a unique skills, but if the character who holds her is defeated, it is the game over.

All of the characters (including the boss enemies) has their own treasures.
You can steal them from enemies but Fito is the only one who has the stealing skill.
He is too weak to get reach to the boss enemies alone so support him with the other members.
Their story will change by having or not having these specific treasure items.

Other Features:
*Multiple endings
*For quitting the battle scene, the Quick Save is available.
*Skipping and changing the battle animation speed are always there for busy person.
*Unlimited Turn Rewind System.

name: Temple Trashers
summary:
A couch co-op tower defense game, in which the towers you build can hurt you and your friends just as much as they can hurt your enemies. Build towers, aim them towards your foes and collect the crystals that drop in order to build more turrets and survive the endless hordes of enemies!

Temple Trashers is a couch co-op tower defense game, in which the towers you build can hurt you and your friends just as much as they can hurt your enemies. Build towers, aim them towards your foes and collect the crystals that drop in order to build more turrets and survive the endless hordes of enemies!

You can play both: alone or with friends, with keyboard or controller, but we do recommend friends and controllers :)

The only limit to the amount of players able to play at the same time is the amount of controllers and/or friends you have!

The game is developed by a group of volunteer students from the Hackerspace NTNU student organization over the span of 2 years. The game is open-source and 100% free! 

Want to contribute, give feedback, report a bug or even just peek at our code? Head over to the official github page!

For other projects and information, take a look at Hackerspace's website.

name: Victim
summary:
A game like none other.  Victim invites you into the world of The Ominous Oppression.  A desolate landscape of horrors and mental anguish.  A place where only the mentally strong can survive and overcome the seemingly endless relentless trials of perpetuating devastation.   

Play as the Vulnerable Victim has no idea who he is. Has not idea where he is. And has so many questions as to why he must endure so much pain.

Collect hundreds of items and abilities towards instilling a sense of confidence and competence.  

Survive a world populated with many threats and hazards that beckon certain doom.

Explore top-down environments merged with dangerous 2D platforming 

Collect items & power-ups

Unlock new areas

Solve a large variety of puzzles

Find hidden secrets

Survive all threats

name: Lunar Camp Glenn
summary:
Lunar Camp Glenn is a STEM education simulation based on NASA plans and technology for ARTEMIS mission lunar base. It is the only first-person player game to explore the moon for resources to survive and meet with different characters to cooperate or not.

A STEM education simulation, Lunar Camp Glenn is the only FPS Lunar adventure game based on NASA current plans. The first-person player meets team in habitat and can walk around in the habitat. Player can go outside and walk on lunar surface and explore the moon for resources to survive by collecting ice, aluminum, titanium and gold. Amount of lunar resources acquired results in a final score. Player can explore caves for resources to collect and see new discoveries. Player will learn about the moon, lunar technologies, and laws that govern behavior on the moon. Lunar Camp Glenn is based on real NASA plans and technologies for ARTEMIS mission to establish a lunar base. The role of the player is based on NASA plans for the astronauts living on the moon. Player will meet different characters to cooperate or not, from China, commercial astronauts, and pirates. Principles of cooperation are based on mathematical "Game Theory" outcomes. For example, "win-win or lose-lose" negotiations.

name: Terminate: Study X
summary:
Become the machine, find out what happened in New Sapiens and eradicate the infected in a single player first-person shooter campaign of horror and gore.

Terminate: Project X is a horror first-person shooter inspired by dystopian, violent and 
grimdark themes. 

FEATURES

 Two difficulties, Hard and Nightmare

 6 Unique maps

 Several types of special infected

 Objectives

In the game the player is sent as an artificial intelligence robot to the recently 
closed genetic engineering facility known as New Sapiens. After the COO of the 
facility, Dr. Feller, announced that a new disease took over their genetically 
enhanced human specimens, nasty rumors spread in the media. Majority of the 
population were against experiments with humans to begin with. New Sapiens 
took it a step further by carrying out research with newborn babies, which granted 
the homo sapiens species the best properties of all animals combined: high IQ of 
human, speed of cheetah, strength of gorilla, jump of spider… the hijacked list 
continued.

name: MYRNEscapes
summary:
A single player exploration game, with audio-reactive elements set to the music of MYRNE's Circles EP

Explore 4 vast, scenic landscapes with audio-reactive elements inspired by the music of MYRNE's EP "Circles".
What Can I Do:
Set amongst red sands, this world is littered with runes and artefacts of a once-powerful society. Undiscovered constellations and celestial bodies move across the sky above you as you explore, illuminating new secrets to discover.
Circles:
A spelunking adventure within a vast, mystical cave. Unlock and interact with the mysteries of the Circles as you make your way through an ancient cave system.
Emotion:
Set in a verdant, lush plateau, explore the remnants of a lost tribe as they try to tell you their stories through flickering artefacts. Relax in a stoic experience atop the cliffs; but stay away from the edges.
Faithless:
A dense, forested jungle is littered with bioluminescent flora, surrounding a mystic river. Cliffs and otherworldly plants keep vantage points well-hidden. Daylight cycles are extremely short, so plan your explorations wisely.

name: Vowel Movements
summary:
In Vowel Movements you race against the clock to group words together into categories. The only catch is that each of the vowels has been replaced by a different vowel. Surely that can’t make things too difficult…

Overview

In Vowel Movements you race against the clock to group words together into categories. The only catch is that each of the vowels has been replaced by a different vowel.

Gameplay

You are given a grid of 16 words that need to be grouped together into four categories before the timer expires. To make things slightly more tricky all of the words have had their vowels replaced by other vowels making them surprisingly difficult to read.

If you’re stuck on a particular word you can trade some of your time to unscramble the vowels. There is also a time penalty for any set of words that is incorrectly grouped, so random guessing and blind clicking are probably not the way to go.

Daily Challenge - Each day a puzzle will be set that is the same for everyone in the world. Will you be the first of your friends to solve it?

Arcade Mode - There is also a mode that you can play anytime, where you receive a score based upon how quickly you complete each level.

If you still think this all sounds far too easy, why not try to solve the puzzles in the trailer?

Your challenge awaits...

name: War In Heaven
summary:
Chaotic boss-rush, bullet-hell-y, twin-stick arena shooter mayhem! Dynamically changing arena forces you to be vigilant: Watch the bullets, watch the walls!

War in Heaven?
War In Heaven takes what you know from the classic bullet-hell genre and introduces a dynamically changing arena that forces you to be constantly vigilant. It is a short game focused on highly polished twin-stick shooter combat between you and your enemy. The enemy will try to corner you in the heat of battle so you must use your wits and battle instincts to stay one step ahead, or risk death.
Gameplay

 Touhou + Furi, Bullet-hell Boss Rush gameplay!

Short, highly polished classic twin-stick shooter action

The enemy will try to corner you in the dynamically changing arena

Get yourself out in a pinch using the bomb.

Features

Fight different bosses, each with multiple phases.

Multiple difficulties for the newcomers, or for the trained!

name: Godless grove
summary:
Godless grove - survival horror with elements of a hunting simulator in an open world filled with horrors. Uncover the terrible secrets of the locals and overcome the disgusting creatures of evil that have gathered over this grove.

Godless grove - survival horror game with elements of an open world hunting simulator.

Adapt to the changing conditions of the grove, learn how to survive, discover the terrible secrets of the locals and overcome the disgusting creatures of evil that filled this forest.

.

● The oppressive atmosphere of a dying East Slavic village

● Get food and resources by hunting. Use decoys, traps and don't make too much noise

● Fight terrible monsters and find a way to stop them forever

● High difficulty, the decision to engage in direct combat can cost you a life

name: MechVS: Battlefronts
summary:
Multiplayer MECH PvP battles! Select your Mecha avatar and go to the battlefield, earn points and upgrade & customize your robot!

MechVS: Battlefronts is a top-down, isometric, real-time, casual multiplayer game where you play as a Battle Mech pilot. Start with a base setup and upgrade during battle. Make the mech just how YOU like it by using earned points to upgrade: melee damage, ranged damage and speed! In the other hand, saved points will make you have more health points, bigger size and bigger range.

This simple system allows for replayability and tons of fun!  Build your mecha as you fight, following different aproaches: Big Mech, with long range weak attack? Fast, medium sized with average range and melee? Small with either strong melee or ranged (short range) attack? Many more combinations can be done!

Up to 40 players per room, we have servers set in US and Asia.

:::::::::

Full release feature 20 mech designs with 3 color variants each, totalling 60 mech avatars. In the image below the 20 distinct designs are shown.

This one-page guide details all the elements you will find during battles (appart from other players).

Beware of Kaijus! They are everywhere. They are not hard to kill in a 1-vs-1 encounter once you have some upgrades, but at start of game they can decimate your starting HP and leave you weak in front of other players.

You can leave at any time! The game has no progression record to worry about. It is a casual game for every day that has free time to be filled with mech-packed action!

name: Nexus 5X
summary:
探索、拓张、开发、征服，节奏快速。无论是单人游玩还是在 2—8 名玩家参与的多人游戏中，你都可以通过 60 分钟快节奏的对局，尽情享受这款史诗般 4X 回合制游戏中的深度、外交、冲突与征服。

与朋友们来一场深度策略棋盘游戏对局，能带来无与伦比的刺激与欢乐。而《奈克瑟斯 5X》足够在游戏之夜展开多轮精彩对局，让勉强的“最后一回合”变成畅快的“再来亿局”。

选择独特的派系和领袖，单人游玩或组成 2—8 名玩家参与的回合制多人游戏。与朋友共享欢乐，或在奈克瑟斯在线模式中匹配旗鼓相当的对手。缔结貌似不可能的联盟、展开刻骨铭心的背叛，或在暗处悄悄密谋，在大约 60 分钟内成功登上银河系的王座。

玩家将从安全的母星出发，在银河系中迅速扩张自己的势力，探索并占领新星系，最终控制帝位之星奈克瑟斯。随着扩张与探索，军事冲突和外交交易都将成为可行的选项，但参与星系理事会中的权力斗争同样重要，因为对手帝国将利用其影响力左右投票，支持他们所需的新头衔和议案，从而增强派系的实力或推进战略目标。

无论是想要沉浸于《Stellaris》宇宙丰富设定的玩家，还是习惯“精打细算”的策略游戏爱好者，在每局游戏中都可以选择不同的派系与领袖从而调整制胜方式，以丰富多样的游戏玩法来抢占先机、赢得胜利。

Alice is a dreamy girl who lives between the real and imaginary worlds, in love with the wrong person. Just before that situation becomes unsustainable, things change unexpectedly, and a new path opens for her and those around her.

Short Sad Stories is a visual novel that tells the intertwined stories of a group of young adults, exposed to unexpected dilemmas, misfortunes, and complex romances. A story-rich tale of overcoming, reward, and hope, in which the player must make the most relevant decisions to drive the story.

The content has a realistic basis and addresses dramatic situations that may be sensitive to some audiences. However, it's not about pain but about the strength to overcome, the desire to improve and the beauty of life as it is.

name: Breaking & Entering
summary:
Run, steal, hide, and try not to get caught! Guards patrol and will chase you if they see you. Steal what you can, but be careful so you don't get weighed down. Guards and cameras protect these treasures. Do you think you have what it takes to become a master thief?

Play as a thief in this single player, 2D, pixel style game. Sneak around and collect as much treasure as you can while trying not to get caught. With each treasure pick up, you get heavier and slower making it easier to get caught. Opening your inventory and dropping items can increase your speed again. Security cameras and patrolling guards are protecting these treasures. Keeping out of sight will keep you from being pursued. Don't take too long though. You only have two minutes to complete these heists, otherwise, the guards will know you broke in. Remember, your ultimate goal is to not get caught!

Features:

 A short and replayable game

 Steal jewels, gems, and gold in each of the 18 levels

 Test your skills by completing all 5 challenges in 1 round

 2 types of locks requiring either a key or money level to unlock

name: Chromatic
summary:
Chromatic is a 2D Side-Scroller where your goal is to bring color into a monochrome world by using your abilities to traverse new terrain and defeat enemies.

The world is monochrome. It is your quest to defeat those evil adversaries who have taken the color, and restore the world to its colorful state.

In this 2D Side-Scroller, you will travel across four different levels, restoring color to the world as you progress.

Jump, Dash, Grapple, and more in this colorful 2D adventure!

Progression
In Chromatic, you will fight multiple bosses, each releasing a new color when you defeat it. As you restore color to the world (and yourself), you will also discover new abilities to help you traverse difficult landscapes and give you an advantage against enemies.

Features
- Four unique levels containing varying landscapes, themes, obstacles, enemies, and bosses
- Four special abilities unlocked with new colors
- Themed music for each level
- Color.

Development
This game was made across two semesters (15% of the game in the first semester, and 85% in the second).

Warning:
This game may not be for you if you have an avid fear of any of the following: water, color, vibrance, bunnies that pelt you with wooden pellets, giant two-dimensional frogs, music, clouds, wind, annoying lava chickens, falling, failing, running, dashing, jumping, moving, sand, people, or fun.

name: Cosmopoly
summary:
COSMOPOLY - is a multiplayer board game for 1-6 players. Play with friends, buy planets and space stations, participate in auctions and trade, build upgrades and become dominant in space.

COSMOPOLY is an economic/random/strategic board game for groups of up to 6 players.
Look for optimal ways, hope for luck and capture as many businesses on the field as possible, avoiding penalty cells and other people's businesses.

Build your strategy by collecting and using items at the right moment.

Be careful and monitor the situation in the system, Anthony will help you keep up to date with all the latest news. And don't forget, the longer the game goes on, the higher the penalties and costs!

Take money from other players, make profitable deals and become the richest man in the solar system! And detailed statistics at the end of the game will help you analyze the game and measure success with other players.

Chat, argue, laugh and have fun

If you like Monopoly, Manager or Merchant, then this game is for you.

name: Infinitevania
summary:
nfinitevania 是一款2D平台游戏，采用类银河战士恶魔城风格，深受 恶魔城：月下夜想曲 的启发，并融入了 空洞骑士 的元素。游戏专注于战斗、探索、解谜、升级和扣人心弦的故事情节。

探索不同的世界
击败这些世界中最强大的生物，吸收它们的力量，变得更强，最终摧毁 Infinitevania 的核心，回到自己的世界。

面对强大的敌人
制定独特的策略，适应每一场战斗，并在冒险中不断前进。

解决谜题
解决引人入胜的谜题，解锁新区域和隐藏的秘密。

生存于致命陷阱
穿越充满危险的环境，每一步都将考验你的技能和反应能力。

收集升级以变得更强大
在冒险过程中不断提升你的能力和装备。

name: There Swings a Skull: Grim Tidings
summary:
Enter the doomed town of Pareildas. Watch as the flames turn bone and stone to ash. Like joined wicks, we'll all burn together.

THERE SWINGS A SKULL

The town of Pareildas stands in the center of a vast desert. Its citizens live their lives quietly. Or, at least, they once did.

In recent days the speaker-gallows sprang, weedlike, in the heart of the town - and since its inception the denizens of Pareildas have been sacrificed, one by one. The electric words that spew from the gallows claim this is to staunch the blistering hatred of the vengeful sun... but the heat has only grown more and more unbearable.
OUR PROTAGONISTS

Anatoli works for the town train station. He dreams of leaving Pareildas, so that he might peacefully live out the rest of his life with his husband. His dreams share much in common with the blackened husks of the town's denizens that line the streets.

Pyotr is an independent artist. He hopes, deeply, that he might do something to stop the hellfire slowly consuming Pareildas. But the price of stopping the natural order is immensely steep - and, of course, there's no guarantee this is a natural occurrence at all...
ABOUT THE GAME

There Swings a Skull: Grim Tidings is a narrative-horror game built in RPG Maker 2003 by Conor Walsh and Quinn K., with music by Leaf Let. Though the game initially released as a jam game it was so well-received - and sat so well with our team - that we decided to build it out into a full game.

Conor Walsh is a professional narrative designer who has written on such titles as The Outer Worlds, A Place, Forbidden, The DreadX Collection 2, and many others.

Quinn K. brought indie darling OFF to the English-speaking world and recently released the stylish and moody AN OUTCRY.

We hope you enjoy our work.
FEATURES

A deep central narrative

Gorgeous pixel and fullscreen graphics

A unique, haunting soundtrack

Two separate routes and a third that we dare not mention

Multiple endings

A hateful sun

The endless ocean

Dea

Everyone's heard of Mothman– the moth creature that haunts the outskirts of Point Pleasant, West Virginia– but no one's heard of it like this! In some random idyllic Midwestern town, you meet Artemis (aka Mothman) at your favorite coffee shop and begin an agonizingly slow burn romance with them.

Everyone's heard of Mothman– the big, scary, feathery moth creature that haunts around the outskirts of Point Pleasant, West Virginia– but no one's ever heard of it like this! In some random idyllic Midwestern town, you meet Artemis (aka Mothman) at your favorite coffee shop and begin an agonizingly slow burn romance with them. 

Go around town, explore different locations, and meet sexy humanized versions of all your favorite cryptids and fantasy creatures

Custom pronoun options that allow you to use multiple pronoun sets as well as input your own neopronouns

Have the freedom and ability to say no to anything without it negatively impacting the characters' view of you or the story itself, creating a comfortable and welcoming experience

See your relationship with Artemis grow and progress over the course of thirteen weeks and get to choose what kind of physical contact you have with them

About 152,000 words and 7-9 hours of playtime

It's a queer, slow burn, coffee shop AU like what's not to love!!!!!

Cryptid Coffeehouse is a very casual, slice-of-life game about living in the American Midwest, meeting new people, and developing feelings for someone. It's a game about relationships and the importance of consent, permission, and respect in those relationships, especially relationships that are between stages. And, as corny as it sounds, it's a game about being yourself.

Content warnings: swearing, mentions of recreational alcohol & marijuana consumption, sexual tension, and a lot of kissing ;)

summary:
PR会社で働く、明るく真っ直ぐな27歳の女性・柴崎ひまり（岡本夏美）は、見た目とは違い、性欲が強めなこともあり、歴代彼氏と性生活の不一致で別れてきたことがトラウマとなっていた。ある日、友人が軒並み結婚していくことに焦るひまりは、いつものように、大学時代からの親友で、職場の同僚でもある北条和巳（沢村玲）を飲みに誘い愚痴をこぼす。そんなひまりとは反対に長年恋人を作らず、焦りを見せない和巳。しかし、相性のいい人と出会いたいと言うひまりに、和巳は突然「俺で試してみる？」と提案する。
これまでどこか一線を引いている気がしていた和巳の思わぬ行動に驚くひまりだが、親友なのに…と戸惑いながらも、一線を超えてしまうことに──！そして何でも言い合える仲だった二人の関係は次第に形を変えていき…
親友になら本音を言えるのに。親友でいいと思っていたのに─
それぞれが抱える過去により、踏み出すことのできなかった二人が、親友の枠を超え、「友情」と「恋愛」の狭間で葛藤する、胸キュン間違いなしの、甘く危険な等身大ラブストーリー。

name: アノマリス／ANOMALITH
summary:
昭和██年。日本。

前触れもなく発生する特殊空間『異界』。

17歳の少女『水無月 玲緒奈』は、異界で行方不明となった友人を見つけるため

政府が設立した『危険区画対策室』の調査要員となる。

初の調査任務で、多くの調査要員が犠牲となる中、

特異な力が彼女に現れる。

生き残った彼女は、異界の深淵へと足を踏み入れていく。

消えた友人の行方、異界の発生原因、特異な力の謎。

それら全てが明かされるとき、彼女が目にするものとは―――

異形うごめく世界を生き抜け。

summary:
The Adventures of Sir Kicksalot是一款第一人称动作游戏，你可以通过多种方式击败敌人：无论是武器、法术、潜行，还是使用战术将他们一脚踢进致命尖刺。

探索一场精心打造的战役，其中充满了独特的关卡、荒诞的情境，以及一个从拯救公主开始、随后迅速彻底失控的愚蠢故事。

⚔️ 投身激战 ?

使用近战和远程武器对抗敌人。无论是砍、劈、砸、刺，狠狠干掉你的对手。格挡他们的进攻，或是翻滚躲避。把你的武器掷向敌人，解除他们的武装，擒拿、抛投他们，甚至把他们踢向一切——或是把一切踢向他们。

? 释放元素之力❄️

施展多重法术，如焚烧、冰冻、电击、幻术或念力。用法术巧妙地在地面布置陷阱，或是为你的武器注入能力。如果还是不够，那就直接控制敌人的心智。

?️ 潜入阴影之中 ?

在护卫巡逻中悄然穿行，并从背后发起致命一击，扒窃他们的武器，躲进木桶，或者分散他们的注意力。

? 利用环境??

充分利用环境场景中植入的各种危险要素。把敌人踢进尖刺、水中、火海或是深渊。向他们投掷箱子、桌子、红色炸药桶™、尸体、甚至是活着的敌人。把他们踢下楼梯让他们狠狠摔倒。使用火把或灯具把他们点燃——万物皆可为你所用，化为武器。

summary:
1300年前の恋の歌が、現代の恋にリンクする――。会いたくて、言えなくて、泣きたくなる。そんな“会えない夜”に読みたくなる、わたしの恋の物語。万葉集の和歌から生まれた、切なくて愛しい恋物語を5話収録。いま、万葉の恋が、わたしの恋と重なる。

~第1話~ 「君し踏みてば」
4月に転任してきた美術の先生に秘かに思いを寄せる泉。千曲川での写生大会の日、どこを描くか迷っていると、先生に声を掛けられ、うれしい気持ちに!しかし、名前で呼んでもらえず、先生の中の自分の存在の小ささに悲しくなる。泉の切ない恋心が1300年前の和歌とリンクする。

~第2話~ 「紐解き設けな」
お互いに気になる存在であった絵斗と千結。しかし、七夕祭りで千結のチア衣装を汚してしまったことをきっかけに絵斗は千結の顔を見られなくなってしまう。そのまま、別々の高校へ行き、1度も会えないまま1年がたつ。絵斗は「来年も行く」と言っていた千結の言葉を信じて七夕祭りへ向かうが…。

~第3話~ 「来むとは待たじ」
同じクラスの陸上部の男の子、小山君に恋する主人公。メッセージのやりとりをするようになったが、どうやら小山君には同じ部活の彼女がいるらしい。それなのに「キミのことがいちばん好き」と思わせぶりなことを言ってくる小山君。その言葉を信じ、10月31日、ハロウィン限定パフェを頼んでカフェで…。勇気を出して行動した、切ない恋の結末は…。

~第4話~ 「月の舟」
連休に海が近いおばさんの家へ遊びにきた沙月は、コンビニで海斗と出会う。2人は、それぞれの過去にとらわれて縛られたボートと同じように時間が止まっていた。沙月がこの町を去る前日、海斗に再び夜、海に来るように言われる。月に照らされ、2人の止まった時間がボートとともに、動き出す…!

~第5話~ 「恋ひ恋ひて」
中学最後のバレンタイン。愛は勇気を出して友樹にチョコを渡す。2人の距離は少しずつ縮まるが、友樹は卒業したらサッカー強豪校の寮に入ることを知る。ホワイトデーに2人で会うことになり、希望に満ちた高校生活を熱く語る友樹。そこにあたしはいないんだ……。愛は悲しくなり、走ってお店を飛び出す。ひとり佇んでいると、追いかけてきた友樹に手をつかまれ…。

恋ひ恋ひて、君を想ふ――
それは、いつの時代も変わらない。

name: 中出しティータイム・召しませクリームパイ
summary:
主人公はフリーター。
バイトの合間に・・・というか、皆勤賞間違い無しの通いっぷりで行く喫茶店がある。

ある日、いつものように喫茶店に行くと、見慣れないメニューが挟まっているのを発見してしまう。
それは、夜専用の裏メニューで、名付けて「クリームパイ・セット」というものだった。

内容は「ウェイトレスとオマ●コ、中出しもＯＫ」という夢のようなサービス。喫茶店にはありえないお値段だが、試す価値はある魅惑のメニューだった。

その秘密のメニューを知ってしまった主人公は、否応なく喫茶店と関わっていくことになります・・・。

本作品は、お気楽極楽の簡単ＡＶＧ。
お客として楽しむのもよし、バイトとして参加するのもよし。エッチなサービスでいっぱいです。

夫・クリスの身を守るため、アルデラはより強力な黒魔術をかけることを決意。「これはキスじゃない、黒魔術よ」そう自分に言い聞かせながらクリスに口づけを重ねていくうちに、アルデラを嫌っているはずのクリスの態度がなぜか甘々に急変して──⁉すれ違いから始まるラブファンタジー、二人が辿り着く恋の結末とは――。

summary:
「何度でも約束するよ、アリサを守る、ずっとそばにいると──」

前総督の不正を暴き、領地経営の第一歩を踏み出したアリサとアレクサンドル。
愛情を確かめ合い、平穏な日々が続く……かと思いきや、挨拶に向かった南の領地でアレクサンドルに命の危機が……！？
さらにはアリサの妹・エレナも領地にやってきて、二人に愛の証明を求める……！

領地経営の危機に、二人の愛が試される！
不器用だけど愛おしい、溺愛ラブファンタジー第2巻！

name: 妹恋だいあり～2
気弱な令嬢と追放殿下のイチャイチャ領地経営！～一途で可愛い婚約者を、わたしが一流の領主にしてみせます！～ (3)
summary:
「そのままのあなたを、わたしは愛しています」

リトリアの問題を解決し、領地発展の兆しが見え始めたアリサとアレクサンドル。
しかし王都からの命令により再び領地経営の危機に瀕してしまう。
第二王子派に妨害されながらも、アリサは資金調達の協力を求めて隣国の大公の元へ赴くことに。
しかし隣国の大公・クヌートから、驚きの条件を提示され……！？
そして明かされる、アレクサンドルが抱えていた秘密とは──

気弱な令嬢と追放殿下の溺愛ラブファンタジー、堂々完結！

name: おおぉ! 妹の穴キュン ～学校の用務員も～
summary:
「おおぉ！るすばんはドキドキ」の完結編です。（最後のおおぉ！シリーズ）
妹と妹の友人とキャンプに行ったお兄ちゃんは、そのときの妹の友人とつきあうことに。
しかしその娘が結構ヤキモチ焼きで、その後妹とはトンとご無沙汰である。
そんなときに妹の学校から電話が…。
保健室で寝ている妹を見てると、お兄ちゃんは我慢できず学校で始まっちゃいます。
表ストーリーでは、お兄ちゃん視点と、妹視点の2ストーリー。
途中、イベントから裏ストーリーへ。
学校の用務員の2ストーリーの計4話。
今回も、女の子フルボイス仕様、またムービーはそれぞれ長めで42ムービー以上と
充実の1本に仕上げました！

name: 夢触手!
summary:
ある日、主人公“みゆき”宛てに小包が。中身はパンツが入ってるという缶詰。
おまけにそのパンツ、“ドリームショーツ”と称し、それを履いて寝るといろんな夢が見れるというスグレモノ！
優等生の“みゆき”も興味津々で夢の中へ！

name: エロゲ的に妹好き!
両腕が折れたのでHなお世話をされる話
summary:
帰り道、猫を追いかけて道路に少女が飛び出す場面に遭遇する主人公『菊池隼人』。
そこへトラックが猛スピードで突っ込んできて、慌てて少女と猫を助けるために道路にダイブした。

「あぶなーいっ！　どんっ！！」

結果として、少女と猫は救われたが
隼人は両腕複雑骨折全治半年の大怪我を負ってしまった。

そんな絶望的な隼人の前に現れたのは、命を救った少女楠木あいり。
なんとあいりは隼人の身の回りのお世話をなにもかもしてくれると言う。

「大丈夫です！　わたしが全部お世話をしてあげますっ！！」

あまりに突然過ぎる自体に状況が飲み込めず、困惑する隼人だったが
あいりの圧に気圧され、不思議なお世話生活がはじまってしまう。

「わたしの……初めてをもらってください！！！」

ふたりの関係は、はたしてどうなってしまうのか———

name: ケモノミチ ～白の刹那～
summary:
男は巨剣を手にし、組織から脱走を図る。

追撃を逃れ、彷徨う男。そんな彼の目の前に…

あの少女は現れた。

銀髪を靡（なび）かせ現れた少女の手には、
場違いにも感じられる長刀が握られていた。

少女は男を視認すると、弾かれたように襲いかかる。

肉体を改造・強化された男を、少女の神速とも言える剣戟が、
徐々に追いつめていく…

何故少女が彼を狙うのか、

少女の目が、暗闇で「赤く」光っていた…

summary:
在《天方夜谭》所有的故事里，最神奇的莫过于阿拉丁的冒险。
他（魔法师）来到了阿拉丁的村庄——据说这个村子靠近中国边境——假扮成阿拉丁失散多年的叔叔，承诺要把自己的财富全都留给阿拉丁，借此博取他的帮助。在某个片段中，这位魔法师讲述了自己游历中国、印度和波斯的经历，银幕上随之出现他这些冒险的蒙太奇画面；影片对那个时代其他文化的展现方式颇有意思。全片还穿插了一些不必要的填充内容，角色们会突然唱起歌来，而这些歌曲除了流水账似的交代部分情节之外，毫无用处……

很久很久以前，在非洲某个地方，有一位本土魔法师，他一心梦想得到神灯。借助一颗魔法球，他得知那盏神灯藏在一个亚洲村庄里，并且只有年轻人纯洁无瑕的手才能把它取走。于是，他动身前往那个靠近中国边境、名叫“三丘城”的村子。阿拉丁就生活在那里。

summary:
很久很久以前，发生了一场可怕的地震。结果，原本无忧无虑的猴子们不得不逃往安全地带。随着时间的慢慢推移，加上无知和迷信，猴子渐渐分成两群——树猴和地猴。树猴卡姆一直是妈妈格外担心的那个儿子，因为他不像哥哥一样老实本分，卡姆活跃、大胆，总是做出一些出乎意料的事来。在数猴的部落有一个传统，就是要牢牢地抓住树枝，千万不能掉到树下。因为在他们看来，所有的事物都是上面好，下面坏，传说树下的世界充满魔鬼，一旦掉下去就会万劫不复。
　　其他的树猴都怕极了，只有卡姆不这么想，对于下面的世界他十分好奇。一日在张望下面的世界的时候，卡姆掉了下去，所有的同伴都为他伤心，以为他必死无疑。但幸运的是，卡姆被恰巧从丛林里路过的地猴国王所救，并把他带回宫中治疗，很快卡姆就康复了。正如卡姆所料，树的下面并没有魔鬼，而地猴的进化和发展也已经达到了一定的程度，其文明度也比树猴要高很多。但与此同时，卡姆在这里也发现了在树猴那没有的狡诈与争斗。

summary:
【黑魔岛】的惊险历程
　　从小在孤儿院长大的『小鬼』，不记得小时候的事，也不晓得自己的父母是谁，甚至不知道自己真正的名字。每天被关在孤儿院里受到不人道的奴役，无法掌控自己的命运，对于孤儿院外的世界，只能全凭想像。然而，渴望自由的念头一直没有停过，在孤儿院唯一的乐趣就是听说书人讲黑魔海盗的故事，梦想长大后能像这位海盗一样伟大。
　　有一天，他捡到一张从海盗故事书里掉出的地图，并趁机跳窗逃离了孤儿院，当他被海浪冲到岸边时，有两名通缉犯--马盖仙及瘦竹竿救了他。为了完成自己的梦想，『小鬼』偷了海防队的巡逻船，出发寻找梦想中的黑魔岛。船上有个被通缉的非洲逃兵--塔卡以及一只叫做吉姆的猴子，在某次靠岸补给时，又遇到了年轻的修道士，为了利用她识字的能力，小鬼迫使她一同上船，就这样一行人开始了寻找宝藏的旅程，在航海期间，意想不到的冒险却接二连三发生，但一次次的惊险遭遇也让失根的『小鬼』慢慢找回真正的自我。

name: FORTUNE BRIDE - 絶頂開眼の儀式 -
summary:
◆快楽に堕ちるか、奈落に落ちるか◆

学校の屋上で突如気を失った俺。
目を覚ますと、そこは見知らぬ赤い礼拝堂。
そばには震える幼馴染の「木葉」。

礼拝堂には巨大なモニターとそこに映るゲームマスター。
「君たちには『花嫁候補』選別のゲームに参加してもらう」
スロットを通じて木葉のカラダを絶頂へ"堕とし"、「死の期限」までにノルマを達成すること。
それが叶わなければ、床が抜け、"落ちる"。

彼女を自らの手で開発し尽くすしか、生き残る道はない…。

◆ゲーム概要◆

アナタは、どこにでもいる普通の高校生の「蓮」。

ある日、校長から手渡された一粒のチョコレート。
それを共に口にした幼馴染の木葉と意識を失い、目を覚ますとそこは、見知らぬ赤い礼拝堂の中だった。

モニターに映し出されたゲームマスターは、静かに告げる。

「君たちには『花嫁候補』選別のためのゲームに参加してもらう。」
「スロットを通じて彼女を絶頂へ導き、『第三の目』を開眼させるのだ。」
「ノルマを達成できなければ床が開く。蓮君、君は死ぬことになる。」

スロットの絵柄は、足・首・口・胸・クリ〇リス・お○んこ・お尻・——木葉のあらゆる部位に対応している。
スロットを回すとポイントが手に入り、木葉を快感が襲う。
稼いだポイントで購入したチャームが、ノルマ達成への細い一本道を切り拓いていく。

ノルマを一つ一つクリアするごとに、ゲームマスターからの要求は過激になっていく。

そして、手にするチャーム次第で、彼女の精神そのものすら、形を変えていく。
恥じらいながらも応えようとする「ノーマル」、罵倒で抗ってくる「反抗」、自ら快楽を求めてしまう「アヘ」、刺激にすら反応を返さなくなる「虚無」——。

真面目で、才色兼備で、誰もが憧れた幼馴染。
そんな彼女が、あなたのスロットの目によって、あなただけの「花嫁」へと堕ちていく。

閉ざされた礼拝堂の中で、死の期限を十回生き延びるのだ…。

name: Subculture Adventure!
summary:
서브컬처 문화는 정말 매력적인 부분들이 많다고 생각합니다. 좋아하는 캐릭터나 창작물에 빠져서 몰두하는 사람들이 모여, 만들고, 소비하고, 즐기는 문화...
저 역시 동인 음악 활동을 하면서 가볍게 시작한 리믹스 및 부틀렉 활동이었습니다. 그렇게 어느샌가 많은 시간이 흘러서, 많은 리믹스와 부틀렉들을 작곡하게 되었습니다.
그래서 준비했습니다. 여러분들을 위한, 오로지 저의 리믹스와 부틀렉만으로 이루어진 앨범!
이번 앨범을 위해 새롭게 준비하거나 업데이트한 곡 13곡과, 예전에 만든 곡 13곡을 함께 취합하였습니다! 헥사큐브가 직접 선별한 리믹스 트랙!
오로지 제 취향 100%로 이루어진, 여러분들이 알던 곡을 더 신나게 즐길 수 있도록 하기 위한 앨범!
1디스크(1번~13번 곡)는 중독성 위주의 곡으로, 2디스크(14~26번 곡)는 전개 및 감성 위주의 곡으로 구성했습니다.
많이 들어주세요! 그리고, 디제잉 장에서도 많이 즐겨주세요! 감사합니다!

I think subculture has so many uniquely charming aspects. It’s a culture where people come together around the characters and works they love, creating, sharing, consuming, and enjoying them together.
For me, remixing and making bootlegs started out as something casual alongside my doujin music activities, but before I knew it, a lot of time had passed and I had built up quite a collection of remixes and bootlegs.
So here it is: an album made entirely of my remixes and bootlegs!
I have compiled 13 songs newly prepared or updated for this album, along with 13 previously created tracks! Remix tracks personally selected by Hexacube!
A release driven 100% by my own taste, made to help you enjoy familiar songs in a more exciting way.
Disc 1 (Track No.1~13) consists of songs focused on addictiveness, while Disc 2 (Track No.14~26) consists of songs focused on emotion.
I hope you enjoy listening to it, and I hope it brings even more fun to your DJ sets too. Thank you!

name: Two Strikes
summary: 深入古日本的心脏地带，展开一场2D武士对决盛宴，感受令人屏息的手绘动画之美。化身无畏的武士、勇猛的僧兵，或桀骜不驯的浪人，在生死一线的激烈决斗中，每一击都可能成为最后一舞。

name: ラクガキショータイム
summary:
『ラクガキショータイム』は、1999年7月29日にトレジャーが開発、エニックス（現、スクウェア・エニックス）が発売したPlayStation用対戦アクションゲーム。マルチタップ・デュアルショック対応。

2008年6月25日にゲームアーカイブスでの配信が開始された。

創造主ゴッドハンドによって創られた、主人公ユキヲたち。「ビッグダディー」が率いる謎の敵集団と、不思議なステージの上で戦いが毎日のように繰り広げられている。

3Dと「らくがき」風の絵が融合した奇妙なグラフィックが特徴的である。

1人用の「ノーマルモード」はステージクリア型の構成となっており、登場する敵をすべて倒すことで次のステージへ進むことができる。自分の体力が多いなど、有利な状況で勝ち続けると、難易度が上昇し、登場する敵キャラクターが強力なものになっていく。負けることで難易度が低下し、敵が弱いものになる。

最大4人対戦が行える「バーサスモード」ではチーム戦の設定も可能。

アニメーションも導入されており、制作はスタジオ・ファンタジアが担当。

name: Tactics Wanderer
summary:
Tactics Wanderer is a classic-style Strategy RPG (SRPG) that emphasizes deep character customization and tactical decision-making. As the lead developer at Critical Damage Studio, I have poured my passion into creating a nostalgic yet fluid experience, featuring over 40 distinct classes and a gripping narrative.

Core Gameplay Features
• An Epic Journey: Navigate through a rich campaign featuring no less than 24 strategic chapters.

• The Seven Heroes: Command 7 main units, each with a deep progression tree. Evolve your characters through Tier 2,    3, and 4, with branching paths (2 choices per tier) for every level.

• Strategic Support: Utilize specialized support units, including Backpackers, Blacksmiths, and Bards,

  to turn the tide of battle.

• Class Masterclass: Discover and master over 40 unique classes, allowing for endless tactical combinations.

Units & Combat Systems
• Skill Customization: Beyond innate class skills, enhance your units by equipping Skill Rings.

  Combine these with class abilities to create devastating skill combos tailored to your playstyle.

• Resource Management: Skills are divided into Active and Passive. Active skills require strategic

  use of Mana or Items as a cost to deliver immediate impact on the battlefield.

• Equipment & Crafting: Standard weapons do not have a durability system and can be used indefinitely.

  However, powerful Masterwork weapons crafted by the Blacksmith offer superior stats but come with limited     durability.

• Challenge Your Strategy: There is no permanent death in the standard mode. However, for those seeking a challenge,

  Hard Mode features a "Zero Casualty" rule—if any player unit falls in battle, it is an immediate Game Over.

The Story
After generations of conflict, the seven kingdoms of the Athelon continent finally united in peace. But the tranquility was shattered by the Armond, a mysterious and relentless race from an unknown land. Refusing all diplomacy, the Armond have besieged Athelon for a desperate bid for survival, Athelon has formed elite expeditionary units to sail toward the unknown origin of their invaders. Journey alongside 7 Heroes from the 7 Kingdoms to uncover the truth behind the Armond and find a way to end the war forever.

name: むちむちシスター 転生先でどスケベご奉仕ライフ
summary:
保育士として働いている主人公「もも」は、小さな体と貧乳がコンプレックスの心優しい女の子。
同じ職場の先輩に恋心を抱いている。
ようやく恋が実りかけたある日、不慮の事故で川に落下してしまう――。

目覚めた場所は、見知らぬ異世界。
しかも今度の自分は、金髪・巨乳・長身のむちむちボディだった！?

赤髪のシスター「ダリア」に拾われたももは、「カトレア」という新たな名を与えられ、「ラグラス」という街の教会で働きながら暮らすことに…。

この世界には、「ガラム」と呼ばれる良い行いをすると貯まり、消費することで願い事が叶う不思議なポイントが存在する。
教会の奉仕活動をすることで地道に「ガラム」を貯めて元の世界に帰ろうとするカトレアだったが、ある日男性を“ご奉仕”してあげると効率よく貯まることに気が付き……?

元の世界に帰り、先輩に想いを伝えるのか?
それとも、むちむちな体でどスケベご奉仕ライフを続けるのか?

選ぶのは――プレイヤーである“あなた”自身。

name: L'éléphant et la baleine
summary: An elephant saves an unfortunate whale from being paraded in front of the public and takes it away with the circus caravan to put it back into the sea.
